title: Senior Network Engineer
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Senior Network Engineer to take ownership of key areas of MongoDB's global network infrastructure. You'll design, deploy, and troubleshoot network and VPN solutions, including Palo Alto Prisma Access at global scale, partner with InfoSec to harden network security, and mentor engineers across the team. This role combines deep hands-on networking expertise with the judgment to prioritize and communicate risk and strategy to stakeholders.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the design, deployment, and operation of MongoDB's global network infrastructure Cisco Meraki, including routers, switches, firewalls,access points and IOT sensors
  • Lead the rollout and ongoing management of Palo Alto Prisma Access as MongoDB's SASE , in partnership with InfoSec
  • Administer and evolve MongoDB's network authentication stack, including RADIUS implementations (EAP-TLS, PAP, RadSec and Mac Authentication), ensuring secure and reliable network access
  • Partner with InfoSec to implement and continuously improve network security controls, including VLAN configuration, firewall rules, DNS, DHCP, and IDS/IPS solutions
  • Design and deploy network infrastructure for new and existing global office sites, partnering with Real Estate, workplace, AV, and Physical Security teams
  • Serve as a senior technical escalation point (L3) for complex network issues across the organization
  • Build automation to reduce manual network operations work and improve reliability and observability
  • Act as a technical advisor for MongoDB's relationships with ISPs, hardware, low voltage cabling and other network vendors
  • Mentor engineers across the team and contribute to a culture of technical excellence and self-service

Responsibilities

  • Ensure MongoDB's global network infrastructure and VPN remain fault tolerant, reliable, secure, and scalable as the company grows
  • Reduce risk and technical debt across network, security and remote access solutions
  • Communicate network strategy, risk, and incidents clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Uphold strong engineering practices across network documentation, automation, and change management
  • Balance long-term network architecture work with day-to-day operational support
  • Ability to use iterative designs to PoC and deploy new network solution based on company problems

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience
  • 6+ years of experience in network or systems engineering, with a strong grasp of networking fundamentals (OSI model, routing, switching, IP subnetting, cabling, wireless)
  • Proven experience designing, deploying, and troubleshooting high availability network infrastructure at global scale, including routers, switches, firewalls, access points and IOT sensors in high-availability configurations
  • Hands-on experience with network dashboards and platforms such as Cisco Meraki and HPE Aruba
  • Experience implementing and managing VPN and secure access solutions such as Palo Alto Prisma Access, Cloudfare IPSEC L2TP and Cisco secure client / anyconnect
  • Experience with network authentication technologies such as FoxPass, LDAP, and Okta (SAML)
  • Solid understanding of enterprise network design and cloud networking best practices (High availability, VLAN, DHCP, DNS, IP subnetting, firewall rules)
  • Experience partnering with InfoSec, Physical Security, and Workplace teams on cross-functional network initiatives
  • Scripting skills for network automation using infrastructure as code
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics to a wide range of audiences
  • Experience with network documentation such as rack elevation, patching matrices and network topologies at a layer 2 and layer 3 level
  • There will be requirements from time to time to work across multiple time zones as required by the business, including travel

Preferred Qualifications

  • CCNA, CCNP, Meraki Solutions specialist, or equivalent networking certification
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and hybrid network architectures
  • Experience mentoring other network or systems engineers
  • Familiarity with MDM and endpoint tools such as JAMF and Workspace ONE (AirWatch)
  • Experience working directly with ISPs and external vendors to resolve complex connectivity issues

Success Measures

  • In 3 months, you will: Be fully onboarded with a thorough understanding of MongoDB's network infrastructure and policies, have completed a review of the existing environment, and be providing effective L3 support
  • In 6 months, you will: Have led at least one medium-scale network or VPN project end to end, such as a Palo Alto Prisma Access rollout or office network upgrade, and implemented measurable network security improvements
  • In 12 months, you will: Be recognized as a senior technical owner for MongoDB's global network, having led large-scale infrastructure projects and mentored other engineers on the team

Location & Travel:

  • This role is based in Palo Alto / San Francisco, CA, and candidates should be located within reasonable commuting distance of our Palo Alto and San Francisco offices
  • The team operates with a flexible work arrangement, with in-person collaboration typically occurring 1–2 times per month
  • This role also involves travel and occasional work across time zones to support global office builds

title: Senior Consulting Engineer
descriptionHtml:
The team

MongoDB's Application Modernization Platform (AMP) organization is the front door of our modernization business. In our Data Migration practice we move production data - safely, repeatably, at enterprise scale - from relational estates (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and from NoSQL platforms (Apache Cassandra, Azure Cosmos DB, Amazon DocumentDB) onto MongoDB. We do this both as standalone migration programmes and as the data workstream inside larger application-modernization engagements, using MongoDB's own tooling - Relational Migrator, Cluster-to-Cluster Sync, Atlas Stream Processing - alongside the open-source and cloud-native pipeline ecosystem. 

Our mission is to help our customers be successful by leading end-to-end their journey to MongoDB. In an era where AI agents handle routine migration mechanics - such as workload assessments, schema and query translations, and large-scale validation - our consultants focus on the high-judgment decisions that directly mitigate risk. Joining us now means helping draft the playbooks while they are actively being defined. We are seeking builders who prefer creating new frameworks over following legacy instructions.

This role will be based remotely in Germany.

Position expectations

Delivery

  • Plan and lead the technical delivery of data migration engagements end to end: source estate assessment, migration strategy and wave planning, schema and data-model transformation, pipeline build, validation, and production cutover with minimal downtime
  • Design and operate change data capture (CDC) pipelines for zero and near-zero-downtime migrations - using Kafka and the connector ecosystem, Debezium and comparable log-based CDC tooling, and cloud-native replication services
  • Bring genuine platform depth on the estates our customers are leaving: Cassandra data modeling and anti-patterns, Cosmos DB (Core and Mongo API) partitioning and RU economics, DocumentDB's compatibility surface - and use it to de-risk what the customer cannot see coming
  • Work shoulder to shoulder with enterprise customers - architects, DBAs, platform teams and executives - from whiteboard to war room
  • Own the full consulting lifecycle for your engagements, from planning and agenda-setting through post-engagement follow-up, surfacing risks and further opportunities back to Sales and Professional Services

Pre-sales and growth

  • Partner with Solutions Architects, Engagement Managers and account teams to scope and size migration opportunities, shape statements of work and estimation models, and give sales well-founded confidence in what is achievable and what it will take
  • Cultivate your reputation as a migrations SME and trusted advisor, internally and in the market, and positively influence your own utilization through proactive customer engagement
  • Identify services opportunities in our customers, new workloads or estates to be migrated or product improvements the customer could benefit from

Building the practice

  • Build and harden the AI tooling that makes migrations faster and safer: agents for automated estate assessment, schema and data-model conversion, query and code translation, and large-scale data validation - and fold what works into the standard delivery methodology
  • Turn field experience into reusable assets: migration playbooks, reference architectures, estimation models, tooling improvements and enablement for the wider team
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to bring field reality into MongoDB's product and migration-tooling roadmap

Candidate profile

  • Professional fluency in German is required
  • Excellent analytical, diagnostic and problem-solving skills, and the composure to apply them during a production cutover
  • Degree in Computer Science or a similar technical field, and a technology-first mindset that lets you build credibility with some of the smartest technologists in the world
  • 5+ years in software engineering, data engineering, or consulting delivery roles centred on data platforms and data movement at production scale
  • Hands-on experience with at least one of: Apache Cassandra, Azure Cosmos DB, Amazon DocumentDB, or another distributed NoSQL platform - deep enough to reason about data models, consistency, partitioning and failure modes, not just operate one
  • Real-world CDC and streaming-pipeline experience: Kafka or Confluent Platform, connectors, Debezium or equivalent, schema evolution, exactly-once versus at-least-once trade-offs, backfill-plus-tail patterns
  • Solid grounding in relational databases (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL or MySQL) and in getting data out of them without breaking the business
  • Competence in at least one programming language (Java, Python, Node.js, C#, Go or similar) - enough to build pipeline glue, validation harnesses and tooling, not only to configure products
  • Working fluency with AI in real engineering workflows
  • Excellent customer interaction and presentation skills: you can explain a partitioning strategy to a DBA at 10:00 and a migration risk profile to a Senior Leadership at 11:00, and both leave more confident than they arrived
  • An entrepreneurial bias. You see the gaps and what is missing. You are comfortable operating where the process does not exist yet, and you would rather ship a rough first version and iterate than wait for the shape to be agreed

MongoDB expertise is not a requirement. We will teach you MongoDB - that is the part we are world-class at. What we cannot teach is the scar tissue from the platforms and pipelines above. Bring that.

Nice to have

  • Experience building with LLMs beyond personal productivity: you use LLMs and coding agents as part of how you build and deliver today
  • Migration or replication tooling experience: Spark or Flink-based pipelines, dual-write patterns, cloud DMS-class services, data-validation frameworks
  • One or more cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) at architecture depth
  • Experience on the vendor or consulting side of competitive platform displacements
  • Practical experience with MongoDB
  • Fluency in a second European language relevant to this market

Practicalities

Travel up to approximately 30% in normal circumstances, primarily within EMEA.

title: Manager Compliance
descriptionHtml:
MongoDB is looking for a Manager, International Compliance to own statutory, regulatory, and corporate compliance for MongoDB's entities outside the US. This role sits at the intersection of Controllership, Legal, and Tax, ensuring MongoDB operates in full compliance with local corporate, tax, labor, and exchange control regulations across its international footprint, while supporting the broader global controllership agenda. This is a strong fit for someone who thrives on owning a compliance function across multiple jurisdictions, has strong experience navigating varied regulatory frameworks, and can lead a small team while partnering closely with global Finance, Legal, and Tax stakeholders.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model

Key Responsibilities

Statutory & Regulatory Compliance

  • Own end-to-end compliance for MongoDB's international entities across corporate, tax, exchange control, and applicable labor law requirements in each jurisdiction
  • Ensure timely filing of statutory returns, registers, and disclosures across countries, coordinating with local advisors and in-country teams where needed
  • Monitor changes in regulatory requirements across MongoDB's international markets and proactively assess impact on operations
  • Maintain a compliance calendar and tracker spanning all applicable jurisdictions and statutes, with clear ownership and escalation paths

Corporate Governance & Secretarial Coordination

  • Coordinate with local company secretaries, external counsel, and registered agents on board meetings, resolutions, annual filings, and other corporate governance requirements across entities
  • Support entity structuring, intercompany agreements, and any new entity registrations, migrations, or closures internationally
  • Maintain statutory registers across jurisdictions and ensure corporate records are audit-ready at all times

Tax & Exchange Control Compliance

  • Partner with the Global Tax team on transfer pricing documentation, filings, and audits specific to international entities
  • Ensure compliance with local exchange control and cross-border transaction reporting requirements in relevant jurisdictions
  • Support local tax assessments, notices, and inquiries in coordination with external advisors

Controls & Audit

  • Maintain and strengthen internal controls (including SOX) over international compliance processes
  • Serve as a key point of contact for statutory auditors, internal auditors, and local tax authorities on international compliance matters
  • Identify control gaps, document process narratives, and drive remediation in partnership with Controllership and Internal Audit

Team Leadership

  • Supervise and mentor a small compliance team, reviewing work product and building technical depth across jurisdictions
  • Set priorities during peak filing cycles and manage workload across the team

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner closely with Legal on regulatory matters, licenses, and corporate approvals across international entities
  • Work with HR on local labor law compliance, including statutory benefits, employment filings, and other country-specific employee-related obligations
  • Support FP&A and Global Controllership with compliance-related reporting and risk assessments
  • Act as the international compliance point of contact for global stakeholders navigating local regulatory requirements

Process Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to standardize and automate compliance tracking and filings across jurisdictions (e.g., through compliance management tools or improved workflows)
  • Support system implementations or process changes affecting international statutory and regulatory reporting

Qualifications

  • 8–10 years of progressive experience in international statutory compliance, corporate secretarial, or regulatory roles, with meaningful exposure to a multinational or SaaS/tech environment
  • Strong working knowledge of corporate governance, exchange control, and compliance frameworks across multiple jurisdictions (India experience a plus)
  • Experience liaising directly with regulators, statutory auditors, and external counsel across countries
  • Prior experience operating in a SOX-controlled environment; supervisory or mentoring experience preferred

title: Senior Software Engineer, Competitive Benchmarking
descriptionHtml:
MongoDB’s mission is to empower innovators to create, transform, and disrupt industries by unleashing the power of software and data. We enable organizations of all sizes to easily build, scale, and run modern applications by helping them modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unlock AI.

We’re looking for a Software Engineer to join the PM Benchmarking team in Mexico City. This team designs and executes competitive performance testing that benchmarks MongoDB against alternative technologies, while also building the reusable tooling, frameworks, and engineering practices needed to scale that work over time.

This role is a strong fit for an engineer who wants meaningful hands-on coding time, enjoys performance analysis, and is motivated by turning ambiguous technical questions into clear plans, repeatable systems, and high-impact outputs. You will work across the full lifecycle of a benchmark initiative: design, code, run, analyze, and communicate findings. You will also help improve the internal tooling and engineering workflows that make this work faster, more reliable, and more useful across MongoDB.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Mexico for our hybrid working model.

What you’ll do

  • Design performance and benchmarking workloads that reflect realistic customer or product scenarios
  • Build and improve production-quality internal tooling, test harnesses, automation, and reusable workload components
  • Write and maintain code primarily in Python, while adapting to adjacent tools and technologies as needed
  • Run benchmarks across cloud environments and database platforms, with attention to fairness, noise reduction, cost, and repeatability
  • Analyze latency, throughput, scalability, and infrastructure signals to identify bottlenecks and explain results clearly
  • Translate broad business or engineering questions into scoped technical plans, success criteria, and execution milestones
  • Partner closely with Engineering, Product, Sales, and other stakeholders to ensure testing work is relevant and actionable
  • Produce clear technical documents, reports, and summaries that connect findings to product decisions and field value
  • Help shape team standards for documentation, onboarding, prioritization, and benchmark execution as the team continues to mature
  • Mentor peers where appropriate and contribute to a collaborative, low-ego engineering culture

What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years of experience building, debugging, and improving distributed and/or highly concurrent software systems
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including writing maintainable code, profiling performance, and debugging complex issues
  • Hands-on experience with MongoDB architecture, MongoDB Query Language (MQL), and MongoDB performance tuning
  • Hands-on experience with performance testing methodologies such as load, stress, latency, or scalability testing
  • Experience designing and implementing benchmarking or performance-validation workflows
  • Strong coding skills in Python or a similar language, plus the ability to learn new stacks quickly
  • Strong hands-on experience with at least one of the three major cloud providers used for this role, AWS, Azure or GCP, including the practical trade-offs involved in running reliable applications at scale
  • Strong hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, Aurora, Cassandra, or other competing data platforms
  • Ability to reason about relational and document data models, distributed systems behavior, and infrastructure bottlenecks
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, especially when explaining technical findings to different audiences
  • Ability to work with ambiguity, define structure where needed, and operate with a high degree of ownership and autonomy
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Nice to have

  • Experience with CI/CD systems and integrating automated tests into engineering workflows
  • Experience creating reusable technical documentation, runbooks, or internal playbooks

Success in this role

In your first 30 days

  • Build a clear understanding of the team’s current workloads, tooling, roadmap, and stakeholder landscape
  • Complete onboarding and identify the main technical systems, docs, and knowledge gaps relevant to your work
  • Start contributing code, review feedback, and execution support on active benchmark efforts

In your first 90 days

  • Independently contribute to the design, coding, execution, and analysis of multiple benchmark initiatives
  • Improve at least one area of the team’s tooling, documentation, or execution workflow
  • Build strong working relationships with key cross-functional partners

In your first 6 months

  • Own meaningful benchmark or tooling work from scoping through delivery
  • Improve repeatability, clarity, or efficiency in how the team designs, runs, or reports on tests
  • Contribute to mentorship, documentation, or process improvements that increase team autonomy

In your first 12 months

  • Be a trusted technical contributor across benchmark design, tooling, and analysis
  • Influence how the team prioritizes and scales its work
  • Expand your scope through technical leadership, cross-functional collaboration, and deeper ownership of systems and processes

title: Staff Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
MongoDB is looking for a Staff Product Manager to define and execute the strategy for our Developer Tools portfolio. This role will help developers and data practitioners learn about, explore, model, query, and work with data through intuitive, powerful experiences.

The initial scope includes MongoDB Compass and Data Explorer, with the opportunity to shape connected experiences across the broader developer tools ecosystem, including MongoDB Shell, IDE integrations, data modeling, and AI powered developer experiences.

You will operate as a company-wide product leader: setting direction, simplifying complex technical problems, and aligning engineering, design, research, developer advocacy, marketing, sales, support, and adjacent product teams around measurable customer outcomes.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin for our hybrid working model.

What you’ll do

  • Own product strategy for experiences that span desktop, browser, Atlas, and self-managed deployments, creating a coherent journey rather than a collection of disconnected tools
  • Identify high-impact opportunities in data exploration, querying, performance troubleshooting, schema and data modeling, governance, and observability

What you bring

  • 6+ years of product management experience, including experience leading complex technical products, platforms, or developer-facing experiences

title: Staff Product Manager, Atlas Clusters
descriptionHtml:
Atlas is at the heart of our AI-ready data foundation. Atlas is a best-in-class, fully managed, multi-cloud database service that simplifies the complexities of deploying and managing highly available database deployments across multiple regions and cloud providers. Atlas offers vertically and horizontally scalability, built-in automation for optimizing workloads and resources, advanced observability and security features, and unmatched data distribution with over 125 regions available globally across AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure.

This team is at the forefront of innovation, having brought to life some of the most exciting features we've launched in the past, such as multi-cloud databases, predictive autoscaling, and next-generation hardware support on AWS. Furthermore, this team will continue to play a critical role as the platform expands to where developers need it most.

The Role

MongoDB's Atlas Product Management team is seeking a Staff Product Manager to own key cross-domain initiatives within Atlas Clusters. In this role, you will be a key member of the Atlas Clusters product management team, helping make the core Atlas platform a market differentiator that enables MongoDB to win in enterprise and at scale.

You will lead product strategy and execution for capabilities and programs that support enterprise platform requirements and broader large-scale customer needs. You will work across Engineering, Design, Support, Security, and Go-to-Market teams to translate complex technical and customer requirements into clear product investments, roadmaps, and outcomes.

This role is suited for a candidate who can orchestrate multiple interlinked product areas, own cross-team product and architectural trade-offs, and align senior stakeholders around multi-year bets. You will be expected to identify opportunities and dependencies that cut across team boundaries, bring clarity to ambiguous problem spaces, and establish reusable ways of working that help MongoDB deliver reliable, scalable platform capabilities for enterprise and other demanding markets.

You will partner closely with senior engineering and business leaders to evaluate trade-offs, sequence investments, and bring clarity to decisions that balance customer impact, execution risk, and long-term business value.

Responsibilities

Atlas Clusters Product Strategy

  • Own key cross-domain initiatives on the Atlas Clusters roadmap, translating requirements e.g., enterprise platform blockers, multi-cloud architecture, and resilience programs into clear product priorities
  • Define goals and milestones for major platform programs, including platform resiliency, and drive accountability across teams
  • Lead gap assessments and scope customer-driven engineering work

Cross-Functional Program Leadership

  • Drive complex, multi-team programs by setting governance, success metrics, and operating cadence across teams
  • Partner with Engineering and SRE on architecture interpretation, implementation decisions, and launch readiness
  • Embed reliability- and scale-first workflows into product development and delivery

Market Expansion and Enterprise go-to-market (GTM)

  • Lead product strategy for growing Atlas, partnering with GTM to bring new platform capabilities to market and drive adoption
  • Evaluate control plane and infrastructure options, assess engineering trade-offs, and align teams on expansion requirements
  • Partner with Finance, Engineering, and GTM on pricing, packaging, and launch decisions

Customer-Driven Product Development

  • Build strong feedback loops with Customer Engineering, Solutions Architects, Support, and GTM to ensure roadmap priorities reflect field needs
  • Translate customer escalations, support trends, and market gaps into a prioritized Atlas Clusters roadmap
  • Serve as an internal expert on emerging infrastructure and platform trends that shape product direction

Stakeholder Alignment and Executive Communication

  • Align Engineering, Design, Product Marketing, and GTM around product strategy and execution
  • Define KPIs and success metrics for Atlas Clusters investments
  • Represent MongoDB with customers and prospects as a subject matter expert on Atlas architecture and large-scale cloud database deployments

Requirements

  • 10+ years of product management experience on technically complex, infrastructure-level products. Database, distributed systems, or cloud infrastructure experience is a plus but not required. We care about your ability to ramp fast on hard technical domains and make sound product decisions once you do
  • Demonstrated success owning enterprise-grade, technical products end-to-end — not just shipping them, but delivering measurable customer and business outcomes you can quantify
  • Technical fluency: comfortable discussing architecture, failure modes, performance characteristics, and tradeoffs with Staff and Distinguished engineers, and connecting technical decisions directly to customer outcomes. You do need to be the kind of PM who will understand key areas deeply within your first month and have an opinion about how it affects the customer experience by month two
  • Track record of taking products from 0 to 1 and from 1 to 50 — building something new and scaling what works
  • Hands-on experience with databases, distributed systems, or cloud infrastructure platforms (compute, storage, networking, capacity planning). MongoDB experience is a plus
  • Ability to write, promote, and execute business cases. The ability to drive complex projects across multiple teams and deliver results
  • Strong customer-orientation and field-connection, regularly engaging directly with customers and field teams and translating their input into clear requirements and roadmap decisions
  • Excellent written and verbal communication: crisp, high-quality artifacts and the ability to tailor the message by audience (engineering, executives, customers, field). In this role you will represent product direction to enterprise CTOs and to senior engineering leaders who may disagree with your priorities. You need to hold the room
  • Strong analytical skills and metrics rigor, including defining success metrics, instrumenting and debugging analytics, and using data to inform (but not replace) judgment
  • Demonstrated decision-making speed and conviction under ambiguity, with specific examples of making hard calls, cutting scope, and holding a position under pushback. We will ask you about this in the interview, and we will push back on your answer
  • Desire to be a part of the Go-to-Market, Marketing, and Sales enablement process

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Cloud providers such as AWS, Azure, and GCP
  • Community support and participation to advance cloud database and infrastructure technology such as conference or meetup panels and blog or paper authorship
  • Proficiency in managing large scale software rollouts, especially in ways to automate and cohort rollouts to prioritize different environments and customers
  • Experience collaborating with customers in highly regulated industries, understanding the unique challenges and requirements they face
  • MBA, M.Sc. or Ph.D. in relevant domains

title: Senior Software Engineer, Atlas Clusters Security
descriptionHtml:
MongoDB is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join the Atlas Clusters Organization. The organization is responsible for building MongoDB Atlas, our database as a service offering and fastest growing product. Atlas allows users to deploy fault-tolerant, secure, globally distributed MongoDB clusters in just minutes. This includes developing software to interface with the three major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, and GCP) in order to bring security, durability, availability, and performance to all deployments of MongoDB.

Atlas Clusters Security builds the security experience that Atlas customers depend on for mission-critical applications. Across the organization we own cluster networking, data encryption, database authentication, and related controls.

This role sits on the Encryption & Compliance team. We own Encryption at Rest with customer-managed keys (Bring Your Own Key) across AWS, Azure, and GCP, including private networking to customer key management systems. We also own the security and compliance work that lets Atlas serve highly regulated markets, including government offerings and internal credential management. You will design and operate these systems in production, lead fleet-wide rollouts, and partner with customers when encryption or key-management issues hit their clusters.

This role can be based remotely within the U.S. in the Pacific, Mountain, or Central time zones only.

What you’ll do

  • Build and design new features for MongoDB Atlas
  • Contribute to and lead complex technical projects
  • Work closely with product and design teams, considering the user’s perspective while building technical solutions
  • Work with customers and support engineers to fix issues
  • Collaborate with team members to develop our codebase, best practices, and design principles
  • Learn from and mentor other team members
  • Join an on-call rotation to support Atlas’ production services

We’re looking for someone who

  • Has at least 5 years of professional software development experience
  • Is skilled at writing large-scale, distributed backend systems in a compiled language (Java, Go, etc.)
  • Has experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Has led the launch of a new feature and maintained it in production
  • Is eager to solve tough problems
  • Has excellent communication skills
  • Is curious, collaborative, and motivated
  • Nice to have: experience with cloud key management (KMS / Key Vault / Cloud KMS), IAM, private networking, or encryption in a production SaaS environment

Success Measures

  • In 3 months, you'll have shipped code into production and collaborated with the team to solve tough problems
  • In 6 months, you'll have contributed to a large project and joined our on-call rotation
  • In 12 months, you'll have designed new features, led development work, and become a go-to expert on Encryption at Rest, customer-managed keys, or a related part of the system

title: Senior Manager, Event Operations
descriptionHtml:
The Sr. Manager, Event Operations, leads the operating model behind MongoDB’s global Strategic Events portfolio. Reporting to the Director of Global Strategic Events, this leader owns the processes, platforms, planning cadence, and measurement framework that turn portfolio strategy into consistent, high-quality execution at scale, and leads the team that runs them.

This role is for an event operations leader who has run events hands-on and is ready to design how a global events function operates: how work is prioritized and resourced, how technology and AI are applied, and how event impact is measured and reported to senior leadership. You will build the operating model that allows Strategic Events to grow its reach and impact without a proportional increase in resources.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin for our hybrid working model.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead and develop the Strategic Events Operations team. Set priorities, define roles and performance standards, coach and develop team members, and hold a consistent bar for quality and execution across every program in the portfolio
  • Design and own the event operating model. Define the intake, workflows, governance, service levels by event tier, and operating rhythms that the Strategic Events team and its partners run on. Build the playbooks and standards that make execution repeatable across regions and event types
  • Translate strategy into execution. Partner with the Director of Global Strategic Events to turn portfolio strategy into team standards, event execution plans, and resourcing models
  • Own the events technology and data ecosystem. Be accountable for the project management tools (e.g., Wrike, JIRA), event and registration platforms (e.g., Cvent, Luma), and reporting systems the team relies on. Decide what to standardize, integrate, automate, or retire
  • Build and govern agentic workflows in production. Identify where AI agents and automation can take on work across planning, registration, reporting, and stakeholder communications, and design, deploy, and maintain those workflows at scale. Define where agents can act autonomously and where human review or approval is required, measure their impact on speed, quality, and team capacity, and lead the team in operating and evolving them
  • Plan capacity and manage the global events calendar. Run capacity planning, balance workload against company priorities, and surface resourcing risk early so it never becomes a delivery problem
  • Drive measurement and reporting. Partner with Marketing Ops to define the metrics, lead-flow tracking, and post-event reporting used across first- and third-party events, and synthesize results into clear recommendations for senior stakeholders
  • Act as the operations partner to Sales, Marketing, and Partner teams. Work through competing priorities, budget trade-offs, and process gaps directly, and keep stakeholders aligned on how Strategic Events works and what to expect
  • Continuously improve how the work gets done. Redesign roles, consolidate tools, and rebuild processes so the team can take on more with the resources in place. Make the call and see it through to implementation

Qualifications

  • 8+ years in event operations, event marketing, or marketing operations, ideally in B2B SaaS or enterprise technology, with progressive scope and strategic impact
  • Experience leading and developing people in an events, marketing, or program operations environment, including setting priorities, coaching, and raising the standard of work
  • A track record of designing operating models, processes, or playbooks for an events or marketing organization that were adopted across teams and sustained over time
  • Deep expertise with event and registration platforms, project management software, and AI tooling
  • Hands-on experience applying AI and automation to operational workflows, and leading a team to make them part of everyday work
  • Strong analytical skills and fluency with data tools such as Tableau and Salesforce, with the ability to turn event and pipeline data into recommendations for senior stakeholders
  • Proven ability to influence and align stakeholders across functions, seniority levels, and time zones without relying on constant escalation
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with strong meeting management and follow-through
  • PMP or CPM a plus

title: Technical Services Engineer, Infrastructure
descriptionHtml:
MongoDB Technical Services Engineers use their outstanding problem solving and customer service skills, along with their deep technical experience, to advise customers and to solve their complex MongoDB problems. Technical Services Engineers in the Infrastructure team are skilled in automation, backup, performance, and security that underpins mission-critical deployments at scale. In addition engineers within the team have specialisations in advanced technology areas such as Search, Vector Search, auto-embedding, event-driven and agentic workloads. Our engineers combine their MongoDB expertise with passion, initiative, teamwork, and a great sense of humor to achieve exceptional results for our customers.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Sydney for our hybrid working model. The standard work week post ramping will be Sunday - Thursday every week. With three days in office.

Why MongoDB is a fantastic place to work and build your career

  • Be a part of the company that’s reinventing the database, passionate about innovation and speed
  • Enjoy a fun, inspiring culture that is engineering focused
  • Work with exceptionally talented people around the globe
  • Learn, contribute, and make an impact on the product and community

Cool things you’ll do

MongoDB, the developer data platform and AI platform of choice for modern applications, is on a mission to change the way people think about databases. As they build intelligent, data-driven experiences on our platform, our customers naturally encounter questions and challenges about how our approach to data and databases fits their specific use cases and architectural needs. In Technical Services, it’s our job to guide these people, helping them design, operate, and optimize their solutions so they can succeed with MongoDB.

You'll be working alongside our largest customers, solving their complex issues - resolving questions on architecture, performance, recovery, security, and everything in between. You'll be an expert resource on standard methodologies in running MongoDB at scale, whatever that scale may be.  You'll be an advocate for customers' needs - working with our product management and development teams on their behalf. You'll contribute to internal projects, including software development of support tools for performance, benchmarking, and diagnostics.

MongoDB Technical Services puts a strong focus on engineers enabling their peers to be successful by sharing newly gained technical knowledge with the team, either via informal one-to-one conversations, or training and workshop sessions. By documenting solutions in our knowledge platform, TSEs will increase the efficiency of our customers, other team members and departments throughout MongoDB. 

Beyond direct customer work, you will contribute to internal tools and automation that make our engineers and customers more effective, including AI-assisted diagnostics, performance analysis, and knowledge discovery. You will share what you learn by writing knowledge base articles, delivering training and workshops, and mentoring new team members. As MongoDB’s AI and data platform continues to evolve, you will play a key role in exploring and teaching new product capabilities across the MongoDB ecosystem.

What you need

You should have 5+ years of proven experience, we consider all candidates with an eye for those who are self-taught, insatiably curious, and multi-faceted. 

The ideal candidate should have a mix of experience in most of the following areas: 

  • Systems engineering experience, including Linux performance, memory management, I/O tuning, configuration, security, networking, clusters, and troubleshooting
  • Understand core Kubernetes concepts, including containers, namespaces, custom resources and multi-cluster deployments
  • Should have a good understanding of Networking concepts and protocols (DNS, TCP/IP, SSL/TLS, etc.)
  • Storage engineering experience, including NAS, SAN, SSD, multi-pathing, and caching
  • Experience building and maintaining complex mission-critical production database systems
  • Broad awareness of customer workloads and use cases, including performance, availability, and scalability
  • Experience analyzing issues holistically, from the application tier through the database, down to the storage
  • Be able to read code, and basic coding/scripting ability in one or more languages: Java, Python, Ruby, C, C++, C#, Javascript, node.js, Go, etc.
  • Desire and ability to rapidly learn a wide variety of new technical skills

You should possess a genuine desire to help people, the ability to think on your feet and remain calm under pressure while solving problems in real-time. There’s a lot to learn, so the desire and ability to rapidly learn a wide variety of new technical skills is paramount. We work in a collaborative team environment, so a willingness and ability to get help from team members when required, and good judgment to know when to seek help, is essential. We also aim to have diverse technical backgrounds and therefore different subject matter expertise is welcome.

You do not need to have prior experience with MongoDB. We can teach you that! 

Bonus Points

  • Experience managing large scale databases (e.g. RDBMS, NoSQL)
  • Experience with authentication systems such as LDAP, Kerberos, AD
  • Experience using or managing MongoDB
  • Experience using distributed version control systems, and in particular git
  • Experience using any cloud services stack such as AWS, Azure or GCP
  • Experience with Kubernetes (including CLI), ability to inspect resource / container status using relevant utilities and commands

Success Measures

  • In 3 months, you’ll have gained a deep understanding of MongoDB and its ecosystem. You will complete New Hire Training
  • In 6 months, you will be comfortable partnering with our customers. You will also complete the MongoDB Certified DBA Associate exam
  • In 12 months, you will be a technical specialist within MongoDB and will be helping your peer engineers in advance diagnostics. Also, you will be encouraged to handle technical escalations independently

descriptionHtml:
MongoDB Technical Services Engineers use their exceptional problem solving and customer service skills, along with their deep technical experience, to advise customers and to solve their complex MongoDB problems. テクニカルサービスエンジニア

世界のデータ管理ソフトウェア市場は巨大で、IDCは2026年に1,376億ドルに達すると予測しています。MongoDBは、さまざまな業界に変革をもたらし、人々が毎日使う優れたアプリを開発者が作れるよう支援しています。私たちは、業界をリードする開発者向けデータプラットフォームであり、20年ぶりにIPOを果たしたデータベースプロバイダーです。イノベーションと創造性の最前線で、ともに挑戦しませんか。

MongoDBのテクニカルサービスエンジニア(TSE)は、卓越した問題解決力とカスタマーサービススキル、深い技術的知見を活かし、お客様への助言や、MongoDBにまつわる複雑な課題の解決にあたります。TSEは、データベースサーバー、ドライバー、クラウド、インフラなど、MongoDBエコシステム全体のエキスパートです。DBaaSの「Atlas」や、MongoDBシステムの自動化・バックアップ・監視を支援する「Cloud Manager」なども担当します。私たちのエンジニアは、MongoDBの専門性に加え、情熱、主体性、チームワーク、そしてユーモアを大切にしながら、お客様に最高の成果を届けています。

ハイブリッド勤務のため、日本在住の方からのご応募をお待ちしています。

仕事内容

  • 大規模で要求水準の高いお客様とともに、セルフマネージド環境のMongoDBからAtlasへの移行を最初から最後まで支援します(部門横断型のポジションです)
  • お客様のユースケース、ビジネス上の課題、アプリケーションやクラウドインフラの構成を踏まえて最適な解決策を検討し、TSEとしてのトラブルシューティング力を高められます
  • プロフェッショナルサービスのコンサルティングエンジニアと連携し、ワークロードからDB、インフラまでを一貫して評価します。そのうえで、AtlasへのMongoDBワークロード移行について、社内チームとお客様に専門的なアドバイスを行います
  • 製品へのフィードバックを通じて、移行手法、ツール、データベース本体のロードマップづくりに関われます

応募資格

  • 日本語・英語ともに流暢なレベル(ビジネスレベル以上)のコミュニケーション力
  • 相手に寄り添い、人の役に立ちたいという思いがあること
  • 文章・口頭の両方で、的確なコミュニケーションができること
  • 状況に応じて素早く判断し、プレッシャーの中でも冷静に解決策を見つけられること
  • 本番環境で発生する技術的な問題を、原因の切り分けから解決まで一貫して対応した経験
  • Oracle、PostgreSQL、MySQLなどのRDBMSの運用管理経験が5年以上(MongoDBの経験があれば尚可)
  • クラウドまたはオンプレミスのインフラ運用管理経験が5年以上
  • 以下のうち、いずれかの分野で3年以上の経験(他の分野の経験もあれば尚可)
    • データベースのパフォーマンスチューニング、ベンチマーク
    • 主要クラウド(AWS、GCP、Azure)の設定・利用
    • ファイアウォールやロードバランサなど、ネットワークの知識
    • シェルスクリプト、Python、PowerShellなどでの開発

歓迎要件

  • オンプレミスからクラウドへのデータベース・ワークロード移行の経験
  • 大規模データベース(RDBMS、NoSQL、またはその両方)の運用経験
  • Java、PHP、Python、Ruby、C、C++、C#、JavaScriptのいずれかでの開発経験

入社後のステップ

  • 3か月後:MongoDBとそのエコシステムへの理解を深め、入社時研修を修了します
  • 6か月後:お客様対応の最前線で、自信を持って業務を進められるようになります。MongoDB認定DBAアソシエイト試験にも合格します
  • 12か月後:社内の技術スペシャリストとして、高度な障害調査で同僚をサポートします。技術的なエスカレーション案件にも、自ら主体となって対応します

You will design, build, and scale learning experiences that will enable people managers to live our values, serve our customers, and ultimately strengthen culture and accelerate performance. This role is part of the Culture, Talent, and Development (CTD) leadership team. As a team, we are responsible for culture and talent building programs, including leadership development, employee learning, talent management, engagement, listening, and inclusion. 

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES include but are not limited to: 

  • Design, deliver, and evaluate scalable leadership development experiences, tools, and resources for people managers through direct delivery, internal facilitators, senior-leader faculty, train-the-trainer strategies, on-demand learning, and AI-supported experiences
  • Lead the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of a director-level leadership development program serving more than 500 leaders, including scalable solutions for enrollment, participant and manager accountability, and impact measurement
  • Conduct needs assessments and align program deliverables, priorities, and resources with business objectives and broader People Team initiatives

descriptionHtml:
The HR Technology organization is looking for a seasoned Senior Technical Program Manager to help enable the efficient delivery of technology solutions to meet stakeholder needs.  TPMs in the organization enable IT to accelerate business impact and strategically transform how we work with technology and AI.

title: Compensation Manager, Customer
descriptionHtml:
The Compensation team serves as a strategic advisor to business leaders, managers, and employees across MDB. We use data and insights to drive value and build the tools, models, and frameworks that support sound compensation decisions. This role sits within Compensation and partners closely with the Customer organization —and with Recruiting, Finance, Sales Operations, Legal, and HR.

The Difference You Will Make

We are looking for a Compensation Partner to serve as the dedicated partner for the Customer organization. This role will support VP and Director-level leaders, and their HRBP partners as the primary day-to-day compensation resource.

The ideal candidate will be a trusted business partner and builder of compensation programs, tools, and frameworks. They will bring deep experience supporting Customer organizations, a strong understanding of various incentive plans, and the ability to partner effectively with Operations and other teams that design them. This person must be comfortable operating autonomously, influencing senior stakeholders, and navigating a fast-moving environment.

A Typical Day

  • Serve as the dedicated compensation partner for the Customer organization, supporting leaders and People Partners across Customer Success, Professional Services, Technical Services and Strategic Partners teams
  • Provide data-informed guidance on new-hire offers, internal equity, leveling, promotions, retention actions, and out-of-cycle requests
  • Build a strong understanding of incentive plans and partner with the teams that design them to assess effectiveness and support informed compensation decisions
  • Own Partners compensation-cycle execution end-to-end, including market benchmarking, budget modeling, manager enablement, and leadership rollups
  • Lead competitive intelligence for Customer roles, researching compensation trends, pay practices, incentive structures, and talent movement in the evolving technology and AI landscape
  • Supplement survey data with recruiting signals, offer data, sales talent trends, and other real-time market sources
  • Partner with Recruiting and People Partners on market insights and competitive positioning for hires at all levels
  • Analyze compensation programs using data, business results, and stakeholder feedback; recommend improvements that support growth, retention, and pay-for-performance principles
  • Lead strategic projects such as incentive-plan governance, job architecture, or compensation-planning tool implementation
  • Develop manager enablement materials and training on compensation philosophy and decision-making

Your Expertise

  • 7+ years of compensation experience, including significant experience as a compensation business partner
  • Proven track record supporting Customer orgs, with end-to-end ownership of cyclical compensation programs
  • Experience supporting the implementation, administration, and communication of Sales incentive plans, with a strong understanding of how they operate
  • Experience partnering with Finance and Sales Operations on incentive-plan modeling, budgeting, forecasting, attainment analysis, and reporting
  • Strong knowledge of third-party survey methodologies, such as Radford and WTW, and the ability to build and validate pay structures across geographies and functions
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and executive-presenting skills
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives in ambiguous, fast-moving environments

Preferred Experience and Skills

  • Experience in both compensation business partner and program roles
  • Experience supporting a high-growth technology company, preferably in a global Customer environment
  • Experience with compensation-planning, incentive-compensation, and analytics tools
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build relationships across distributed teams
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to prioritize multiple projects with strong follow-through
  • Comfortable operating at both the tactical and strategic levels and creating structure in ambiguous environments
  • Experience working remotely and/or internationally with global teams
  • Strong business acumen and awareness of business, technology, and market trends

title: Senior Manager, Revenue
descriptionHtml:
The Revenue team is a highly visible, global team responsible for accurate and timely revenue reporting. The team manages the monthly and quarterly revenue close, supports contract review and accounting conclusions, evaluates revenue treatment for new and existing product offerings, maintains controls over revenue reporting, and supports revenue forecasting and analytics.

This role will lead the Revenue Operations team in Gurugram, India, with responsibility for managing and developing Revenue Managers and Revenue Analysts. The Senior Manager will be the primary point of leadership for the India Revenue Operations team and will be accountable for the quality and timely execution of the revenue processes owned by the team.

The role will partner closely with global Revenue leadership and cross-functional teams to manage close execution, resolve complex revenue and operational issues, strengthen processes and controls, and continue building the capabilities of the India team.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.

Candidate Profile

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance; CPA, CA, or equivalent qualification preferred
  • 10+ years of relevant experience, including experience in revenue accounting or revenue operations at a public, high-growth SaaS or technology company
  • Demonstrated people leadership experience, including managing Managers and individual contributors
  • Strong working knowledge of ASC 606, including experience with SaaS, cloud, and usage-based revenue models
  • Experience owning complex revenue close processes, including revenue recognition, journal entries, account reconciliations, revenue allocations, and related analytics
  • Experience reviewing customer contracts and evaluating non-standard terms and revenue accounting considerations
  • Strong understanding of financial reporting controls, SOX requirements, and external audit support
  • Demonstrated ability to independently assess complex issues, determine appropriate next steps and escalation, and drive matters through resolution
  • Experience improving or scaling accounting processes through standardization, automation, documentation, or enhanced controls
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to work with large data sets and identify trends, exceptions, and underlying drivers
  • Experience with ERP and CRM systems; NetSuite and Salesforce experience preferred
  • Advanced Excel skills
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across functions, levels, and global time zones
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines while maintaining a high degree of accuracy and sound judgment

Position Expectations

  • Lead, manage, and develop the Revenue Operations team in Gurugram, including Revenue Managers and Revenue Analysts, with accountability for team performance, development, workload allocation, and effective delegation
  • Own the monthly and quarterly revenue close activities within the India team's scope, including revenue analyses, journal entries, account reconciliations, revenue recognition, and related review activities, ensuring accurate and timely completion
  • Establish clear ownership, review, and escalation expectations across the team and ensure issues are identified and addressed on a timely basis
  • Review complex sales transactions within the Company's ERP and revenue systems to ensure the accuracy of underlying data, revenue allocations, and revenue schedules
  • Review contract analyses and provide guidance on revenue treatment for complex or non-standard arrangements under ASC 606 and the Company's accounting policies
  • Apply judgment to revenue accounting and operational issues, determine when escalation is required, and drive issues to resolution in partnership with global Revenue leadership and other stakeholders
  • Lead quarterly review and year-end audit activities for the revenue processes owned by the India team, including coordination of supporting documentation and resolution of auditor questions
  • Review revenue analytics and complex data sets to identify trends, anomalies, and potential financial reporting or operational risks and communicate findings to Revenue leadership
  • Partner with OTC, Legal, FP&A, Product, Cloud Engineering, FinTech, and other cross-functional teams on initiatives and issues with revenue accounting or operational implications
  • Partner with global Revenue leadership to align processes, controls, and operating practices across the broader Revenue organization
  • Identify and lead opportunities to improve the efficiency, scalability, and control environment of Revenue Operations through process improvement, automation, standardization, and documentation
  • Coach Revenue Managers and Analysts to strengthen technical knowledge, operational ownership, judgment, and issue escalation
  • Support new products, systems, and business initiatives by assessing revenue accounting and operational impacts and helping ensure appropriate processes and controls are established
  • Lead revenue-related projects and other initiatives requiring coordination across the India Revenue team and global business partners

Success Measures

First 30 Days

  • A successful candidate will develop a strong understanding of the Company's business, product offerings, revenue streams, key systems, close processes, controls, and team responsibilities, while establishing relationships with the Gurugram team and key global stakeholders

3 to 6 Months

  • The Senior Manager will be independently overseeing the revenue close activities within the India team's scope, with clear ownership and escalation expectations established across Revenue Managers and Analysts. The individual will also have identified key opportunities to improve processes, controls, documentation, and team capability

6 to 9 Months

  • The Senior Manager will be operating as a trusted partner to Revenue leadership and key cross-functional teams, independently resolving routine operational matters and appropriately escalating complex or higher-risk issues. The role will also be driving targeted improvements in close execution, controls, automation, and process consistency

12 Months and Beyond

  • The Senior Manager will have established a strong, scalable Revenue Operations team in India, with clear accountability across Managers and Analysts, consistent execution of close and control responsibilities, and increased team capability to independently own complex revenue processes. The role will continue to drive improvements in efficiency, automation, controls, and operational scalability as the business evolves

title: Senior Payroll Specialist LATAM
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Senior Payroll Specialist to serve as a subject matter expert on our Global Payroll team, with ownership of payroll operations across LATAM (Brazil and Mexico). Reporting to the Senior Payroll Manager, this role partners closely with HR, Finance, and external vendors to ensure accurate, compliant, and timely payroll delivery.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Cork for our hybrid working model.

Responsibilities:

  • Prepare and review advance, monthly and supplemental payrolls for our LATAM operations including salary, equity, benefits, and variable pay
  • Manage Brazil 13º salário (13th month salary), férias (vacation), and rescisão (termination) calculations and payments
  • Manage Mexico Christmas Bonus, profit sharing and terminations calculations and payments 
  • Single point of contact (POC) for all LATAM issues. Resolve all issues in a timely manner and within global payroll SLAs
  • Reconcile payroll and support monthly/quarterly/annual accounting close processes
  • Build internal LATAM payroll expertise, reducing reliance on external consultants through hands-on guidance and more efficient processes
  • Issue union due slips and submit for payment 
  • Prepare the income tax DARF and reconcile the amounts according to the appropriate period
  • Deep, current knowledge of Brazilian labor law (CLT), social security and tax obligations, and the eSocial/FGTS Digital ecosystem
  • Own LATAM payroll-related employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, vacations and terminations, ensuring accurate and timely execution
  • Partner with Legal, Finance, and HR on termination processing, CBA (Dissidio) and any other processes as required
  • Ensure we are meeting annual compliance requirements; assist the Payroll Tax Team with any audits and year-end compliance reporting
  • Train junior payroll staff; document and continuously improve payroll SOPs
  • Automate processes to enhance scalability and efficiency of payroll operations
  • Ensure SOX compliance with all payroll operation processes
  • All other duties and responsibilities, as assigned

Skills and Qualifications:

  • Fluent in Portuguese (a must) and Spanish (a plus)
  • Experience with Brazil and Mexico end to end payroll 
  • Experience with Brazil payroll statutory obligations is required, i.e. hands-on experience with eSocial, FGTS Digital, INSS, IRRF and related filings
  • Advance proficiency with MS Word, Excel, Google Applications
  • Experience with ADP Celergo and SuccessFactors is a plus
  • Minimum 6+years of LATAM payroll experience
  • Subject matter expert in Brazil compliance and regulation including but not limited to vacation, collective bargaining agreements, 13th month salary calculations etc
  • Ability to partner and collaborate with various stakeholders to fulfill common goals
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills required to clearly communicate complex payroll matters to both employees and stakeholders
  • Ability to multi-task and work in a fast paced, high volume environment

title: Associate TSE II
descriptionHtml:
MongoDB Technical Services Engineers use their exceptional problem solving and customer service skills, along with their deep technical experience, to advise customers and to solve their complex MongoDB problems. Technical Service Engineers are experts in the entire MongoDB ecosystem - database server, drivers, cloud and infrastructure. This also includes services such as Atlas (database as a service), or Cloud Manager (which helps customers with automation, backup and monitoring of their MongoDB systems). Our engineers combine their MongoDB expertise with passion, initiative, teamwork and a great sense of humor to help our customers to be successful with MongoDB.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Bengaluru for our hybrid working model.

Cool things you’ll do

You'll be working alongside our largest customers, solving their complex challenges - resolving questions on architecture, performance, recovery, security, and everything in between. You'll be an expert resource on best practices in running MongoDB at scale, whatever that scale may be. You'll be an advocate for customers' needs - interfacing with our product management and development teams on their behalf. And you'll contribute to internal projects, including software development of support tools for performance, benchmarking, and diagnostics.

As an ideal candidate, you will have

We consider all candidates with an eye for those who are self taught, curious, and multi-faceted. Our ideal ATSE II candidate should have:

  • 4+ years of relevant experience
  • Strong understanding and grasp of the following areas
  • Systems administration
  • Troubleshooting Systems
  • Scalable and Highly available distributed systems
  • Network Administration
  • Application Architecture
  • Data architecture and design
  • Understanding of database architecture and administration
  • Experience in performance tuning and benchmarking
  • Previous experience in technical support
  • A B.Tech / B.S. or equivalent work experience

Nice to have

  • Comfortable with modern AI concepts and proficient in using AI-assisted tools to accelerate troubleshooting and enhance day-to-day technical support workflows.
  • Knowledge on one or more of Java, Python, Ruby, C, C++, C#, Javascript, node.js, Go, PHP, or Perl

It’s crucial for every candidate that they can check off all of these boxes

  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Genuine desire to help people
  • Uncontrollable urge to investigate and solve problems, with advanced diagnostic and troubleshooting skills
  • Ability to think on your feet, remain calm under pressure and solve problems in real-time
  • Desire and ability to rapidly learn a wide variety of new technical skills
  • Strong teamwork: willingness and ability to get help from team members when required, and the good judgment to know when to seek help

Success Measures 

  • In 3 months, you’ll have gained a deep understanding of MongoDB and its ecosystem. You will complete New Hire Training.

title: Staff Engineer
descriptionHtml:
MongoDB's Application Modernization Platform (AMP) helps organizations modernize legacy applications and move their workloads and associated data from relational databases to MongoDB. Our customers need a dependable way to bring analysis, transformation, testing, and migration capabilities into their modernization workflows.

The Platform team builds the shared foundations that make AMP a cohesive product. We connect specialized tools and services through consistent interfaces, integrate them with AI agents and development environments, and make them secure, observable, and straightforward to deploy and operate. Our work enables product teams to deliver new capabilities without repeatedly solving the same integration and infrastructure problems.

We are looking for a Staff Engineer to set technical direction and lead delivery of this platform. You will combine deep systems engineering with product judgment, turning ambiguous requirements into reusable services and working integrations. You will define clear boundaries between platform, product teams, and external partners; make deliberate build-versus-integrate decisions; and contribute foundational code. Your impact will be measured by how reliably teams and customers can adopt and use AMP capabilities, and how much engineering effort the platform removes from their path.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.

A strong candidate for this position will have:

  • Technical Leadership: Over 8 years in software engineering and production operations, with a proven history of championing major technical strategies and deploying resilient, scalable architectures
  • Platform Engineering: Deep practical expertise architecting common frameworks, distributed architectures, or core developer tooling leveraged across multiple organizations or customer environments
  • API & System Design: Track record of establishing and refining service boundaries, interfaces, and data schemas with a sharp focus on backward compatibility, extensibility, and smooth adoption
  • Operational Rigor: Practical expertise maintaining mission-critical services, driving observability, incident recovery, performance tuning, automated test suites, and continuous delivery workflows
  • Security Integration: Demonstrated success constructing safe integrations, implementing strict auth mechanisms while protecting proprietary client code, sensitive data, and authentication tokens
  • Cross-Functional Impact: Ability to spearhead architectural direction across team boundaries, communicate complex tradeoffs, offer constructive guidance, and mentor engineers throughout execution
  • Product Sense: Sharp product judgment that converts developer requirements and user feedback into clear roadmaps, tangible milestones, and clear success criteria

Not required but beneficial:

  • AI Agent & LLM Integration: Hands-on experience embedding intelligent agents or language model workflows into enterprise platforms, including defining execution contexts, robust tool interfaces, and mitigating nondeterministic operational behavior
  • Developer Tooling & Distribution: Expertise delivering developer-centric software—such as CLIs, custom SDKs, containerized architectures, or self-hosted components—deployed directly within client-managed infrastructure
  • Domain Expertise: In-depth background in application modernization, relational database systems, MongoDB ecosystems, automated code transformation, and enterprise data migration pipelines

Position Expectations

  • Architectural Vision & Strategy: Formulate core service layers and integration frameworks enabling seamless AMP functionality. Define strict service-level boundaries with collaborating engineering orgs, iteratively maturing platform primitives using production workloads
  • Agent & Tooling Integration: Spearhead engineering initiatives to expose platform capabilities via resilient CLI tools and APIs, connecting them cleanly with autonomous agent frameworks while managing tenant isolation, auth state, and operational context
  • Deployment & Lifecycle Engineering: Optimize distribution, automated upgrades, and runtime execution across client enterprise environments. Establish holistic telemetry, structured logging, and actionable diagnostics to streamline incident recovery and troubleshooting
  • Security & Enterprise Quality: Work closely alongside security engineers to safeguard customer intellectual property, ensuring robust execution isolation and embedding security controls directly into release pipelines
  • Cross-Functional Strategy Execution: Align product management, field teams, and external technical partners to translate user demands into high-impact roadmaps, driving implementation from discovery through widespread client adoption
  • Technical Leadership & Excellence: Author core infrastructure components, lead rigorous architectural reviews, and elevate team capabilities through shared design paradigms, thorough documentation, and hands-on mentoring

Success Measures

3 Months Objectives:

  • Develop comprehensive mastery of system architectures, user journeys, and technical constraints while fostering key cross-functional partnerships
  • Unify stakeholders around a strategic engineering initiative, defining architectural boundaries, delivery roadmaps, and baseline operational metrics
  • Deploy a high-impact core component that validates key design paradigms and eliminates key operational friction for internal adopters

6 Months Objectives:

  • Spearhead production rollout of major shared services with defined interfaces, comprehensive telemetry, and sustainable operational framework support
  • Drive quantifiable progress in target performance indicators, including onboarding speed, integration complexity, system resilience, and mean time to resolution
  • Influence overall technical direction alongside product partners, establishing systematic cadences for architectural reviews and execution milestones

12 Months Objectives:

  • Establish foundational platform primitives powering enterprise-wide capabilities, ensuring high-availability operations and seamless upgrade paths
  • Demonstrate tangible efficiency gains across product teams by significantly lowering maintenance overhead and accelerating modernization deployment speed
  • Serve as a key technical champion, mentoring talent, elevating engineering standards, and participating actively in talent acquisition

title: Solutions Architect - French or Spanish Speaking
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for passionate technologists to join our Pre-Sales organization to ensure that our growth is grounded and guided by strong technical alignment with our platform and the needs of our customers.

MongoDB Pre-Sales Solution Architects are responsible for guiding our customers and users to design and build reliable, scalable systems using our data platform. Our team is made up of seasoned technical sales professionals, software architects, entrepreneurs, and developers who take direct responsibility for customer success, including the design of their software, deployment, and operations. We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin for our hybrid working model.

  • 5 to 8  years of related industry experience, ideally 2 years of experience in a customer facing role
  • Minimum of 2 years experience with modern scripting languages (e.g. Python, Node.js, SQL) and/or popular programming languages (e.g. C/C++, Java, C#) in a professional capacity
  • Experience implementing scalable and highly available distributed systems in the cloud and on-prem
  • Demonstrated ability to work with customers to review complex architecture of existing applications, providing guidance on how to improve by leveraging technology
  • Excellent presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to convey complex technical and business concepts in a clear and compelling manner to technology and business leadership

  • Fluency in French or Spanish Required

  • Experience developing, deploying, or supporting applications with any of the major cloud providers 
  • Experience working in a technical pre-sales capacity 
  • Experience with database programming and data models 
  • Experience in data engineering or AI/ML projects
  • Understanding of popular sales methodologies/ frameworks such as MEDDPICC/ Command of the Message

Modern Architecture Design:

  • Design Patterns and Methodologies: Embrace best practices in microservices, DevOps, cloud, and security

title: Software Engineer 3
descriptionHtml:
Enterprise Advanced is a distributed team across Europe and India that builds the software running MongoDB on any infrastructure, at global scale — from on-prem data centers to private cloud. You'll work primarily on Ops Manager and Automation, the systems that let customers deploy fault-tolerant, globally distributed MongoDB clusters in minutes. Our software manages some of the largest self-managed MongoDB deployments in the world, with production clusters running hundreds of shards and nodes under a single deployment.

The main focus of this team is to adapt our software to manage MongoDB clusters which are deployed in data centers or private cloud platforms.

You will work on the core functionality for all of our products, mainly on the Ops Manager, and Automation products.  Our team's end users are some of the largest businesses in the world, deploying massive clusters and processing huge amounts of data.

This role is based in our Gurgaon office, and can work in a hybrid fashion.

This role will report to the Senior Engineering Manager also based in our Gurgaon office.

What you’ll do

  • Design, implement, test, and release features for Ops Manager
  • Own end-to-end delivery of complex projects, from design through incremental shipping
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues surfaced in customer deployments running at scale
  • Apply engineering judgment and MongoDB's core values across planning, design, and code review

A great fit for this role will be

  • You enjoy distributed-systems problems; consistency, fault tolerance, and scale are the daily reality, not edge cases
  • People who like ambiguity and are comfortable defining their own approach with guidance, not step-by-step instruction
  • You're flexible! You're willing to take on a wide variety of responsibilities, learning as you go
  • You're a self-starter! You're comfortable organizing your own time, acting on feedback and prioritizing with guidance from senior members of your team

Requirements

  • 4+ years experience with a language such as Java or GO.
  • Experience building multi-threaded, asynchronous, distributed systems
  • Good knowledge of Computer Science fundamentals (data structures and algorithms)
  • Good understanding of Object Orientation concepts
  • Ability to think conceptually and design modular, complex systems

Nice to have

  • Familiarity running services on Cloud Infrastructure (Amazon AWS, Google Cloud Platform, Microsoft Azure), using containers and/or container orchestration platforms (Docker, Kubernetes, Openshift)
  • Experience working directly with production systems
  • Experience with multiple programming languages
  • Experience with the MongoDB Server (specialized, in-depth training will be provided upon joining)
  • Experience or interest in full-stack web application development

What is in it for you

  • Generous compensation package (top-range salary, equity, comprehensive benefits)
  • Hybrid working model (3 days in office, 2 days working from home) 
  • Opportunities to learn on the job (time to upskill in new technologies)
  • Team budget for attending industry-specific conferences and training
  • High level of independence in your day to day work
  • Engineers in our team have the chance to work with multiple programming languages (JAVA, Javascript/React, Golang, Python)
  • You'll be joining a good-humored supportive team that works well together!
