title: Senior Compensation Manager, Sales
descriptionHtml:
The Compensation team serves as a strategic advisor to business leaders, managers, and employees across MDB. We use data and insights to drive value and build the tools, models, and frameworks that support sound compensation decisions. This role sits within Compensation and partners closely with the Sales organization —and with Recruiting, Finance, Sales Operations, Legal, and HR.

The Difference You Will Make

We are looking for a Senior Compensation Partner to serve as the dedicated compensation partner for the Sales organization. This role will support VP and Director-level leaders, and their HRBP partners as the primary day-to-day compensation resource.

The ideal candidate will be a trusted business partner and builder of compensation programs, tools, and frameworks. They will bring deep experience supporting Sales organizations, a strong understanding of incentive plans, and the ability to partner effectively with Sales Operations and other teams that design them. This person must be comfortable operating autonomously, influencing senior stakeholders, and navigating a fast-moving environment.

A Typical Day

  • Serve as the dedicated compensation partner for the Sales organization, supporting leaders and People Partners across Sales
  • Provide data-informed guidance on new-hire offers, internal equity, leveling, promotions, retention actions, and out-of-cycle requests
  • Build a strong understanding of Sales incentive plans and partner with the teams that design them to assess effectiveness and support informed compensation decisions
  • Own Sales compensation-cycle execution end-to-end, including market benchmarking, budget modeling, manager enablement, and leadership rollups
  • Lead competitive intelligence for Sales roles, researching compensation trends, pay practices, incentive structures, and talent movement in the evolving technology and AI landscape
  • Supplement survey data with recruiting signals, offer data, sales talent trends, and other real-time market sources
  • Partner with Recruiting and People Partners on market insights and competitive positioning for hires at all levels
  • Analyze compensation programs using data, business results, and stakeholder feedback; recommend improvements that support growth, retention, and pay-for-performance principles
  • Lead strategic projects such as incentive-plan governance, job architecture, or compensation-planning tool implementation
  • Develop manager enablement materials and training on compensation philosophy and decision-making

Your Expertise

  • 10+ years of compensation experience, including significant experience as a compensation business partner
  • Proven track record supporting Sales, with end-to-end ownership of cyclical compensation programs
  • Experience supporting the implementation, administration, and communication of Sales incentive plans, with a strong understanding of how they operate
  • Strong understanding of Sales compensation concepts, including quota and goal setting, pay mix, crediting, accelerators, thresholds, caps, guarantees, and plan governance
  • Experience partnering with Finance and Sales Operations on incentive-plan modeling, budgeting, forecasting, attainment analysis, and reporting
  • Strong knowledge of third-party survey methodologies, such as Radford and WTW, and the ability to build and validate pay structures across geographies and functions
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and executive-presenting skills
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives in ambiguous, fast-moving environments

Preferred Experience and Skills

  • Experience in both compensation business partner and program roles
  • Experience supporting a high-growth technology company, preferably in a global Sales environment
  • Experience with compensation-planning, incentive-compensation, and analytics tools
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build relationships across distributed teams
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to prioritize multiple projects with strong follow-through
  • Comfortable operating at both the tactical and strategic levels and creating structure in ambiguous environments
  • Experience working remotely and/or internationally with global teams
  • Strong business acumen and awareness of business, technology, and market trends

title: 2027 - Software Engineering Intern, AMER
descriptionHtml:
We’re seeking curious minds like yours to collaborate with full-time engineers and cross functional teammates, learn development standard methodologies, and gain practical software engineering experience. 

Software engineering interns are fully integrated into software engineering teams across our Product and Technology organization. Interns spend their summer pushing production-level code to make lasting contributions across MongoDB’s products and services for our internal teams, external customers, and developer end users.

This is a 12-week internship starting in May or June 2027.

What we are looking for in you (qualifications)

  • In the process of receiving a Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
  • Have a foundation in computer science theory, with proficiencies in data structures, algorithms, and software design.
  • Fluent in any one of the following programming languages: Java, Python, Go, C++, Javascript, Node.js - or a comparable object-oriented programming language.
  • Have a minimum of one quarter/semester remaining in university studies after the internship concludes. Graduation date in Fall 2027, Spring 2028, Summer 2028, Fall 2028, Spring 2029 or Summer 2029.
  • Must be authorized to work in the United States. 

What you'll find at MongoDB

  • Authentic Culture: A workplace where you are encouraged to bring your whole self to work, we believe that Embracing the Power of Differences is the best way to broaden our own perspectives and foster innovation.
  • Personalized Mentorship: Pair up with an engineering Mentor, a Program Advisor from the Early Talent Recruitment Team, and an Employee Resource Group (ERG) Guide to foster your growth.
  • Career Coaching Sessions: Access to a tailored training program designed uniquely for interns’ personal and professional development.
  • Work-Life Harmony: Embrace "Bloom for Interns" with access to mental and physical health benefits, paid time off, free lunch, and more!
  • Impactful Projects: Contribute to projects where you can Make it Matter - your meaningful work will see the light of day.
  • Exclusive Networking: Attend "Speaker Series" and "Get to Knows" to connect with our executives and departmental leaders.

MongoDB internships are full-time (40 hours/week) for 12 consecutive weeks beginning in May or June and ending in August or September. All interns are considered hybrid employees, designated the "in office" working model and are expected to be in their office location 3-5 days a week.

title: Senior Solutions Architect
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for passionate technologists to join our Pre-Sales organization to ensure that our growth is grounded and guided by strong technical alignment with our platform and the needs of our customers.

MongoDB Pre-Sales Solution Architects are responsible for guiding our customers and users to design and build reliable, scalable systems using our data platform. Our team is made up of seasoned technical sales professionals, software architects, entrepreneurs, and developers who take direct responsibility for customer success, including the design of their software, deployment, and operations. You'll work closely with our sales executives, helping customers solve business problems by leveraging our solutions, playing a key role in winning deals and driving the business forward. You'll be a trusted advisor to a wide range of users from startups to the world's largest enterprise IT organizations. 

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Madrid for our hybrid working model.

As an ideal candidate, you will have:

  • Ideally 8 to 11 years of related experience in a customer facing role, with 5 to 7 years of experience in pre-sales with enterprise software
  • Minimum of 3 years experience with modern scripting languages (e.g. Python, Node.js, SQL) and/or popular programming languages (e.g. C/C++, Java, C#) in a professional capacity
  • Experience designing with scalable and highly available distributed systems in the cloud and on-prem
  • Demonstrated ability to work with customers to review complex architecture of existing applications, providing guidance on how to improve by leveraging technology
  • Excellent presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to convey complex technical and business concepts in a clear and compelling manner to technology and business leadership
  • Ability to strategize with sales teams and provide recommendations on how to drive a multi-threaded account strategy, aligning other MongoDB and ecosystem resources to move towards a mutually beneficial account plan
  • The ability to travel up to 25%
  • A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience

You may also have:

  • Experience selling databases and/or deploying applications with any of the major cloud providers 
  • Experience with database programming and data models 
  • Experience in data engineering or AI/ML projects
  • Experience in transforming legacy systems and platforms into modern, scalable, and efficient technology stacks
  • Understanding of popular sales methodologies/ frameworks such as MEDDPICC/ Command of the Message
  • A MongoDB Certification
  • A Cloud Provider Certification

What you do at MongoDB:

In this role, you will work on complex opportunities where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of various factors. You will:

  • Design and Architect: Design scalable and performant applications, systems and infrastructure for large software projects leveraging MongoDB
  • Customer Advising and Value Articulation: Guide customers on architecture patterns and optimisation strategies for MongoDB, while clearly communicating its business value to the relevant stakeholders
  • Sales Partnership: Collaborate with the sales team to drive account success through account planning, opportunity prioritization/qualification and pipeline generation strategy, while taking ownership of the technical aspects (including but not limited to technical discovery, demos, proof of value, presentations, sizing and documentation)
  • Demand Generation: Proactively generate demand within the sales territory through self-driven technical initiatives, participation in events such as industry trade shows and account-based marketing events
  • Customer Success: Foster strong customer relationships, build champions and ensure customer success and satisfaction
  • Innovation and Improvement: Continuously seek opportunities to innovate and improve MongoDB solutions and processes (e.g. by relaying field feedback to the product team), as well as proactively mentor other Solutions Consulting team members 
  • Personal Training and Development: Engage in ongoing training and professional development to stay abreast of MongoDB product suite as well as industry trends

What you will learn:

MongoDB Product Suite Mastery:

  • Core Database Server: Master the fundamentals and advanced features of MongoDB's core database
  • Atlas and Advanced Services: Gain expertise in Atlas (fully managed cloud database service), Atlas Stream Processing, Atlas Data Lake, Atlas Full-Text Search, Atlas Vector Search, and Charts
  • Relational Migrator: Learn to migrate from relational databases seamlessly

Market-Relevant Technologies:

  • Hyperscaler Ecosystem: Gain expertise in designing complex systems utilizing cloud services on hyperscaler platforms
  • Complementary Technologies: Enhance your skills with partner and complementary technologies such as Apache Kafka and Kubernetes

Modern Architecture Design:

  • Design Patterns and Methodologies: Embrace best practices in microservices, DevOps, cloud, and security
  • Cutting Edge RAG and AI Architectures: Help customers on their generative AI journeys and working with industry leading partners in the space

Sales Techniques and Soft Skills:

  • Effective Communication: Master presentations, demonstrations, and whiteboarding
  • Client Interaction: Develop strategies for discovery and objection handling

Industry Insights:

  • Diverse Market Verticals: Gain exposure to a broad spectrum of interesting use cases across various industries

title: Senior Partner Solutions Architect
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Senior Partner Solutions Architect to lead technical engagement with independent software vendors (ISVs) and strategic technology partners. You will help partners build, embed, deploy, validate, and go to market with MongoDB-based solutions that create repeatable customer value and accelerate MongoDB adoption.

This role combines enterprise architecture, partner engineering, technical pre-sales, solution assurance, and go-to-market enablement. You will work across the complete partner lifecycle—from opportunity discovery and business-value alignment through architecture, validation, design wins, launch readiness, and post-launch reuse.

You will be successful in this role if you can move fluidly between a partner’s product architecture, a customer’s business problem, MongoDB’s technical capabilities, and the field motion needed to scale the outcome.

We're looking to speak with candidates based in Mexico City for our hybrid working model.

What you will do

  • Serve as the senior technical advisor for strategic ISV and technology-partner engagements, including embedded software, SaaS, BYOA/BYO-EA, AI, and agent products
  • Lead technical discovery and architecture reviews that clarify the partner’s workload, adoption path, deployment model, customer segment, success criteria, and MongoDB value proposition
  • Guide partners through a repeatable technical validation and solution-assurance process covering architecture, deployment, security, compliance, performance, scale, resilience, operability, upgrades, support ownership, and lifecycle management
  • Establish evidence-based readiness gates and partner maturity assessments; distinguish clearly between tested, supported, recommended, and go-to-market-approved claims
  • Design reference architectures, integration patterns, sizing guidance, deployment blueprints, quickstarts, demos, troubleshooting guidance, and partner-facing documentation
  • Help partners build MongoDB into shipped products, SaaS platforms, AI applications, agent systems, and customer-managed environments while defining clear ownership boundaries and support handoffs
  • Support MongoDB design wins and technical co-sell motions by partnering with ISV Sales, Partner Sales, field Solution Architects, Product, Marketing, Professional Services, Technical Services, and Partner Programs
  • Create technical “better together” messaging and field-ready enablement that equips partner sellers, MongoDB sellers, and customer-facing architects to position joint solutions consistently
  • Deliver technical workshops, webinars, executive briefings, partner enablement, and customer-facing presentations that turn validated architecture into pipeline and adoption
  • Build scalable operating mechanisms for ISV onboarding, intake, partner classification, evidence collection, gap remediation, conflict management, approval workflows, and post-launch re-assurance
  • Turn individual engagements into reusable assets and operating patterns that improve time to value, partner self-service, field readiness, technical quality, and customer success

What you will learn and work with

title: Technical Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
MongoDB Technical Account Managers are at the forefront of technical problem solving with key customers, working on some of the most complex and exciting application ecosystems built on the MongoDB platform. TAMs combine:

  • Deep product knowledge and expertise across multiple domains 
  • Polished technical communications
  • Strong account leadership, with the ability to engage effectively at all levels of the customer
  • Ability to not only proactively engage, but anticipate and preempt needs a customer may have or issues they could experience
  • A high degree of ownership and willingness to go above and beyond for our customers

The TAM’s primary remit is the cultivation of customer confidence and delivery of positive, account-wide technical outcomes that solve big customer problems while showcasing the capabilities of the MongoDB product portfolio. They do this through a systematic engagement process including deep discovery and the development of a roadmap of shared objectives. They are able to operate in complex environments where there may be shared or even ambiguous responsibilities between the customer and MongoDB. The TAM is able to shift gears between enabling, coaching and mentoring, and marshaling resources to get the right things done at the right time.

The TAM also acts as the eyes and ears of the product team while working with marquee customers as they will sometimes surface new requirements or potential areas of opportunity for future development. They work closely with these teams to understand these requirements, manage expectations, and ensure MongoDB is staying one step ahead of customer needs.

This role will be an early hire into the new Technical Account Management function and will help pioneer the new service offering for MongoDB.

Successful candidates will have the flexibility to work around the schedules of customers with 100% uptime systems while enjoying the life/work balance MongoDB promotes.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Bengaluru for our hybrid working model.

Why MongoDB is a fantastic place to work and build your career

  • Be a part of the company that’s reinventing the database, focused on innovation and speed
  • Enjoy a fun, inspiring culture that is engineering focused
  • Work with exceptionally skilled people around the globe
  • Learn, contribute, and make a positive impact on the product and community

Cool things you’ll do

MongoDB is on a mission to unlock the inner genius of our customers by making data stunningly easy to work with. Along the way, our customers encounter questions and issues about how our approach to databases works for their use case. In Technical Services, it's our job to help our customers succeed with MongoDB

As a Technical Account Manager, you’ll be highly engaged with a handful of our largest customers, building key relationships with technical leaders and collaborating with them on their projects to build and scale MongoDB solutions - resolving questions and demonstrating solutions related to architecture, performance, recovery, security, and everything in between

You'll be an expert resource on the best way to run MongoDB at scale, whatever that scale may be. You will identify deep dive opportunities to educate our customers on crucial topics of concern to them and either conduct those deep dives yourself or make timely connections between customers and subject matter experts within MongoDB

You will also mentor and ramp new team members, and take initiatives in building knowledge of new product lines within the MongoDB ecosystem

What you need

You should have 7+ years of relevant experience. We consider all candidates, with an eye for those who combine formal education with self-teaching, are insatiably curious, and are multi-faceted

It’s crucial for every candidate to check these boxes:

  • Communicator:
    • Foster open lines of communication amongst internal stakeholders; The TAM ensures all concerned parties, including in some cases the MongoDB executive team, are well informed about accounts within the TAM’s portfolio (especially during critical or escalated situations)
    • Great communication and account leadership skills of external stakeholders, with a good organizational understanding of customers and ability to calibrate communication style based on the audience
    • The TAM must quickly understand and communicate about customer workloads, use cases, and resiliency criteria, including performance, availability, and scalability
  • Collaborator
    • Ability to work independently as well as cross-functionally to ensure customer needs are being met
    • Genuine desire to help people, and to increase their confidence and good will
    • Ability to cultivate strong team partnerships: Understanding of when and how to seek help from team members, skill in choosing from potentially conflicting perspectives or approaches; ability to secure commitments and lead collaborative efforts
  • Problem Solver:
    • Comfort thinking on your feet, solving problems in real-time, and reducing pressure and anxiety through calm, authoritative technical leadership; ability to keep your cool and project command presence during escalated situations where tensions and anxiety may be high
    • Ability to design, communicate, and follow a structured approach to solving complex problems based loosely upon the scientific method
    • Experience analyzing and pursuing issues holistically in the enterprise; spanning multiple technologies, customer teams and silos
  • Technical Expert
    • Experience building, maintaining, tuning, and troubleshooting sophisticated mission-critical production database systems
    • Familiarity with modern service architectures  and the implications on development teams, their structures and the development lifecycle
    • Experience with the technologies and development patterns typical of a large-scale enterprise customer
    • Experience using any cloud services stack such as AWS, Azure or GCP
  • Builder
    • Develop, document, and help implement techniques, tools and procedures for optimizing MongoDB’s technical relationship with marquee customers
  • Product evangelism
    • The TAM helps customers understand how the MongoDB developer data platform is well-suited to solve a wide variety of their problems

Bonus Points

  • Experience managing large scale databases (e.g. RDBMS, NoSQL)
  • Extensive experience with mass scale application architectures
    • Microservices/Serverless architectures
    • CI/CD tools and approaches
    • Containerization, orchestration and management tools
    • Enterprise Identity platforms
  • Experience using or managing MongoDB
  • Experience using distributed version control systems, and in particular git
  • Strong systems engineering and troubleshooting experience, including Linux performance, memory management, I/O tuning, configuration, security, networking, virtualization, clustering

Success Measures

  • In 3 months, you will have gained a deep understanding of MongoDB and its ecosystem. You will complete New Hire Training
  • In 6 months, you will be confident working frontline with our customers. You will also complete the MongoDB Certified DBA Associate exam
  • In 12 months, you will be directly and independently engaged in technical account management, ensuring customers are successful and happy with MongoDB and see our developer data platform as the de facto standard for new projects

title: Senior Project Manager - Professional Services
descriptionHtml:
About the Team

MongoDB Professional Services serves as the delivery owner for complex customer initiatives, translating strategic goals into disciplined execution and measurable business outcomes across modernization, migration, cloud, data, and AI-related programs. The team drives delivery accountability across customers and internal stakeholders through strong governance, proactive risk management, and sustained alignment to customer priorities.  

About the Role

MongoDB is looking for a Senior Project Manager to lead complex customer-facing Professional Services engagements and serve as the accountable delivery owner for customer requirements, execution, and business outcomes. The role translates  customer objectives into a clear delivery strategy, aligns  execution to expected outcomes, and drives alignment across scope, schedule, risk, dependencies, stakeholder actions, governance, and success measures.

The person acts as a consultative partner to the customer’s business.   helping shape priorities, tradeoffs, and decisions while keeping delivery focused on value realization. They must bring strong services delivery leadership, executive communication skills, and the ability to operate effectively in technically complex environments with sound judgement. 

The role partners closely with Consulting Engineers, Customer Success, Sales, and customer stakeholders to maintain momentum, align resources, and deliver measurable value. title: Senior Software Engineer, Cluster Scalability
descriptionHtml:
Join Cluster Scalability, one of MongoDB's Online Transaction Processing teams, and help build the core infrastructure that makes MongoDB a world-class distributed database. The team builds the infrastructure and tools that let customers scale their workloads past what a single node can handle. We take pride in building clean abstractions over hard distributed systems problems, so users can focus on their data instead of worrying about where it lives or how it's accessed. Our work has a big impact: it solves the hardest data challenges faced by MongoDB's largest customers.

As a Senior Software Engineer on Cluster Scalability, you'll work on data partitioning, one of the hardest and most impactful problem areas at MongoDB today. You'll collaboratively design and build the distributed machinery that turns independent query-processing and storage nodes into a single, unified database system. Your team’s work will be to build the data-movement and dynamic-scaling features that run on top of it. Current work includes seamless horizontal scaling with minimal tradeoffs, better cluster elasticity and smarter workload execution. You'll solve complex performance problems and design protocols for moving and placing data without disruption. Your work will help the architecture scale reliably to meet customer demand at any volume.

Our team champions a strong culture of inclusivity, diversity, and collaboration. If you want to work on a collaborative team that applies distributed systems fundamentals to deliver core features of a popular database, join us! Let’s change what’s possible for application developers, system architects, and database operators.

This role can be based remotely in the United States.

Candidate Profile

  • 5+ years of experience building distributed systems
  • Experience with building production-level code with a large user base, robust design structure and rigorous code quality, written in C++.
  • Degree in Computer Science or similar field, or equivalent practical experience, with strong competencies in data structures, algorithms, and software design/architecture
  • Passion for the theory and practice of system design for large-scale distributed systems, as well as hands-on or academic experience in the domain
  • Understands modern computer architecture and internals to the degree that they can reason about how specific design choices plays out in a system like MongoDB
  • Has demonstrated industry success or academic research in areas such as:
    • High performance / low latency networking
    • Performance tuning
    • Distributed systems
    • System observability
    • System resiliency

Success Measures

  • In your first month, you’ll understand the high-level architecture of MongoDB, dive into the details of your team’s components, and resolve a few bugs
  • In the first three months, you’ll contribute to the development of a project slated for the next release of MongoDB, take on code review responsibilities, and participate in design reviews for new features
  • In the first six months, you’ll lead the development of a new feature and help mentor new engineers on the team

title: Software Engineer 3 - Enterprise Architecture
descriptionHtml:
MongoDB seeks an experienced Software Engineer to join Enterprise Architecture on a focused team dedicated to AI experimentation. You'll partner with teams across the organization, including Internal Engineering, to explore, prototype, and validate emerging AI capabilities before they become formal roadmap priorities.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.

Our ideal candidate:

  • Has 2-5 years of professional software engineering experience
  • Deep experience with at least one modern programming language (Python, Typescript, Go, Rust, etc.)
  • Strong technical judgment and the ability to independently solve complex engineering problems
  • Excellent communication skills and comfort collaborating across teams and disciplines
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity, scoping and running experiments when the right approach isn't known yet
  • Hands-on experience prototyping with LLMs or agentic systems (evals, fine-tuning, RAG, tool use, orchestration frameworks)
  • Has the ability to iterate fast, specially in the case where requirements are not clear
  • Keeps up with emerging AI tooling and models, not just what's already mainstream
  • Collaborative, detail-oriented, and passionate about developing usable software

Bonus Round:

  • Experience building and maintaining full-stack applications, from front-end UIs to backend API to data pipelines
  • Experience designing systems or services used by other engineers or teams
  • Knowledge of any of the following technologies: Tanstack Start, Next.js, FastAPI, React
  • Experience with model evaluation frameworks, vector databases, or agent orchestration tooling (e.g., LangGraph)
  • Familiarity with transformer architecture and model internals
  • Familiarity with containerized applications, Kubernetes, and ability to design CI/CD pipelines

Position Expectations:

  • Design and run experiments that test emerging AI capabilities against real internal use cases, before they're formally prioritized. Condense the learnings of those experiments and document them so that the knowledge can be used across the org.
  • Build lightweight prototypes to validate or kill ideas quickly
  • Stay current on new AI tooling and models, and turn relevant developments into concrete internal proof points
  • Partner with product, platform, and internal engineering teams to hand off validated capabilities once they're ready to move from experiment to production
  • Maintain technical rigor and clear documentation of findings, even for work that doesn't ship
  • Identify and communicate risks, unknowns, and open questions clearly to stakeholders

Success Measures:

  • In three months, have run and documented at least one AI capability experiment, with a clear recommendation on whether and how to pursue it further
  • In three months, demonstrate the ability to move quickly from idea to working prototype
  • In six months, have influenced the org's roadmap or tooling direction by surfacing a capability two to three steps ahead of current need, backed by evidence from your experimentation

title: Staff Engineer - Netsuite Business Systems
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a highly skilled Staff NetSuite Engineer with deep expertise in Order-to-Cash(O2C) & Record-to-Report (R2R) processes and accounting best practices. This role will serve as the technical and functional bridge between Finance and Technology, driving automation, process optimization, and scalability within our NetSuite environment.The successful candidate will lead the design, enhancement, and support of accounting systems that power our General Ledger (GL), Record-to-Report (R2R), Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), including credit card process, Tax, and Treasury operations. As a senior member of the Finance Technology team, you will design and implement solutions that streamline accounting workflows, ensure compliance, and enhance financial reporting accuracy.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in New York City, NY or Palo Alto, CA or remotely in the United States.

Key Responsibilities

System Architecture & Development

  • Lead the design, configuration, and customization of NetSuite to support R2R and accounting processes (GL, journals, allocations, consolidations, fixed assets, intercompany eliminations)
  • Architect scalable NetSuite solutions that integrate seamlessly with upstream and downstream systems (e.g., procurement, billing, expense management, data lake)
  • Develop and maintain SuiteScript, SuiteFlow, SuiteTalk (Web Services), and RESTlets to support automation and integrations

Process & Accounting Alignment

  • Partner with Finance, Accounting, and Audit teams to translate accounting policies into system-enforced controls within NetSuite
  • Act as the primary point of contact for Finance teams including Accounting, Tax, Treasury and RevOps
  • Ensure compliance with SOX, GAAP, and audit requirements through configuration of role-based security, approvals, reconciliations, and audit trails
  • Optimize financial close processes (journals, reconciliations, accruals, consolidations) to reduce close cycle time
  • Build and enhance reporting frameworks (saved searches, financial reports, dashboards) to support accurate and timely financial reporting
  • Support compliance and audit requirements through appropriate controls and documentation

Technical Leadership

  • Serve as the subject matter expert (SME) for NetSuite R2R and OTC processes, guiding engineers, administrators, and analysts
  • Serve as the primary technical advisor for business stakeholders
  • Translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions with clear documentation
  • Establish engineering best practices in NetSuite development, including coding standards, testing, version control, and deployment
  • Drive system performance, scalability, and reliability improvements
  • Mentor junior engineers and provide architectural oversight for NetSuite-related initiatives

Integration & Data Management

  • Oversee integrations with external systems (e.g., payroll, banking, consolidation tools, CRM platforms like Salesforce, Coupa, Concur)
  • Partner with Data Engineering teams to ensure accurate data flow into finance data lake/warehouse for analytics and compliance reporting
  • Support data governance, master data management (chart of accounts, dimensions, entity hierarchy) in alignment with accounting standards

Qualifications

Required

  • 10+ years of NetSuite development/engineering experience with a focus on General Ledger and accounting modules
  • Strong knowledge of OTC and R2R processes including journal entries, close cycle, reconciliations, consolidations, and intercompany accounting
  • Proficiency in SuiteScript 1.0/2.0, SuiteFlow, SuiteTalk, REST APIs, and NetSuite integration patterns
  • Demonstrated experience implementing system-enforced financial controls and supporting SOX compliance
  • Solid understanding of US GAAP and accounting workflows
  • Experience with role-based security design, segregation of duties, and audit requirements

Preferred

  • Experience with global accounting operations (multi-entity, multi-currency, consolidations)
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Familiarity with modern finance data stacks and BI/reporting tools
  • Prior experience in a high-growth, SaaS or technology company
  • Exposure to AI/automation in Finance (e.g., reconciliations, anomaly detection)

Soft Skills

  • Strong problem-solving and cross-functional collaboration abilities
  • Excellent communication skills, able to translate technical details into business terms
  • Leadership mindset with the ability to mentor and influence stakeholders
  • Detail-oriented with a commitment to accuracy and compliance

Why Join Us?

  • Impact at Scale: Play a strategic role in modernizing Finance Technology for a growing global organization
  • Innovation: Work at the intersection of Finance, Technology, and Compliance to deliver scalable impact
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with senior leaders in Finance, Procurement, and Technology to deliver systems that enable smarter decisions
  • Opportunity to lead technical strategy and influence how core accounting processes are automated and optimized

descriptionHtml:
This Sr Data Analyst will join our analytics org within the Executive Insights team, which is responsible for synthesizing revenue and operational data from across the company to measure the trajectory and overall health of the business.

title: Senior Manager, Procurement
descriptionHtml:
MongoDB is looking for a Senior Manager, Procurement (Software) to support our growing company's needs. This role requires a strategic thinker, but also someone who is prepared to “roll up their sleeves.” It also requires interaction across the organization, globally. The right candidate will be a builder with strong analytical, negotiation and communication skills.  This position will work in the Procurement Team managing procurement analyst and supporting the company in creating and implementing a category strategy for global Software. This role is based in the New York office and will be reporting to the Head of Procurement & Travel who is also based in New York. By joining the MongoDB Procurement team you will be gaining an enormous amount of experience while accelerating your career.

This role will be based remotely in the United States.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the main point of contact for global Software contracts, leading category strategic initiatives and managing a team of procurement analysts
  • Collaborate cross-functionally across the organization with stakeholders and the global Legal team to ensure vendor compliance and requirements are met
  • Develop and execute a Software Category Management strategy and roadmap aligned with company growth and technology goals
  • Own and manage a pipeline of software renewals, sourcing initiatives, and supplier engagements, ensuring proper planning and execution across the organization
  • Build a deep understanding of software spend, market trends, licensing models, and supplier landscapes to unlock cost savings and value optimization
  • Establish trusted partnerships with key stakeholders in Finance, Legal, IT, Security, and business teams to guide procurement decision-making
  • Partner with global teams across regions and time zones, including regular collaboration during Pacific Time business hours
  • Drive supplier negotiations, vendor performance management, and sourcing activities to secure optimal commercial outcomes
  • Ensure all deals within your scope comply fully with the company purchasing policy

So, what does success look like?

The Senior Manager  will be successful in this role when they can start executing the following strategic tasks and responsibilities after their first quarter with the company:

  • Deliver superior and consistent project management skills for multi country, cross functional team projects
  • Work closely with global stakeholders on pre renewal strategy, RFP distribution, contract negotiations, and post renewal analysis
  • Develop a trusted advisor relationship with key business partners and internal stakeholders through effective communication, strategic guidance, and high quality execution
  • Build and maintain a forward looking software renewal and sourcing pipeline with clear visibility into risks, opportunities, and upcoming business needs
  • Develop actionable category strategies based on spend analysis, supplier insights, and business priorities
  • Identify and deliver measurable cost savings, cost avoidance, and value optimization opportunities across the software portfolio
  • Contribute to the development of new tools, processes, and approaches that support global expansion and operational scale
  • Develop an understanding of the legal framework for contract execution and supplier risk management
  • Lead and grow the team with career planning, mentorship, and professional development at the forefront

About You

  • Bachelor's Degree or MBA/Master's Degree
  • 8+ years of experience within an indirect procurement team, including significant experience managing software purchasing and supplier negotiations
  • 4+ years of people management experience required
  • Experience developing category strategies and managing complex software supplier relationships
  • Ability to analyze spend data, draw conclusions, and develop actionable recommendations
  • Strong organizational and project management skills
  • Legal contract experience
  • Demonstrated ability to build strong stakeholder relationships and influence decision making across multiple business functions
  • Highly articulate with excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to work effectively with global teams and stakeholders across multiple time zones, including Pacific Time business hours
  • Think creatively, are highly driven, and are skilled at creating structure in situations that are uncertain or ambiguous within a rapidly growing business
  • Demonstrated ability to roll up your sleeves and work alongside team members, driving projects through to completion

title: VP & GM, Public Sector
descriptionHtml:
MongoDB is seeking an executive public-sector leader to build the next phase of growth across Federal civilian and Defense. As General Manager, you’ll have significant autonomy to shape a more self-sufficient business by integrating Clarity’s federal engineering and modernization capabilities with MongoDB’s product and go-to-market teams, expanding our position in Defense, and establishing the partnerships, authorization strategy, talent, and operating discipline needed for sustained growth.

MongoDB acquired Clarity Business Solutions to accelerate the modernization of government applications. Clarity is a federal-focused software and systems engineering firm with expertise in data analytics, data processing, and data flow. Its team combines technical delivery capabilities with experience navigating federal missions, procurement, and security requirements. You will shape how Clarity’s people and capabilities work alongside MongoDB by aligning strategy, customer engagement, delivery, and operating practices while preserving the specialized expertise federal customers rely on.

MongoDB Atlas for Government’s pursuit of FedRAMP Certified – Class D (formerly known as FedRAMP High) expands MongoDB’s ability to support high-impact government workloads, secure AI, and mission-critical modernization across cloud environments. This is an opportunity to build on customer trust and strong executive commitment, address significant unmet demand across government, and shape a business with the ambition and resources to become a meaningful growth engine for MongoDB.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Washington DC for our hybrid working model.

What you will do

  • Own the public-sector P&L, strategy, operating plan, and execution, with accountability for revenue, expenses, investment decisions, forecast quality, and overall performance; Establish executive-grade forecasting, pipeline inspection, P&L reviews, account and partner planning, talent reviews, and cross-functional decision mechanisms that strengthen predictability and scalable execution
  • Lead and develop the Regional Directors and their sales teams, together with dedicated Finance, Sales Operations, Product, Solutions Architecture, and Customer Success resources; Set shared goals, clarify decision rights, and establish effective interfaces with MongoDB’s broader functional organizations
  • Build an increasingly autonomous, high-performing public-sector entity by setting its governance, resource priorities, operating cadence, and talent systems, while applying MongoDB’s company-wide processes and the practices needed to serve government customers; Make timely decisions with substantial autonomy, create clarity as the organization evolves, and balance near-term results with long-term scale
  • Integrate Clarity’s people and federal services capabilities into the public-sector business; Align strategy, leadership, accountability, customer engagement, delivery, and partner motions; clarify how Clarity works with MongoDB’s sales, Product, Solutions Architecture, Customer Success, and Security teams; and shape the organization’s reporting model and long-term end state
  • Grow strategic Federal civilian relationships and expand MongoDB’s position in Defense by building trust with Department of Defense and other mission stakeholders, converting existing product usage into strategic customer relationships, and developing repeatable paths to new opportunities
  • Build and scale a partner ecosystem, with a strong emphasis on systems integrators alongside resellers and other strategic partners; Create joint customer and delivery motions that extend MongoDB’s reach and support mission-relevant outcomes
  • Translate Atlas for Government’s pursuit of FedRAMP Certified – Class D status (formerly known as FedRAMP High) into a clear, accurate field and customer strategy; Partner with Product, Security, Legal, Clarity, and cloud providers to address customer authorization and secure-delivery requirements without overpromising product readiness or certifications; represent MongoDB with agency executives, partners, and company leadership, and bring field insight into product and investment decisions.

What we are looking for

  • 8+ years of public-sector leadership across Federal civilian and Defense customers at modern software, cloud, data, cybersecurity, or technology platform companies
  • Demonstrated experience owning and managing a public-sector P&L, with accountability for revenue, expenses, growth, and investment decisions. Success leading multi-layer sales organizations and delivering strong forecasting, talent, and customer outcomes
  • Demonstrated ability to build partner ecosystems including systems integrators, resellers, and alliances along with Integrating services or consulting capabilities into a product-led commercial model
  • Strong executive presence and judgment to navigate complex agency ecosystems, engage internal and external leaders, and operate effectively while organizational structures evolve
  • Bias for action and resilience to make difficult decisions without perfect information while maintaining a customer-first mindset
  • Exceptional people leadership skills, including recruiting, coaching, succession planning, and driving high performance with integrity and trust
  • Active security clearance is required, along with experience in highly regulated public-sector markets

title: Senior Manager, AI and People Transformation
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a Senior Manager, AI & People Transformation to sit at the intersection of HR strategy, workflow architecture, and emerging AI technologies. In this high-impact, cross-functional role, you will challenge legacy HR practices, rapidly prototype low-code and AI-driven solutions, and evaluate build-vs-buy decisions in close partnership with IT. As a bridge between People leadership and technical execution, you will establish repeatable automation frameworks, solve complex operational bottlenecks, and unlock strategic capacity across the enterprise.

The ideal candidate will be passionate about transforming HR operations and defining scalable, next-generation workforce capabilities, this is an opportunity to shape the future of work in a high-growth environment.

This role can be based out of our New York City office (hybrid working model) or remotely in the United States (Eastern or Central time zones).

Key Responsibilities

  • Translating senior strategy into clear goals and operating rhythms, leading high-impact People transformation and AI initiatives to simplify work, improve experiences, and create scalable capacity
  • Designing and leading end-to-end workflow transformations that challenge existing processes and integrate AI, automation, self-service, and enterprise systems to fundamentally scale how work gets done
  • Translating complex business challenges into clear future-state workflows, technical requirements, experiments, and cross-departmental implementation plans
  • Rapidly prototyping and testing solutions using AI and low/no-code platforms to establish best practices, validate concepts, and set technical standards
  • Partnering with senior People Team leaders and functional experts to align resources, set priorities, and move high-value opportunities from concept through division-wide implementation
  • Partnering closely with IT leadership to translate business needs into technical requirements, inform cross-functional systems design, and advise leaders on critical build-vs-buy trade-offs
  • Designing reusable, cross-departmental capabilities across People workflows to improve quality, performance, and scale rather than building disconnected point solutions
  • Establishing key metrics to track the operational impact of transformation, including process performance, capacity created, cross-functional adoption, and elevated employee/manager experience
  • Developing practical frameworks, standards, and toolkits that empower cross-functional teams to identify, test, and apply AI and transformation capabilities

The right candidate for this role will have

  • 10+ years of professional experience, with 8+ years of progressive leadership specifically across transformation, operations, strategy or consulting, ideally within People/HR or a high-growth technology environment
  • Experience in consulting, program management, product management, or a similar cross-functional role, bridging business and technical teams to shape roadmaps, navigate trade-offs, and drive solutions from discovery through adoption
  • Strong understanding of AI and automation and the ability to translate emerging capabilities into practical business solutions
  • A builder mindset, with experience prototyping, experimenting, and rapidly testing new approaches to drive organizational change
  • Strong systems thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to resolve complex, ambiguous cross-functional problems and scale performance across the Business Unit
  • Proven ability to influence senior executives, align cross-functional teams around a shared vision, and hold stakeholders accountable for outcomes without direct authority
  • Experience influencing senior stakeholders and bringing teams together around a common future state.Strong judgment and comfort moving between strategic thinking and hands-on execution

What success looks like

You will help the People Team move beyond using AI primarily for individual productivity toward redesigning core operating models and driving high-impact organizational leverage.

Success means delivering scalable, cross-functional solutions that eliminate manual handoffs, expand self-service, set clear operational standards, and unlock strategic capacity for the Business Unit.

Over time, your work will establish a standardized, repeatable framework for evaluating, executing, and scaling new ways of working across the enterprise.

descriptionHtml:

They own the technical strategy across complex opportunities—from discovery and qualification through architecture, proof of value, executive alignment, and successful adoption—and connect technical decisions to measurable business outcomes.

. We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Singapore for our hybrid working model.

title: Manager, Workplace
descriptionHtml:
MongoDB is seeking a proactive, hands-on Workplace Manager to lead the day-to-day operations of our San Francisco office while overseeing the employee experience and operational performance of our North America portfolio of satellite (a.k.a. “spoke”) offices. 

This is an operations-first role for someone who takes pride in making workplaces safe, welcoming, functional, and consistently well run. You will be the visible, service-minded point of contact for employees, visitors, vendors, and local leaders; responding to requests, coordinating workplace services, maintaining accurate records, and following issues through to resolution.

Alongside daily operations, you will help cultivate a connected hybrid workplace in our San Francisco office and our Spoke Offices through thoughtful events, local communications, and culture-building initiatives. The ideal candidate is organized, resourceful, comfortable working across multiple locations, and energized by the combination of hospitality, facilities coordination, vendor management, budget management, event execution, and employee engagement.

What you’ll do

Own day-to-day workplace operations in San Francisco Hub Office

  • Serve as the primary point of contact and escalation path for workplace matters across assigned spoke offices and/or the designated hub office
  • Maintain a safe, clean, professional, organized, and welcoming workplace environment for employees and visitors
  • Conduct regular office walkthroughs to identify maintenance, facilities, hospitality, safety, presentation, and space issues; coordinate corrective actions and confirm completion
  • Respond to, track, and resolve employee and stakeholder requests through workplace support channels and systems with urgency, clear communication, and strong follow-through
  • Coordinate front-of-house and visitor experiences, greeting employees, guests, candidates, and vendors with a warm, hospitality-first mindset

  • Monitor office supplies, amenities, equipment, and shared spaces; coordinate replenishment, repairs, and replacements
  • Maintain accurate workplace records and systems, including provider or membership databases, occupancy/utilization information, service logs, and operational documentation
  • Partner with Physical Security on access control, visitor procedures, incident follow-up, and other security requirements
  • Coordinate with IT/AV and other service partners to help ensure meeting rooms, workplace technology, and office equipment are working properly
  • Communicate workplace updates, service changes, expectations, and important office information clearly and consistently

Own Spoke Office operations and engagement across America

  • Oversee the day-to-day operations of our Spoke Offices across the Americas, serving as the primary Workplace point of contact for each location
  • Actively support the development of a positive, inclusive culture across Spoke Offices, ensuring local experiences align with MongoDB’s company values
  • Partner with Local Spoke Ambassadors to build strong office communities and deliver initiatives that foster connection and engagement
  • Manage office memberships, including activating, deactivating, and updating memberships, and maintain accurate provider records
  • Oversee ad hoc facilities operations, including janitorial services, conference-room coordination, event bookings, maintenance requests, and other office needs
  • Monitor and manage the budget allocated to each office location, partnering with Workplace leadership and Finance to support a consistent rhythm of events to ensure budgets are utilized effectively and completely
  • Audit and maintain the integrity of workplace databases and systems, including memberships, access, and utilization platforms
  • Support required utilization data entry and provide regular utilization and operational reports to keep Local Spoke Ambassadors and Workplace leadership informed
  • Proactively share workplace developments, service updates, risks, and recommendations with local stakeholders and employees

What you bring

  • 5+ years of experience in workplace operations, office coordination, facilities, hospitality, events, employee experience, or a related field; 5+ years preferred for broader multi-location or specialist-level scope
  • Demonstrated experience managing day-to-day office or workplace operations, ideally across multiple locations or in a remote-management model
  • Strong event planning and execution experience, including vendor coordination, logistics, communications, and onsite delivery.
  • Experience managing vendors, service providers, budgets, purchase orders, invoices, or other administrative workflows
  • Project management experience and the ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders, deadlines, and competing priorities
  • Excellent organization, attention to detail, judgment, responsiveness, and follow-through
  • A proactive, flexible, hands-on approach and the ability to work effectively in a fast-moving environment where priorities can change
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with confidence working with employees, vendors, local leaders, and cross-functional partners
  • A warm, customer-obsessed, service-oriented mindset and strong emotional intelligence

title: Senior Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
MongoDB is seeking an exceptional Product Manager to own disaster recovery and business continuity for the world's leading developer data platform.

In this role, you will own the product vision, requirements, and execution plan for Standby Clusters, MongoDB's disaster recovery offering for both Atlas and Enterprise Advanced. Standby Clusters continuously replicates a production cluster to an isolated standby in a separate region, datacenter, or cloud provider, delivering sub-minute recovery time and near-zero data loss. You will work closely with engineering, customers in regulated industries, and the field to take the product from preview to GA and beyond, and to shape MongoDB's broader strategy for replication, recovery, and resilience.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin for our hybrid working model.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute the product strategy and roadmap for Standby Clusters across Atlas and Enterprise Advanced, from public preview through GA and the post-GA feature set (planned failover and reverse sync, cross-cloud and multi-region topologies, scaling while linked, backup integration)
  • Own the recovery objectives and the tradeoffs behind them: define and defend RTO and RPO targets, replication lag semantics, consistency guarantees across sharded clusters, and the behavior of failover, switchover, and failback
  • Drive the product's position within MongoDB's resilience portfolio: when a customer should choose Standby Clusters versus multi-region clusters, backups and point-in-time restore, or Atlas Stream Processing, and how these offerings fit together
  • Partner with customers in financial services, healthcare, and other regulated industries to translate compliance requirements (such as DORA and isolated-recovery-environment mandates) into product requirements, and run DR gamedays and design-partner programs with them
  • Define the operator experience across the Atlas UI, Atlas Administration API, Ops Manager, CLI, and Terraform, including monitoring, alerting on replication lag and standby health, and the "break glass" path when the active region is unreachable
  • Shape pricing and packaging for standby capacity and the associated storage and data transfer
  • Collaborate with engineering on architecture decisions that affect customer-visible behavior, including replication through object storage, cluster-wide consistent timestamps, and dependencies on the Atlas control plane
  • Gather and analyze usage data, failover outcomes, and customer feedback to drive improvements, and own the success metrics for adoption, standby creation time, and time-to-recovery
  • Work with marketing, sales, and customer success on go-to-market, enablement, and launch readiness
  • Stay current on disaster recovery, replication, and high-availability approaches across the database industry and cloud providers

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in product management or a deeply technical customer-facing role, focused on database systems, distributed systems, or infrastructure
  • Deep understanding of durability, availability, and performance tradeoffs in distributed systems. Hands-on experience with replication, consensus, failover, backup and restore, or disaster recovery is strongly preferred
  • Working knowledge of how production databases are operated: replica sets and sharding, consistency models, recovery objectives, maintenance and upgrade workflows, and the operational realities of regulated environments
  • Experience with MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL, or comparable database systems, and with at least one major cloud provider
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive complex technical programs with multiple engineering teams and external design partners
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to explain recovery semantics to both platform engineers and compliance officers
  • Strong technical acumen. Our Product Managers must be as technical as their engineering counterparts and have real depth of knowledge

  • Executive Presence: Exceptional communication and advisory skills, with a track record of driving consensus and advising C-suite executives and board members

title: Associate Technical Services Engineer
descriptionHtml:
MongoDB Technical Services Engineers combine technical expertise, structured problem solving, and exceptional customer service to help customers build and operate reliable MongoDB applications and deployments.

The team supports the MongoDB ecosystem—including the database server, drivers, Atlas, Cloud Manager, Compass, and related services. Engineers work directly with customers to understand complex technical challenges, identify root causes, and provide practical solutions for largescale, data intensive environments.

We are looking for highly technical, insatiably curious, and adaptable engineers who enjoy understanding how systems are designed, deployed, and operated. Success in this role requires sound judgment, clear communication, initiative, collaboration, and a genuine desire to help others.

Location and working model

This role is based in Toronto and follows a hybrid working model, with a minimum expectation of three days per week in the office.

Office location: 333 Bay St., Suite 1400, Toronto, ON M5H 2R2, Canada

Cool things you’ll do

You'll be working alongside our largest customers, solving their complex challenges - resolving questions on architecture, performance, recovery, security, and everything in between. You'll be an expert resource on best practices in running MongoDB at scale, whatever that scale may be. You'll be an advocate for customers' needs - interfacing with our product management and development teams on their behalf. And you'll contribute to internal projects, including software development of support tools for performance, benchmarking, and diagnostics.

What you need

We consider all candidates with an eye for those who are self-taught, insatiably curious, and multi-faceted.

The ideal candidates should have strong technical experience in one (or more) of the following areas

  • Systems administration
  • Distributed systems
  • Network Administration
  • Database architecture and administration
  • Application Architecture
  • Data architecture and design
  • Performance tuning and benchmarking
  • Extra bonus points if you have experience in one or more of Java, Python, Ruby, C, C++, C#, Javascript, node.js, Go, PHP, or Perl

If you have an operations background, we prefer experience administering large-scale production environments, including hardware, operating systems (e.g. Linux, Windows), networks (including firewalls and load balancers), as well as cloud-based resources (e.g. AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform).

It’s crucial for every candidate that they can check off all of these boxes

  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Genuine desire to help people
  • Uncontrollable urge to investigate and solve problems, with advanced diagnostic and troubleshooting skills
  • Ability to think on your feet, remain calm under pressure and solve problems in real-time
  • Desire and ability to rapidly learn a wide variety of new technical skills

title: Lead, Technical Services Engineer - Partners
descriptionHtml:
MongoDB's Technical Services Engineering team uses exceptional problem-solving and customer service skills, along with deep technical experience, to advise customers and solve their complex MongoDB problems: consulting on application and schema design, optimizing performance and scalability, resolving production outages, designing and reviewing operational procedures such as business continuity plans, and explaining MongoDB internals.

As Lead, Technical Services Engineer, Partners, you will mentor, train, and coach a team of Partner TSEs while remaining hands-on with the most complex partner and mutual-customer issues. You will work with the team Manager and take on day-to-day operational responsibility for the team, ensuring caseload is addressed accurately, quickly, and professionally, with a constant focus on customer and partner success. You will also collaborate with Customer Success Management, Solutions Architects, Partner teams, and other internal stakeholders on high-profile partners and customers as we migrate and support business-critical applications.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Bengaluru for our hybrid working model.

Required

  • 2+ years of experience leading teams, directly or indirectly
  • Patience, empathy, and a genuine desire to help others
  • ~7 years of experience building, managing, and maintaining complex, mission-critical, large-scale production database systems (RDBMS, NoSQL, or both). 
  • Coding/scripting ability in one or more languages: Java, Python, Ruby, C, C++, C#, JavaScript, Node.js, Go, etc.
  • Experience working with APIs to integrate with 3rd-party technologies and software in areas such as security and fraud, big data analytics and AI, healthcare, content management, IoT, database performance monitoring and management, financial services, and telco
  • Solid hands-on systems engineering experience, including Linux performance, memory management, I/O tuning, configuration, security, networking, clusters, and troubleshooting
  • Strong diagnostic and troubleshooting process, with significant experience analyzing and troubleshooting end-to-end issues holistically in production, from the application tier through the database down to storage
  • Troubleshooting experience with the TCP/IP networking stack on OS and hypervisor, including firewalls and load balancers
  • Experience using or administering one or more cloud stacks such as AWS, Azure, or GCP
  • Hands-on experience administering and troubleshooting NAS, SAN, local storage, and multi-pathing
  • Experience building solutions involving application workloads and use cases
  • Strong background in performance tuning and benchmarking, and in providing technical support to internal and/or external customers
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to think on your feet, remain calm under pressure, and find solutions in real time

Preferred

  • Experience using or managing MongoDB
  • Experience developing applications in one or more programming languages using a NoSQL or SQL database
  • Strong understanding of authentication systems such as LDAP, Kerberos, and AD
  • Experience with distributed version control systems, in particular git
  • Experience with Kubernetes or other orchestration systems using vendor-specific Enterprise operators
  • Experience working with software product teams, and familiarity with product release processes from planning to release

Success Measures

  • In 3 months, you will have gained a deep understanding of MongoDB and its partner ecosystem, completed New Hire Training, and built working relationships with your team, the Manager, and key partner and internal stakeholders
  • In 6 months, you will be running day-to-day team operations (workflow, escalations, meetings) with the Manager, comfortable working frontline with customers and partners, and will have completed the MongoDB Certified DBA Associate exam
  • In 12 months, you will be a recognized technical specialist and people leader: your team's engineers are growing and independently handling technical escalations, partner Centers of Excellence are in place for onboarded partners, and you are driving regular pain and bug reporting and operational improvements with Engineering and internal teams

Responsibilities

Team leadership and operations

  • Drive customer and partner success by guiding the team to solve complex technical problems, from design through production operations, including managing team workflow, assisting on hands-on customer issues, and managing internal and external escalations
  • Work with the team Manager to assume day-to-day operational responsibility for the team, including hiring, training, mentoring, coaching, meetings, and performance evaluations
  • Ensure caseload is addressed accurately, quickly, and professionally, and actively monitor partner-related cases to ensure correct handling
  • Contribute to internal technical projects, which can include software development, benchmarking, building documentation and training guides, and providing oversight on other engineers' project work
  • Ensure we are investing the right resources, addressing the right problems, and scaling the organization properly: drive monthly and quarterly pain and bug reports to Engineering, improve operational workflows with internal teams at MongoDB, coordinate regional trainings, summits, and conferences, and help address market demand for our product and services more broadly

Direct partner support

  • Provide in-market support for technology partners to ensure good customer outcomes
  • Provide development support through the Design-Win process, helping partners get to market via MongoDB best practices and solution interoperability guidance
  • Act as the domain expert and context source for partner-related matters, and facilitate partner engagement as needed
  • Onboard partners: document contacts, establish escalation paths, and set up communication channels (Slack, recurring review and check-in cadence)
  • Lead Partners Center of Excellence work per onboarded partner: build a partner-specific knowledge base, perform technology reviews of the partner's solution and integration, review partner solution releases for known MongoDB issues, maintain as-built documentation (deployment architecture, product/solution matrix, known issues), communicate best practices, and build a risk mitigation plan

Support for joint and mutual customers

  • Lead multi-vendor collaboration when an issue's root cause spans multiple vendors
  • Manage mutual support systems and case-handling processes
  • Manage partner escalation contacts and processes
  • Collaborate with Customer Success Management, Solutions Architects, and other internal stakeholders on high-profile customers as we migrate and support business-critical applications

Program-level objectives the role serves

  • Centralized point of contact within Technical Services for partner-account support matters
  • Knowledge hub within TS for all partner-related information
  • Minimizing technical-interoperability risk for mutual customers
  • Champion the customer's and partner's needs and contribute to the evolution of our Developer Data Platform

title: Field Marketing Manager
descriptionHtml:
The Regional Marketing Manager is a key execution engine within MongoDB's newly created AMER Marketing Hub based in Mexico City. MongoDB is looking for a driven, analytical, and experienced Regional Marketing Manager based in Mexico City to join our high-performing AMER Marketing organization. In this role, you will be responsible for driving account expansion, developer groundswell, pipeline generation and deal acceleration across North America (US/Canada) while scaling impactful virtual programs across the region.

Working directly under the leadership of the LATAM Regional Marketing Lead, you will collaborate daily with AMER Regional Marketing Managers, ABM Leads, Developer Relations, and Marketing Operations. You will own, build, and execute integrated field marketing plans that encompass high-touch regional events (Developer Days, AI Builder Days, sponsorships, pipeline acceleration dinners) and scalable virtual initiatives (Skill Badge workshops and webinars).

Because this role directly owns field execution in US territories,on-site presence is critical. You will spend 20–30% of your time traveling to US markets to lead event execution, partner with local sales teams, and engage directly with developers, architects, and C-level executives. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Program Execution & Operations

  • Build, own, and execute an integrated marketing plan for assigned territories in North America, aligning programs directly with regional sales goals and routes to revenue
  • Serve as a trusted partner to Sales leadership and Account Executives, understanding territory needs, strategic account challenges, and key decision-making personas
  • Manage the regional marketing budget for assigned programs, ensuring disciplined allocation, optimization, and strong ROI
  • Support MongoDB flagship events, regional roadshows, third-party conferences, and executive dinners

2. Scalable Virtual Programs & Developer Groundswell

  • Lead and scale high-volume, virtual engagement programs across NAMER, including hands-on Skill Badge workshops, technical webinars, and virtual enablement series
  • Build developer groundswell across assigned accounts, tracking and reporting on developers enabled and certified within the region
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams (Developer Relations, Product Marketing, ABM, and Partner Marketing) to deliver cohesive end-to-end buyer and developer journeys

3. AI Adoption, Process Innovation & Workflow Automation

  • Demonstrate strong curiosity and a forward-thinking mindset in the AI Era, continuously exploring and adopting AI tools and technologies to optimize daily marketing operations
  • Proactively identify manual bottlenecks and implement AI-driven workflow automations to improve process efficiency and team output
  • Operate with high autonomy, independence, and adaptability, maintaining the flexibility needed to navigate evolving GTM priorities, cross-border timezone alignment, and fast-paced regional requests

4. Data, Analytics & Performance Tracking

  • Track, measure, and report on program performance, MQL generation, pipeline creation, deal velocity, and Net Annual Recurring Revenue (NARR) influence
  • Utilize Salesforce, Tableau, and marketing automation tools to deliver rigorous quarterly retrospectives and actionable insights to leadership
  • Experiment with new campaign formats and iterate quickly based on data-guided insights
  • Deliver post-event performance recaps and highlight best practices that can be scaled across NAMER

Qualifications

  • Location: Must be based in or near Mexico City (CDMX)
  • US Travel & Documentation: Ability and willingness to travel 20–30% of the time to North America (US/Canada). Must possess a valid Passport and a US Visa
  • Language Proficiency: Exceptional written and verbal English fluency is required (daily interaction with US cross-functional teams)
  • 3–6 years of B2B field marketing, regional marketing, or demand generation experience in enterprise SaaS, cloud, or technology companies
  • AI & Automation Mindset: Practical experience or strong proficiency using AI tools to automate marketing workflows, streamline tasks, and increase operational output independently
  • Adaptability & Independence: High degree of flexibility, proactive problem-solving skills, and the ability to work self-sufficiently across timezones and shifting priorities
  • Proven track record building and executing complex field marketing plans in direct alignment with Sales teams
  • Strong proficiency with B2B marketing stacks (Salesforce, Wrike, Tableau, Jira, and event management platforms)
  • Analytical and metrics-driven mindset with proven capability to prove ROI against marketing spend
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and project leadership skills with a positive, can-do attitude
  • Familiarity with developer, architect, or IT decision-maker (ITDM) audiences and developer marketing programs

What Success Looks Like in Year 1

  • Seamless onboarding into the AMER Marketing Hub and immediate operational partnership with US regional leads
  • High-quality, flaw-free execution of assigned Developer Days, AI Builder Days, and virtual Skill Badge workshops
  • Consistent achievement of SLAs for campaign setup, lead upload, and post-event reporting
  • Positive feedback and strong trust built across Sales and Marketing counterparts

Position Details

  • Reports to: Regional Marketing Lead, LATAM 
  • Location: Mexico City (CDMX), Mexico
  • Travel Requirement: 20–30% travel
  • Department: Marketing – Regional / Revenue Marketing AMER
