title: Senior Financial Analyst
descriptionHtml:
MongoDB is seeking a Senior Financial Analyst, Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A) to grow our G&A FP&A team. You will be responsible for financial planning, forecasting, reporting, and partnering with the business to drive decision-making and resource planning. The Senior Analyst is expected to make significant contributions to the success of MongoDB by working with executives and team leaders to evaluate, plan, execute, and measure strategic business initiatives.

This position requires an adaptable self-starter who is able to work comfortably and communicate clearly with stakeholders across the organization, progress tasks from start to finish, and enjoy working in a fast-paced, challenging environment. The working model for this role is flexible. 

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in one of our offices for our hybrid working model.

Responsibilities:

  • Business Partnering: Quickly establish positive relationships and become a key advisor for your G&A partners allowing you to build a solid understanding of business drivers and ensuring alignment with overall company objectives
  • Forecast Coordination & Modelling: Build and maintain detailed financial and operating models to support your stakeholders in all aspects of their budget including headcount planning and optimization
  • Analyzing: Conduct ad-hoc analyses and build financial models to guide leaders toward efficient operating strategies, resource allocation, and investments in product initiatives
  • Operational Effectiveness: Improve and scale business, operational, and financial processes understood by all important partners, including standardizing and automating reports and improving how we leverage internal systems
  • Perform financial month-end close activities, including headcount reconciliations, accrual reviews, and budget vs. actuals analysis and reporting
  • Partner with recruiting and HR partners to drive efficiencies in workforce planning and reporting for executives and their leaders
  • Operate independently to prepare schedules and relevant analysis for each planning cycle and develops clear support for management review
  • Drive clarity underlying drivers of spend and business performance, in areas such as total token / AI spend and SaaS spend across the compay

What You'll Need:

  • Bachelor’s Degree; finance, business or economics preferred
  • 3-5 years experience in FP&A, and/or analytical, critical thinking, and quantitative skills
  • Proficiency in financial modeling, Google Suite, and Microsoft Excel; financial planning tools (Pigment) are a plus 
  • Ability to analyze data, draw conclusions, and develop actionable recommendations
  • Confidence to forge strong relationships with business partners at all levels of the organization; prior business partnering experience preferred, within a tech company a plus 
  • Drive for results and a sense of urgency with the capacity to multitask and prioritize

title: Manager, Technical Services
descriptionHtml:
At MongoDB, we are transforming industries and empowering developers to build amazing applications that people use every day. We are a leading developer data platform, helping organizations build, scale, and operate modern applications.

MongoDB Technical Services partners with customers to help them successfully run MongoDB in production. Our globally distributed organization provides 24x7x365 support through a follow-the-sun model, combining deep technical expertise with a strong commitment to customer outcomes.

We are looking for a Manager, Technical Services to lead and grow a team in Gurugram. This leader will manage engineers supporting customers across MongoDB’s database, cloud, and emerging application-platform capabilities. The role is well suited to a people leader who can build a high-performing, inclusive team; lead complex customer situations; and partner effectively with Engineering, Product, and go-to-market teams.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.

The role

As a Manager, Technical Services, you will lead a team of highly skilled support engineers. You will create the conditions for excellent customer outcomes, develop technical and people leadership capability within the team, and help scale the support model for evolving customer workloads.

Your team will support a broad range of technologies, including MongoDB database and cloud services, distributed applications, APIs, cloud infrastructure, observability, and modern AI-enabled application workflows. You will help establish durable operating practices for a fast-growing area while ensuring seamless collaboration with the wider global Technical Services organization.

What you’ll do

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Technical Services Engineers, including regular 1:1s, clear goals, performance feedback, career development, and succession planning
  • Build an inclusive, accountable, and customer-focused team culture where engineers can do their best work
  • Own regional service delivery for your team, balancing customer experience, case health, quality, operational discipline, and team sustainability
  • Lead and coordinate high-impact customer escalations, ensuring timely communication, sound technical judgment, clear ownership, and effective follow-through
  • Partner with Engineering, Product, Security, Customer Success, Sales, and other Technical Services teams to resolve complex issues and bring customer feedback into product and process improvements
  • Work with global peers to maintain consistent follow-the-sun processes, effective handoffs, and high-quality support across regions
  • Help scale support for modern application workloads involving APIs, cloud services, distributed systems, containers, observability, data services, and AI-enabled application workflows, including agent orchestration, model and tool integrations, MCP, retrieval, memory, and production reliability considerations
  • Establish and improve team operating mechanisms, including incident management, case reviews, root-cause analysis, knowledge management, quality practices, and capacity planning
  • Identify recurring customer issues and drive improvements to self-service content, diagnostic tooling, runbooks, and support processes
  • Participate in hiring and onboarding, and build a strong local talent pipeline
  • Use operational metrics and customer feedback to identify trends, communicate performance, and prioritize improvements
  • Contribute to regional and global Technical Services initiatives that improve the customer experience, operational efficiency, and technical capability of the organization

What you’ll bring

Required

  • 3+ years of experience leading a technical support, customer engineering, site reliability, operations, or similar customer-facing technical team
  • Demonstrated success developing people, managing performance, hiring strong talent, and building inclusive, high-performing teams
  • Experience coordinating complex or high-severity customer escalations and working effectively with Engineering and Product organizations
  • Strong technical foundation in troubleshooting production systems, with the ability to guide structured investigations across application, infrastructure, network, identity, and data layers
  • Experience with one or more of cloud platforms, distributed systems, databases, containerized workloads, APIs, observability, or enterprise software
  • Foundational knowledge of AI-enabled applications and agentic workflows, with the ability to assess technical judgment in areas such as agents, model-provider integrations, tool calling, Model Context Protocol (MCP), retrieval and memory, orchestration, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop workflows
  • Strong customer advocacy and sound judgment under pressure, with the ability to set expectations and drive issues to resolution
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt communication for technical, business, and executive audiences
  • Experience translating organizational objectives into clear team priorities, measurable outcomes, and individual goals
  • A collaborative, pragmatic leadership style and the ability to operate effectively across global, cross-functional teams

Preferred

  • Experience supporting MongoDB, MongoDB Atlas, or another database or distributed data platform
  • Experience with cloud-native technologies, such as AWS, Azure, or GCP; Docker; Kubernetes; networking; identity and access management; or CI/CD systems
  • Familiarity with logs, metrics, traces, alerting, incident response, and root-cause analysis
  • Experience supporting developer platforms, platform services, or AI-enabled applications
  • Experience using operational metrics, dashboards, or scorecards to improve support performance and customer outcomes

Success in the role

Within 30 days

  • Complete MongoDB onboarding and build rapport with the team and key partners
  • Develop a working understanding of the Technical Services operating model, customer support processes, and product portfolio
  • Establish a regular 1:1 cadence and begin assessing team strengths, development opportunities, and operational priorities

Within 60 days

  • Build productive relationships with peer managers and stakeholders in Engineering, Product, Customer Success, Sales, and Escalation Management
  • Understand regional and global follow-the-sun workflows, escalation processes, and the team’s current performance measures
  • Begin contributing to regional escalations, case reviews, and team operating rhythms

Within 90 days

  • Own the day-to-day leadership of the team, including development planning, performance management, and delivery oversight
  • Identify opportunities to improve team efficiency, knowledge sharing, customer experience, or technical readiness
  • Define a practical plan for scaling the team’s capability and operational maturity over the following 6–12 months

title: Software Engineer 3
descriptionHtml:
The Application Modernization Platform (AMP) team is dedicated to solving one of the industry's biggest challenges: transforming rigid, legacy applications that suffer from poor scalability and high operating costs into modern, microservices-based architectures on MongoDB. To accelerate this transition, MongoDB is building a dedicated Platform and Infrastructure team to develop the Application Modernisation Platform and Infrastructure . As we help customers modernize their application and data ecosystems, we face the challenge of deploying complex tooling into highly restrictive client environments and architecting automated verification frameworks to ensure data equivalence.

This new team will architect the platform foundation and infrastructure that enables a "build once, run anywhere" model, ensuring our AI-powered modernisation suite operates seamlessly regardless of a client's security or network constraints. We are looking for engineers to join this high-visibility initiative, where you will solve unique distributed systems puzzles and help shape the future of how global enterprises leverage data and AI.

We are looking for an experienced Software Engineer who thrives on solving infrastructure constraints and building developer-centric modernisation platforms with a strong background in building software testkits/frameworks. The ideal candidate will be designing and building automated frameworks that validate functional equivalence, performance benchmarks, and data integrity. From leveraging LLMs for unit test generation to building contract testing frameworks, your work will be the safety net for the world’s largest enterprise migrations.

This role will be based in our India office in Gurgaon and offers a hybrid working model.

The ideal candidate for this role will have

  • 3-4 years of commercial software development experience with at least one JVM language such as Java, preferably using the Spring ecosystem
  • Expertise integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) into the developer workflow to automate unit test generation and edge-case discovery
  • Experience building developer tools, infrastructure, or complex testing frameworks
  • Solid experience in software architecture and development
  • Deep expertise in application/database modernization with proven ability to design and implement frameworks that ensure database state equivalence across different implementations
  • Must understand change data capture, event-driven database interception (MongoDB listeners, RDBMS triggers), and state comparison algorithms with pattern-based exclusions. Strong Spring Boot (or equivalent Java framework), MongoDB (or equivalent), and JDBC/JPA skills required
  • Extensive experience with relational and document data modeling and hands-on experience with at least one SQL database (Postgres, MySQL, etc) and at least one document database (e.g. MongoDB)
  • Good understanding of algorithms, data structures and their time and space complexity
  • Curiosity, a positive attitude, and a drive to continue learning
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Position Expectations

  • Contribute high-quality, well-tested code to the modernization and framework team and its surrounding services
  • Collaborate effectively with Product Management, other engineers, and designers to build and deliver on the product roadmap
  • Participate actively in code reviews to enforce best practices and patterns
  • Help troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues in our distributed systems
  • Give and solicit feedback on technical design documents and pull requests
  • Perform tasks related to process such as CI/CD, quality, testing, etc 

Success Measures

Within the first three months, you will have:

  • Familiarize yourself with the MongoDB Modernization Infrastructure & Frameworks stack
  • Set up software development infrastructure (tech stack, build tools, etc) to enable development using the relevant tech stacks
  • Started collaborating with your peers and contributed to code reviews and design reviews

Within six months, you will have:

  • Familiarised yourself with the rest of our the application modernization tool stack
  • Delivered at least one large scale feature that spans the entire tech stack
  • Reviewed and contributed to scope and technical design documents

Within 12 months, you will have:

  • Become a key contributor to our stack, capable of taking on complex features independently
  • Helped recruit and interview new members of the team
  • Collaborated effectively with other teams at MongoDB on cross-functional projects

title: Senior Software Engineer, Product Security
descriptionHtml:
The MongoDB Product Security team is looking for a full-stack senior software engineer to help us build and scale the next generation of security practices, enabling hundreds of MongoDB engineers to build secure products for our customers.

The Product Security team empowers product teams to build secure products for MongoDB customers by providing security enablement, such as AI-powered code analysis, threat modeling and security finding triaging and verification, fuzzing infrastructure, and finding management solutions. Our goal is to incorporate security early in product development at scale without introducing friction. With the emerging capabilities of AI models, we are proactively adopting our security practices to be prepared for the newly introduced challenges.

This role can be based out of our Dublin or Cork office or remotely in the Ireland region. This role is expected to work with a distributed team that covers all time zones in the US.

Key Responsibilities:

As a software engineer on our team, you will help us develop and maintain security automations, such as:

  • Deliver features for an automated code analysis platform
  • Expand security findings triaging and verification platform to all products across MongoDB
  • Automate finding management process to be self-serve for engineering teams
  • Centralized security signal analytics platform to help teams focus on the most important security work
  • Design and build tooling solutions to shift security practices left in SDLC

Baseline Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience of production-level software development with Python and TypeScript in a cloud environment
  • Experience managing the end-to-end development lifecycle, including building, deploying and operating software at scale
  • Experience in micro-services, Kubernetes, and containers
  • Deep understanding of CI/CD systems, including linting, testing and various deployment strategies
  • The ability to independently prioritize and execute tasks after alignment with the team and stakeholders
  • A proven track record of identifying problems, implementing solutions and delivering complex projects 
  • Strong Understanding of building AI agents
  • Strong verbal and written technical communication skills

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Basic knowledge of what security practices are and how they work, such as threat modeling, secure code review, and CVE
  • Familiarity with C++ or Rust
  • Experience designing and operating systems that execute untrusted code safely — container/sandbox isolation, least-privilege credential handling, and network egress controls.
  • Experience with NoSQL or database development

title: Technical Services Engineer
descriptionHtml:
MongoDB Technical Services Engineers use their exceptional problem solving and customer service skills, along with their deep technical experience, to advise customers and to solve their complex MongoDB problems. Technical Service Engineers are experts in the entire MongoDB ecosystem - database server, drivers, cloud and infrastructure. This also includes services such as Atlas (database as a service), or Cloud Manager (which helps customers with automation, backup and monitoring of their MongoDB systems). Our engineers combine their MongoDB expertise with passion, initiative, teamwork and a great sense of humor to help our customers to be successful with MongoDB.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are interested in working out of our Dublin office under our in-office working model (3-5 days onsite) Monday to Friday.

You'll be working alongside our largest customers, solving their complex challenges - resolving questions on architecture, performance, recovery, security, and everything in between. title: Senior Solutions Architect (Search Specialist)
descriptionHtml:
The worldwide data management software market is massive (According to IDC, the data management software market is forecast to be $94 billion in 2023 growing to approximately $153 billion in 2027, representing a 13% compound annual growth rate). At MongoDB we are transforming industries and empowering developers to build amazing apps that people use every day. We are the leading developer data platform and the first database provider to IPO in over 20 years. Join our team and be at the forefront of innovation and creativity.

We are looking for hardworking technologists to join our Pre-Sales organization to ensure that our growth is grounded and guided by strong technical alignment with our platform and the needs of our customers.

MongoDB Pre-Sales Solution Architects are responsible for guiding our customers and users to craft and build reliable, scalable systems using our data platform. Our team is made up of hardworking software architects, entrepreneurs, and developers who take direct responsibility for customer success, including the design of their software, deployment, and operations. You'll work closely with our sales reps and play a key role in winning deals and driving the business forward. You'll be a trusted advisor to a wide range of users from startups to the world's largest enterprise IT organizations.

As MongoDB continues to expand its product offerings and features, MongoDB is seeking an expert in search. Beyond the normal tasks of a MongoDB Solutions Architect, this specialist role will operate in a worldwide team, assist in the most complex search deal cycles, assist in search enablement, and work closely with the Atlas Search product team to close the feedback loop and further enhance the product moving forward.

This role will be based remotely in Barcelona, Spain.

As an ideal candidate, you will have

  • 3+ years of search or information retrieval expertise (Elasticsearch, Lucene, Solr, Algolia, Milvus, Qdrant, or similar) 
  • 3+ years of software development experience or pre-sales experience with enterprise software

  • Experience with scalable and highly available distributed systems
  • Excellent presentation and interpersonal skills

You may also have

  • Translate technical concepts and patterns into business benefits for management and executives
  • Act as a liaison, collecting feedback from the field to relay back to the Product Management team
  • Help drive demand through participation in both industry-known trade-shows as well account-based marketing events
  • Demonstrate resilience and sound judgment in dealing with business challenges
  • Proactively seek opportunities to support and mentor other pre-sales team members and share standard methodologies
  • Help enable other solutions architects with knowledge on search technical and business concepts as well as build tools to allow other SAs to demonstrate these concepts 
  • Assist in the direction of Search and AI through collaboration with Product Management
  • Embody MongoDB’s core values in our interactions with internal teams and customers

What you will learn

  • How to lead in a fast growing SA organisation and take ownership of a product narrative from the SA perspective.
  • The rapidly growing MongoDB product suite, particularly the MongoDB data platform for AI which includes:
    • Core Database

title: VP, Corporate Controller
descriptionHtml:
About the Role

MongoDB is seeking a seasoned Vice President, Corporate Controller to lead the Company's global controllership organization at a pivotal stage of growth. This is a rare opportunity to shape the accounting function of a high-growth, publicly traded technology company as it scales into its next phase.

Reporting to the Chief Accounting Officer, the VP, Corporate Controller will serve as a strategic thought partner to executive leadership and key cross-functional stakeholders, leading the strategy and performance of MongoDB's global accounting and external reporting function. This leader will own global accounting operations, international compliance, SEC reporting and technical accounting, global payroll, accounting center of excellence, and will serve as the Company's senior authority on U.S. GAAP.

This is a high-impact, hands-on leadership role with responsibility for building and developing a global, distributed organization while driving transformation across people, process, and systems. The role will modernize accounting infrastructure, automation, and controllership, translate complex accounting matters into clear business decisions for senior leadership and help shape a scalable roadmap for MongoDB's next stage of growth.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in San Francisco, CA or Palo Alto, CA for our hybrid working model.

Responsibilities

  • Set the strategic vision and operating model for global Controllership—building the maturity, scalability, and rigor needed to support MongoDB's next stage of growth
  • Lead and develop senior leaders across the function, with accountability for organizational design, location strategy, talent development, succession planning, and cross-functional execution across a large, distributed global team
  • Own the company's technical accounting positions and conclusions under U.S. GAAP, including complex and non-standard transactions, business combinations, stock-based compensation, and new accounting standard implementation
  • Own the integrity, timeliness, and quality of external financial reporting, including SEC filings (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K) and the earnings release process, and serve as the primary management point of contact for external auditors 
  • Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close and consolidation process, driving continuous improvement in speed, accuracy, and efficiency; define and track controllership KPIs (close cycle time, error rates, automation coverage, control deficiencies) and report on them regularly to the CAO
  • Drive the strategic vision, design, and continuous improvement of the internal control environment (SOX 404), ensuring a control framework that scales with the business and adapts to new products, entities, and processes
  • Oversee global statutory and local GAAP compliance across MongoDB's international entities, partnering with regional finance teams and external advisors
  • Lead and drive major finance transformation initiatives including ERP optimization (Oracle NetSuite), chart-of-accounts governance, reporting-layer modernization, and adoption of AI-enabled close and reconciliation tools

Requirements

  • 15+ years of progressive accounting and finance leadership experience, including current or recent experience as a Controller at a publicly traded, multinational, high-growth technology company
  • CPA and Big 4 public accounting background with a strong audit and technical accounting foundation preferred
  • Deep, current expertise in U.S. GAAP and SEC reporting requirements, with demonstrated experience owning complex technical accounting positions (e.g., business combinations, equity/stock compensation, leases, revenue-adjacent matters)
  • Proven track record of leading transformational change—including ERP/systems modernization, process redesign, and automation—within a controllership or accounting organization
  • Experience building, scaling, and leading large, distributed global teams, including establishing or optimizing shared-services and international location strategy
  • Demonstrated experience operating at scale within a high-growth environment, managing increasing complexity in products, entities, and geographies
  • Strong technical accumen—comfortable partnering with IT/Engineering on financial systems, data, and automation, and translating technical accounting complexity for non-accounting audiences
  • Excellent executive presence and communication skills, with experience presenting to and partnering with C-suite executives, the Board of Directors, and the Audit Committee
  • Strong relationship-building and cross-functional influence skills, with a track record of partnering effectively across Legal, Tax, FP&A, Revenue, Corporate Development, and business teams
  • Proven track record of leading transformational change — including ERP/systems modernization, AI-assisted reconciliation, and intelligent close tools — that measurably reduced manual effort and error rates
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field; MBA a plus

descriptionHtml:

title: Associate Technical Services Engineer (Tues-Sat Shift)
descriptionHtml:
About the team

MongoDB Technical Services Engineers will combine exceptional problem solving and communication skills with deep technical experience to advise customers and solve complex MongoDB problems. 

They are experts in components of the MongoDB ecosystem - database server, drivers, our management suite, and services such as Cloud Manager (the online product we developed for customers for automation, backup, monitoring, and analysis of their MongoDB systems), and MongoDB Atlas. They combine their MongoDB expertise with passion, initiative, teamwork and a great sense of humor to achieve exceptional results for our customers.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Milan for our hybrid working model (Tues-Sat Shift).

Cool things you’ll do

MongoDB is on a mission to change the way people think about databases. Along the way, our customers encounter questions and issues about how our approach to databases works for their use case. In Technical Services, it's our job to help these people. You'll be working alongside our largest customers, solving their complex challenges - resolving questions on architecture, performance, recovery, security, and everything in between. You'll be an expert resource on best practices in running MongoDB at scale, whatever that scale may be. You'll be an advocate for customers' needs - interfacing with our product management and development teams on their behalf. And you'll contribute to internal projects, including software development of support tools for performance, benchmarking, and diagnostics.

In this specific role, starting from the MongoDB database, you will also focus on the performance of our Cloud platform Atlas and its supported services. You will help both frontend and backend developers build next generation applications on MongoDB platform.

Finally, MongoDB Technical Services puts a strong focus on engineers enabling their peers to be successful by sharing newly gained technical knowledge with the team, either via informal one-to-one conversations, or training and workshop sessions. By documenting solutions in our knowledge base system, Technical Services Engineers will increase the efficiency of our customers, other team members and departments throughout MongoDB. 

What you need

We are looking for curious, and multi-faceted teammates who are driven to serve our customers. 

The ideal candidate should have a mix of experience in most of the following areas. We are open to training people up in certain areas, so don't worry about ticking every box!

  • 3–4 years of experience in a technical support, solutions support, or customer-facing engineering role
  • Distributed systems, Database architecture and administration, Application architecture, Data architecture
  • Experience supporting complex mission-critical product applications and database systems (RDMBS or NoSQL or both)
  • Supporting Cloud and/or Enterprise grade applications
  • Strong diagnostics and troubleshooting experience, with the ability to analyze issues holistically, from the application tier, to database to storage
  • Broad awareness of customer workloads and use cases, including performance, availability, and scalability
  • Systems administration experience, including Linux performance, memory management, I/O tuning, configuration, security, networking, clusters, and troubleshooting
  • Ability to read code, and basic coding/scripting ability in one or more languages: Java, Python, Ruby, C, C++, C#, Javascript, node.js, Go, etc
  • Good understanding of Networking concepts and protocols (DNS, TCP/IP, SSL/TLS, etc.)
  • Storage engineering experience, including NAS, RAID, SAN, SSD, multi-pathing, and caching
  • Working with real time stream processing using Kafka.
  • Serverless computing services such as AWS Lambda, Azure functions.

As this role is technical but also about helping our customers, we are looking for:

  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Genuine desire to help people
  • Desire and ability to rapidly learn a wide variety of new technical skills
  • Uncontrollable urge to investigate and solve problems, with advanced diagnostic and troubleshooting skills
  • Ability to think on your feet, remain calm under pressure, and solve problems in real-time
  • Strong teamwork: willingness and ability to get help from team members when required, and the good judgment to know when to seek help
  • Good written and verbal skills in Italian & English

Bonus Points

  • Server side troubleshooting
  • Deep understanding of at least object-oriented programming language.
  • Deep understanding of connection pools.
  • Experience with Apache Spark.
  • Experience with authentication systems such as LDAP, Kerberos, AD
  • Experience using or managing MongoDB
  • Experience using distributed version control systems, and in particular git
  • Experience using any cloud services stack such as AWS, Azure or GCP
  • Experience with Kubernetes or other orchestration systems using vendor-specific Enterprise operators

Success Measures 

  • In 3 months, you’ll have gained a deep understanding of MongoDB and its ecosystem. You will complete New Hire Training
  • In 6 months, you will be comfortable working directly with our customers. You will also complete the MongoDB Certified DBA Associate exam
  • In 12 months, you will work on gaining expertise to be a part of a technical experts group within the MongoDB ecosystem and will be helping your peer engineers in advance diagnostics. Also, you will be encouraged to handle technical escalations independently

title: Lead, Technical Services
descriptionHtml:
Building on the rapid success and adoption of MongoDB, we are delivering applications and services that make it much easier to manage and scale database deployments. These next-generation systems are a growing list but currently include products such as Atlas, Cloud Manager, and Compass. Join our team and be at the forefront of innovation and creativity as we scale cloud deployments for our customers.

We're looking to speak with candidates based in New York City for our hybrid working model.  

Life in MongoDB Technical Services

As part of the Support organization, you will be directly interfacing with our largest customers and their most difficult problems. There will almost certainly be sweat. But don’t worry – you’ll have time to prepare before you take on your first escalation. The limits of your understanding will constantly be pushed, and you’ll be challenged to grow. Underlying it all is the fuel that drives our team: customer obsession. We keep mission-critical deployments online, recover from high-pressure incidents with grace and humility, become trusted advisors, and work so closely with our customers that they would swear we were part of their team.

Role scope: This is a technical Team Lead role rather than a traditional people-manager role. The Lead is expected to provide day-to-day technical and operational leadership, while formal personnel decisions remain with the manager.

As the Cloud Support Team Lead, you will:

  • Lead and mentor a small, distributed team as a hands-on technical player-coach
  • Spend approximately 50% of your time directly supporting customer issues, complex cases, escalations, and technical investigations.
  • Own frontline service quality by monitoring queue health, case and chat aging, diagnostic quality, staffing coverage, and workload allocation
  • Lead high-visibility customer escalations and incidents, coordinating Engineering, Product, Support Operations, and other stakeholders
  • Turn recurring customer problems and support trends into product feedback, process improvements, training, and reusable technical content
  • Create and maintain SOPs, knowledge articles, training materials, and retrospectives that improve team capability and consistency
  • Represent Technical Services in cross-functional and cross-region programs, driving execution through influence

Who You Are

  • You are a calm, empathetic technical leader who earns trust with customers, engineers, and cross-functional partners
  • You are comfortable leading through influence, ambiguity, and incomplete information
  • You use data to identify risks, prioritize work, and allocate team capacity
  • You balance hands-on customer support with coaching, quality management, and continuous improvement

What you need

The ideal candidate will have experience in most of the following areas:

  • Supporting customers through cases, chats, calls, and high-severity escalations. Preferred experience with running high-severity incidents and follow-the-sun procedures
  • Leading or mentoring a small team of highly technical support engineers
  • Strong troubleshooting experience with MongoDB Atlas or comparable cloud database platforms, including cloud infrastructure, Linux, networking, security, storage, and performance
  • A disciplined diagnostic process covering investigation, customer communication, escalation judgment, and root-cause analysis. Experience leveraging AI tools to broaden, improve and accelerate technical diagnostic processes preferred
  • Coordinating customer-impacting incidents and internal technical responders
  • Improving support operations through queue analysis, workload allocation, staffing coverage, training, and process improvement
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills across Engineering, Product, Security, Legal, Billing, Support Operations, and global Technical Services

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Cloud Manager, Compass, or large-scale relational or NoSQL databases
  • Experience managing FIN(Intercom), chat-support, case-management, or similar customer-support workflows
  • Experience leading incident reviews, RCAs, operational audits, or security/compliance improvements
  • Experience creating technical training, LMS content, knowledge programs, or enablement assessments
  • BONUS: Experience with DevOps, infrastructure-as-code, observability, automation, or scripting

Success Measures

  • First 3 months: Build relationships, understand team operations and customer demand, and begin contributing to complex escalations. Learn the Atlas product and master most common customer use cases
  • By 6 months: Independently lead escalations, establish recurring queue and quality reviews, improve coverage, and deliver at least one durable process or enablement improvement. Acquire Atlas Administrator certification
  • By 12 months: Demonstrate measurable improvement in service quality, escalation execution, team capability, coverage, and cross-functional delivery while remaining hands-on technically

エンタープライズ・アカウント・エグゼクティブ（新規開拓）

日本のエンタープライズ企業に新規開拓でアプローチし、MongoDBの日本市場でのプレゼンスを広げていただく営業職です。意欲と主体性があり、お客様の課題に向き合える方を求めています。新たなエンタープライズのお客様との関係を築き、データを活用したモダナイゼーションやプロダクト・システム構築を支援していただきます。担当テリトリーの戦略を自ら描いて実行し、ビジネス部門・テクノロジー部門のリーダーと信頼関係を築きながら、複雑な商談をリードします。お客様とMongoDBの双方にとって意義ある成果を生み出すことがミッションです。

勤務地は東京です。

業務内容

  • 新規エンタープライズ顧客の獲得と持続的な売上成長を軸に、担当テリトリーの戦略を立案・実行する
  • CTO、エンジニアリング・IT部門のリーダー、現場の技術担当者に戦略的にアプローチする。お客様の優先課題や事業施策を掘り下げ、案件の発掘・見極め・パイプラインの構築を主体的に進める
  • ディスカバリーや案件の見極めから、交渉、クロージングまで、複雑なエンタープライズ商談をリードする。関係者の認識をそろえ、次のステップを明確にする
  • 顧客組織内に信頼関係とビジネスチャンピオン（社内推進役）を構築し、新規アカウントの開拓と、事業部門をまたいだMongoDB活用の拡大につなげる
  • MongoDBのプラットフォームがもたらすビジネス価値を伝え、お客様のエンタープライズ技術のニーズを成果に結びつける
  • ソリューションコンサルティング、プロフェッショナルサービス、カスタマーサクセス、クラウド/チャネルパートナーと連携し、案件を前に進めて成約につなげ、お客様の成功を支援する

  • 競争が激しくスピード感のある市場で、新規開拓に重点を置いたクォータ（売上目標）を持つフィールドセールスの経験が7年以上ある

  • 複雑なエンタープライズ向けテクノロジーのビジネス価値を、さまざまな立場の関係者にわかりやすく説明できる
  • ビジネスチャンピオンを育てながら、複雑なエンタープライズ営業プロセスをリードした経験がある
  • 案件の見極め、時間管理、リソース管理に長けており、素早くキャッチアップして信頼を得られる

  • MEDDIC、SPIN、チャレンジャー・セールスなどの営業メソドロジーのトレーニング受講経験

  • MongoDB製品の専門性を高め、データプラットフォーム市場でキャリアを築いていくことへの強い関心

MongoDBについて

MongoDBは「変化」を前提に作られた会社です。お客様と社員が、市場のスピードに合わせてイノベーションを起こせるよう支援しています。私たちはAI時代に向けてデータプラットフォームを再定義し、ソフトウェアで産業を創造・変革し、既存の枠組みを覆そうとする開発者を後押ししています。MongoDBの統合データプラットフォームは、市場で最も広く利用でき、グローバルに分散されたデータプラットフォームです。レガシーなワークロードのモダナイズ、イノベーションの推進、AIの活用を支援します。

クラウドネイティブなプラットフォームであるMongoDB Atlasは、グローバルに分散したマルチクラウド対応のデータプラットフォームとして唯一の存在で、AWS、Google Cloud、Microsoft Azureで利用できます。世界各地に拠点を構え、AIネイティブのスタートアップからFortune 100企業の約75%まで、67,000社を超えるお客様が、最も重要なアプリケーションでMongoDBを活用しています。私たちは、次世代のソフトウェアを支えています。

MongoDBの指針となるのがリーダーシップ・コミットメントです。意思決定の理由と方法、仲間との向き合い方、そして成功への道筋を示してくれます。これこそがMongoDBらしさです。

社員一人ひとりの成長とビジネスへの貢献を後押しするため、誰もが支え合い、成長できる企業文化づくりに力を入れています。社員のアフィニティグループから、不妊治療支援、充実した育児休業制度まで、社員の心身の健康を大切にし、仕事とプライベートの両面でキャリアを支えます。MongoDBでの働き方について詳しくはこちら。ぜひ私たちと一緒に、世界にインパクトを与えましょう。

MongoDBは、障がいのある方が応募・面接のプロセスで必要とする配慮を提供します。配慮を希望される場合は、担当リクルーターにお知らせください。

title: Lead, Technical Services
descriptionHtml:
Building on the rapid success and adoption of MongoDB, we are delivering applications and services that make it much easier to manage and scale database deployments. These next-generation systems are a growing list but currently include products such as Atlas, Cloud Manager, and Compass. Join our team and be at the forefront of innovation and creativity as we scale cloud deployments for our customers.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Toronto for our hybrid working model.

Life in MongoDB Technical Services

As part of the Support organization, you will be directly interfacing with our largest customers and their most difficult problems. There will almost certainly be sweat. But don’t worry – you’ll have time to prepare before you take on your first escalation. The limits of your understanding will constantly be pushed, and you’ll be challenged to grow. Underlying it all is the fuel that drives our team: customer obsession. We keep mission-critical deployments online, recover from high-pressure incidents with grace and humility, become trusted advisors, and work so closely with our customers that they would swear we were part of their team.

Role scope: This is a technical Team Lead role rather than a traditional people-manager role. The Lead is expected to provide day-to-day technical and operational leadership, while formal personnel decisions remain with the manager.

As the Cloud Support Team Lead, you will:

  • Lead and mentor a small, distributed team as a hands-on technical player-coach
  • Spend approximately 50% of your time directly supporting customer issues, complex cases, escalations, and technical investigations.
  • Own frontline service quality by monitoring queue health, case and chat aging, diagnostic quality, staffing coverage, and workload allocation
  • Lead high-visibility customer escalations and incidents, coordinating Engineering, Product, Support Operations, and other stakeholders
  • Turn recurring customer problems and support trends into product feedback, process improvements, training, and reusable technical content
  • Create and maintain SOPs, knowledge articles, training materials, and retrospectives that improve team capability and consistency
  • Represent Technical Services in cross-functional and cross-region programs, driving execution through influence

Who You Are

  • You are a calm, empathetic technical leader who earns trust with customers, engineers, and cross-functional partners
  • You are comfortable leading through influence, ambiguity, and incomplete information
  • You use data to identify risks, prioritize work, and allocate team capacity
  • You balance hands-on customer support with coaching, quality management, and continuous improvement

What you need

The ideal candidate will have experience in most of the following areas:

  • Supporting customers through cases, chats, calls, and high-severity escalations. Preferred experience with running high-severity incidents and follow-the-sun procedures
  • Leading or mentoring a small team of highly technical support engineers
  • Strong troubleshooting experience with MongoDB Atlas or comparable cloud database platforms, including cloud infrastructure, Linux, networking, security, storage, and performance
  • A disciplined diagnostic process covering investigation, customer communication, escalation judgment, and root-cause analysis. Experience leveraging AI tools to broaden, improve and accelerate technical diagnostic processes preferred
  • Coordinating customer-impacting incidents and internal technical responders
  • Improving support operations through queue analysis, workload allocation, staffing coverage, training, and process improvement
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills across Engineering, Product, Security, Legal, Billing, Support Operations, and global Technical Services

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Cloud Manager, Compass, or large-scale relational or NoSQL databases
  • Experience managing FIN(Intercom), chat-support, case-management, or similar customer-support workflows
  • Experience leading incident reviews, RCAs, operational audits, or security/compliance improvements
  • Experience creating technical training, LMS content, knowledge programs, or enablement assessments
  • BONUS: Experience with DevOps, infrastructure-as-code, observability, automation, or scripting

Success Measures

  • First 3 months: Build relationships, understand team operations and customer demand, and begin contributing to complex escalations. Learn the Atlas product and master most common customer use cases
  • By 6 months: Independently lead escalations, establish recurring queue and quality reviews, improve coverage, and deliver at least one durable process or enablement improvement. Acquire Atlas Administrator certification
  • By 12 months: Demonstrate measurable improvement in service quality, escalation execution, team capability, coverage, and cross-functional delivery while remaining hands-on technically

title: Senior Software Engineer, Replication
descriptionHtml:
MongoDB’s Replication Team builds the infrastructure that enables high availability, fault tolerance, automatic failover, and tunable consistency. As a Senior Engineer on the team, you will design and implement distributed-systems features that protect data and keep applications available under demanding operating conditions.

You will work primarily in C++ on core database code, partner with engineers across MongoDB, and shape features central to major MongoDB releases. This is an opportunity to apply distributed-systems fundamentals to problems in data consistency, recovery time, replication performance, and operability.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based near one of our MongoDB office for our hybrid working model.

What you will do

  • Design and implement production features across the replicated data lifecycle
  • Improve restore and recovery workflows with attention to recovery time objectives
  • Improve replication lag, throughput, and flow control; measure performance and prevent or resolve regressions
  • Write production-quality C++ and the unit, integration, and system tests needed to demonstrate its correctness
  • Use JavaScript and Python where appropriate to extend test coverage and validate end-to-end behavior
  • Collaborate with partner engineering teams and stakeholders on large, cross-functional initiatives
  • Investigate distributed-systems issues raised by customers and Technical Support, communicate findings clearly, and deliver durable fixes
  • Participate in code reviews, design reviews, and technical discussions that improve the quality of the team’s work
  • Interview candidates and mentor junior engineers and interns

What you bring

Required

  • At least five years of experience programming, debugging, and performance-tuning distributed or highly concurrent software systems
  • Strong systems fundamentals, including multithreaded programming, concurrency, debugging, and performance profiling
  • Practical experience with distributed-systems concepts such as replication, data consistency and durability, recovery, fault tolerance, or consensus protocols
  • Experience working with complex production codebases and diagnosing problems that cross system boundaries
  • Strong written and verbal technical communication skills
  • A collaborative approach and the ability to make realistic assessments of project complexity and delivery risk

Preferred

  • Professional experience developing production software in C++
  • Familiarity with database internals or core components of data-processing systems
  • Experience with replication, recovery, data consistency, or Raft/another consensus protocol; direct experience with every area is not expected
  • Experience writing unit, integration, and end-to-end tests in C++, JavaScript, or Python
  • Experience responding to customer-impacting production issues in distributed systems
  • Experience mentoring engineers or interns and contributing to technical hiring

Candidates with additional relevant experience may be considered for more senior roles.

What success looks like

In your first month

  • Build a working understanding of MongoDB’s replication architecture, development workflow, and testing strategy
  • Begin resolving scoped bugs and contributing effectively to code reviews

In your first three months

  • Contribute production C++ code to a project targeted for an upcoming MongoDB release
  • Diagnose and resolve issues identified by testing, customers, or partner teams

In your first six months

  • Take regular ownership of code reviews and participate meaningfully in feature design reviews
  • Independently drive scoped technical work from investigation through implementation and validation

In your first twelve months

  • Lead the development of a new feature or substantial improvement from design through delivery
  • Help mentor new engineers and contribute to the team’s technical direction

title: Employer Brand Analyst
descriptionHtml:
MongoDB’s Employer Brand team owns how MongoDB is viewed as an employer and helps attract the talent needed to support our growth. We turn MongoDB’s strategy, EVP and employee experience into clear, credible stories and experiences across the candidate journey.

As an Employer Brand Analyst, you will support the delivery of our India Employer Brand strategy during a period of significant hiring growth. This is a hands-on individual contributor role focused on content creation, particularly video, and strong project execution. You will create, film and edit content, coordinate across teams and help prioritise activity against the most important hiring needs.

This position is a 12 month fixed term contract. You do not need an Employer Brand background, but strong content creation skills are essential. 

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.

Responsibilities

  • Create content across video, social and digital channels, including employee stories, short-form videos and campaign assets
  • Own video production from concept through delivery, including planning, filming and editing
  • Support Employer Brand campaigns across digital media, social, employee advocacy, PR and influencer activity
  • Coordinate projects across Recruiting, Social, Comms & PR, agencies, employees and technical leaders, managing timelines, reviews and approvals
  • Partner with Recruiting to prioritise activity based on changing hiring needs and the talent audiences where Employer Brand can have the greatest impact
  • Manage multiple priorities at once and adapt quickly as business and hiring priorities change
  • Support third-party employer profiles, awards activity and local internal communications

  • 2+ years of experience in content creation, social media, digital marketing, employer branding or a related field
  • Hands-on video production experience, including filming and editing
  • Experience using video editing tools such as Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, CapCut or similar
  • Strong project-management and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders
  • Good creative judgement and an understanding of what makes content engaging across social and digital channels
  • Confident cross-functional communicator who can work effectively with employees, leaders and external partners

title: Senior InfoSec Analyst
descriptionHtml:
About the Role

MongoDB is looking for a Senior InfoSec Analyst to join our Computer Security Incident Response Team. You will detect, investigate, and respond to security events across our corporate and cloud environments. You'll act as a technical lead on incidents, mentor analysts, and work with Engineering, IT, Legal, and Privacy teams to reduce risk.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.

What You'll Do

  • Lead investigations from triage through containment, scoping, remediation, and postmortem for security events
  • Analyze logs, endpoint telemetry, and cloud and SaaS audit data to distinguish true positives from false positives and reconstruct attacker or user activity timelines
  • Investigate credential and secret exposure, endpoint detections, phishing, data exposure, and policy violations such as unauthorized tool or AI usage
  • Automate repetitive response work using scripting and APIs, including enrichment, ticketing, and notification workflows
  • Maintain runbooks, playbooks, and severity and escalation standards
  • Contribute to employee-facing security guidance and awareness
  • Mentor junior analysts and help raise the team's investigative and communication standards

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years in security operations, incident response, detection engineering, or a related field
  • Hands-on experience leading incidents end to end, including clear stakeholder communication during and after an event
  • Strong log analysis skills in a SIEM and fluency with EDR tools
  • Working knowledge of cloud security (AWS, GCP, or Azure), identity and access management, and SaaS security
  • Solid understanding of attacker techniques and frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK
  • Ability to prioritize and make sound decisions under ambiguity and time pressure
  • Strong written communication, including incident reports and executive-ready summaries

Nice to Have

  • Experience integrating LLM or AI tooling into security workflows, or assessing AI-related risk
  • Familiarity with incident management platforms and Jira-based workflows
  • Relevant certifications (GCIH, GCFA, GCIA, CISSP, or similar)
  • Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience

title: Senior Customer Success Manager
descriptionHtml:
The Role

As a Senior Customer Success Manager, you are a highly experienced advisor helping customers navigate their most complex journeys on MongoDB. You’ll be responsible for maximizing customer lifetime value and success for a portfolio of Enterprise (G2000) accounts, acting as a lead strategic connector between your customers and cross-functional resources to achieve high-stakes business goals. You’ll drive customer retention, revenue realization, and long-term advocacy while mentoring team members to elevate the organization's collective impact. You’ll build deep relationships with senior stakeholders, understand intricate technical environments inside and out, and navigate global account teams to deliver measurable impact in high-pressure scenarios.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Advisory

  • Proactively identify and mitigate risks in accounts with significant technical complexity by advising on advanced operational strategies and best practices. Deliver cross-disciplinary solutions to critical customer challenges, accelerating time-to-value and guiding to achieve their business goals through their MongoDB deployments
  • Conduct comprehensive customer business reviews for Enterprise accounts, analyzing technical health and risk while translating insights into business-critical outcomes. Partner with senior technical and business leaders to align on objectives and champion mutual success plans that foster long-term advocacy

Account & Portfolio Management

  • Drive cross-functional development of account strategy and take ownership of elements that drive customer maturity, lifetime value, retention, and revenue realization. Proactively manage a diverse portfolio of Enterprise customers across various stages of the journey, creating and executing strategies to maximize value realization, advocacy, and long-term success
  • Track and report progress against key business outcomes, demonstrate control of the forecast by providing informed predictions to senior leadership for business predictability, and identify new opportunities to expand customer impact by collaborating with presales teams
  • Maintain meticulous hygiene in internal systems to ensure a single source of truth for customer insights and accurate territory analysis. Leverage AI fluency to enhance customer engagement processes, driving efficiency and productivity in delivering technical solutions

Internal Collaboration & Customer Advocacy

  • Amplify the voice of the customer within MongoDB, leveraging technical insights and customer perspectives to influence MongoDB’s product roadmap and coordinate across Sales, Product, Services, and Support to drive long-term health and value realization
  • Connect customers with the right internal resources, including Executive Sponsor engagement, while contributing to regional and global best practices to strengthen team success and act as a force multiplier for the organization
  • Support team growth by participating in the interview and ramping process for new hires, coaching peers to foster development and knowledge-sharing across the region

What You Will Bring

  • Relevant Experience: 7 to 10+ years in a technical customer-facing role (e.g., Technical Customer Success, Solutions Architecture/Engineering, Professional Services/Implementation, Technical Account Management) for a deeply technical, ideally consumption-based, product

title: Growth Marketing Manager
descriptionHtml:
As a Growth Marketing Manager focused on driving growth and adoption of Voyage AI by MongoDB, you will develop and execute growth programs that increase awareness, engagement, and continued usage across the Voyage AI customer journey. You will translate customer and developer needs into compelling lifecycle experiences, campaigns, and experiments across email, in-product, content, and emerging channels.

This role combines product-led growth, lifecycle marketing, and technical audience marketing. You will partner closely with Product, Product Marketing, Analytics, Builder Relations, and Data Science to identify growth opportunities, launch programs, and continuously optimize the Voyage AI customer journey—from discovery and onboarding through activation, adoption, and expansion.

You will be responsible for building measurable growth strategies, segmenting audiences, testing messaging and experiences, and using data to improve performance against key business and product adoption goals. The ideal candidate is a strategic and hands-on marketer who understands technical audiences, is familiar with the AI and LLM ecosystem, thrives in ambiguity, and can turn customer insights into high-impact programs that accelerate the growth of Voyage AI. You bring strong technical aptitude and can drive initiatives from initial strategy through cross-functional execution.

This is a highly visible role that requires natural leadership skills and the ability to work across multiple teams and levels. You are adept at thinking strategically and tactically to move work forward in a complex, cross-functional environment.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in the US for our hybrid working model.

In particular, you will be:

  • Partnering closely with Product to identify opportunities across the customer journey and develop experiences and programs that drive activation, adoption, and continued usage of Voyage AI
  • Designing and executing experiments across audiences, messaging, channels, and experiences to continuously optimize performance and identify scalable growth opportunities
  • Developing and executing growth strategies and programs in partnership with Growth Marketing and cross-functional teams, from opportunity identification through launch and optimization
  • Creating and curating relevant content for driving awareness and adoption, including crafting campaigns that support funnels and lifecycle stages
  • Performing strategic product, market, and customer analyses to identify new growth drivers or opportunities for improvement
  • Uncovering and leveraging new emerging channels and opportunities to accelerate growth and workload expansion
  • Monitoring and analyzing funnel and product adoption KPIs to understand performance, identify opportunities, and measure the impact of growth initiatives
  • Working collaboratively with our Product Marketing and Product team to align messaging and understand relevant product launches and moments to roll into each customer program or campaign

We’re looking for someone with …

  • 5+ years of B2D or B2B experience in growth marketing, with a focus on product-led growth and/or feature adoption and lifecycle marketing
  • Experience designing and executing cross-sell/up-sell strategies to expand customer adoption across product offerings, leveraging insights and tailored messaging to drive incremental growth
  • Deep understanding of marketing to developers or a technical audience
  • Working knowledge of the AI and LLM ecosystem, including how developers build AI applications and use models, APIs, and retrieval technologies, with the ability to quickly develop fluency in new technical concepts and products
  • Drive to provide the best possible experience to our customers and users
  • Understanding of and appreciation for the big picture (market, customers, company) but also the details to successfully scale programs
  • Passion to objectively measure your efforts and only make decisions based on data
  • A collaborative mindset - you love working with others and incorporating relevant feedback
  • An owner mentality - you take complete ownership of your tasks and champion efforts to get them to completion
  • Flexibility and adaptability - you enjoy working in ambiguity. You are calm and effective under pressure and able to pivot quickly. You excel at task prioritization and proper evaluation of situational urgency
  • Focus and drive - you know what matters and apply yourself with gusto, continuously exploring how much faster you can learn and execute
  • Experience or have a working knowledge of product-led growth strategies and KPIs
  • Strong writing skills and the ability to storyboard campaign themes and messages to develop compelling campaigns to bring to market

title: Digital Success Manager
descriptionHtml:
MongoDB’s mission is to empower innovators to create, transform, and disrupt industries by unleashing the power of software and data. Our Customer Success organisation combines business and technical expertise to help customers realise the full potential of their investment in MongoDB.

This role sits within our Digital Customer Success Strategy team. This team exists to help manage and evolve how we serve customers through digital and agentic experiences. The team helps MongoDB deliver a consistent, personalised and relevant experience using data, lifecycle programmes, automation, and human judgement where it matters most. 

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.

The Role

We are looking for a Digital Success Manager to foster high-impact customer relationships at scale by leveraging data, automation, and digital channels to deliver tailored, value-led experiences. Blending strategic insight with digital programmes, you will help advance our Digital-First strategy.

Serving as a subject matter expert across a high volume of accounts, you will build deep knowledge of your assigned region, analyzing retention trends and uncovering new ways to add value. You will drive customer outcome strategies using scalable digital channels, automated health-score triggers, and 1:many outreach, stepping in as the human-in-the-loop when judgment or nuance is needed to define the next best action.

Because this role is still evolving, we seek an entrepreneurial self-starter who is curious, driven, and excited to take initiative, and who uses AI hands-on to accelerate their work, conduct research, and manage programmes while understanding its limitations. 

Cross-functional partnership is central to this role: you will build a deep understanding of the priorities, programmes, and customer work underway across Sales and partner teams, then use that context to shape Digital Customer Success so our solutions connect with and complement existing efforts rather than being built in silos.

Who You Are

Our ideal candidate thrives in dynamic environments, is passionate and knowledgeable about AI, and brings strong analytical skills paired with a deep, customer-centric mindset. You are:

  • AI-Native & Hands-On: Genuinely excited and knowledgeable about AI, and you use it in your day-to-day work, building your own dashboards, running your own research, and managing your own programmes rather than waiting on others to build the tooling for you
  • Curious & Driven: Self-directed, endlessly curious, and always looking for the next insight, improvement, or opportunity to add value
  • Independent, Yet a Strong Cross-Functional Partner: Comfortable working independently and owning your patch, while proactively building strong partnerships across Sales and other teams. You invest in understanding their priorities, programmes, expertise, and work already underway, then use that knowledge to align early and co-design solutions that complement existing efforts rather than working in silos
  • Data-Driven & Analytical: Skilled at analyzing customer trends and data to unlock value and optimize customer outcomes at scale
  • Digital Channels Specialist: Experienced in using scalable 1:many digital engagement models and outreach strategies to connect with customers effectively
  • Strategic Thinker: Able to translate customer insights into strategic initiatives that advance Digital-First goals and drive long-term success

What You’ll Do:

  • Serve as the face of Digital CS for your region, building deep knowledge of your assigned region and acting as the key domain expert, advocate, and human-in-the-loop escalation point for digital customer success strategies in your region
  • Lead customer engagement and retention through digital-first programmes, designing 1:many workshops, webinars, and targeted digital touchpoints. Drive the regional 1:many strategy for our long tail segment, and drive selective 1:1 interactions where appropriate to ensure high impact
  • Partner closely with Sales, account teams, and cross-functional partners to deeply understand customers and the priorities, programmes, and solutions already underway across teams. Use that knowledge to align objectives and co-design digital-first programmes that connect with, complement, and scale existing efforts rather than duplicate work or build in silos. Share regional insights and unlock enablement opportunities, improve onboarding, and mitigate churn
  • Use AI tools and techniques to build your own dashboards, conduct your own research, and manage your own programmes, bringing curiosity and initiative to how you work, not just what you deliver.

What You'll Bring:

  • Experience: 3+ years in Customer Success, account management or a similar role; familiarity with scaled or digital models across onboarding and consumption phases
  • AI Fluency: Genuine enthusiasm for and hands-on experience with AI tools, with a track record of using them independently to build dashboards, automate research, or manage programmes
  • Mindset: Curious, driven, and entrepreneurial, comfortable building processes from scratch and developing innovative solutions that deliver measurable results, while working both independently and as a strong partner to others
  • Adaptability: Comfortable navigating fast-moving shifts in scope, strategy, and goals
  • Tech-Savviness: Familiarity with the tools and technologies that support digital engagement (e.g., automation tools, CRMs, CS software)
  • Analytical Acumen: An ability to analyze data and extract actionable insights for program optimization

title: 2027 - Summer Software Engineer Intern, Dublin
descriptionHtml:
We’re seeking curious minds like yours to collaborate with full-time engineers and cross functional teammates, learn development standard methodologies, and gain practical software engineering experience.

Software engineering interns are fully integrated into software engineering teams across our Product and Technology organization. Interns spend their summer pushing production-level code to make lasting contributions across MongoDB’s products and services for our internal teams, external customers, and developer end users.

This is a 10 week internship starting in June 2027.

What we are looking for in you (qualifications)

  • In the process of receiving a Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
  • Have a foundation in computer science theory, with proficiencies in data structures, algorithms, and software design.
  • Fluent in any one of the following programming languages: Java, Python, Go, C++, Javascript, Node.js - or a comparable object-oriented programming language.

title: Solutions Architect
descriptionHtml:
At MongoDB, we're looking for a technically accomplished Solutions Architect who thrives on solving complex problems, understanding how systems work, and helping customers make better architectural decisions. You'll work with established MongoDB customers running production applications, applying hands-on expertise across databases, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, application architecture, and emerging AI technologies.

As part of a globally distributed Solutions Architecture team, you'll engage with customers across multiple EMEA markets rather than being dedicated to a small number of accounts. This regional reach offers exposure to diverse industries, technologies, and architectural challenges, with opportunities to recognize patterns, build trusted technical relationships, and influence decisions across a broad customer landscape. You'll have the autonomy to drive meaningful technical engagements while drawing on the expertise of specialists and colleagues worldwide.

We value architects who look beyond the immediate problem, investigate underlying causes, challenge assumptions, and bring informed technical perspectives to customer conversations.

You'll help customers optimize what they run today while influencing the architectures and applications they build tomorrow.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin for our hybrid working model.

What You'll Do

  • Optimize Production Architectures: Analyze MongoDB workloads, query execution, indexing, data models, cluster configurations, and resource utilization. Identify performance bottlenecks, scalability constraints, and cost optimization opportunities
  • Engineer for Resilience and Scale: Evaluate distributed architectures, replication, sharding, high availability, backup and recovery, and disaster recovery strategies. Help customers understand technical trade-offs and design for evolving production requirements
  • Think Beyond the Database: Assess how MongoDB interacts with application services, APIs, networking, security, cloud infrastructure, and adjacent technologies. Identify opportunities to simplify architectures, reduce technical debt, and improve operational efficiency
  • Shape Future-State Architecture: Guide technical discussions around application modernization, cloud-native design, and AI-powered applications. Explore architectural considerations involving Search, Vector Search, RAG, intelligent agents, and their integration with operational data
  • Lead Technical Discovery and Design: Engage developers, architects, and engineering leaders to investigate complex challenges, analyze technical evidence, assess architectural trade-offs, and develop actionable recommendations. Provide hands-on technical investigation and targeted validation to guide decisions, rather than owning ongoing support cases or implementation projects
  • Improve How Customers Build and Operate: Look beyond technology to understand development workflows, operational practices, team capabilities, and architectural ownership. Identify opportunities to improve how applications are developed, deployed, and managed
  • Build Trusted Technical Relationships: Establish credibility through technical expertise, curiosity, and sound judgment. Proactively identify architectural risks and opportunities, challenge assumptions constructively, and collaborate with MongoDB Technical Support, Professional Services, and product specialists when deeper troubleshooting or implementation expertise is required

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering, solutions architecture, technical consulting, or related technical roles, including customer-facing technical engagement
  • 2+ years of professional programming or scripting experience using languages such as Python, Java, JavaScript/Node.js, C#, C++, or SQL
  • Strong understanding of database technologies, distributed systems, modern application architectures, and high availability
  • Practical experience investigating technical issues, analyzing performance, and evaluating architectural trade-offs
  • Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure and application architectures on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
  • Ability to engage confidently with developers, architects, and technical leaders, translating complex technical findings into clear recommendations
  • Intellectual curiosity, strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to independently drive technical engagements

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with MongoDB, Atlas, NoSQL, or relational database technologies
  • Familiarity with query optimization, indexing, data modeling, replication, and database scaling
  • Exposure to Kubernetes, Kafka, microservices, APIs, event-driven architectures, or application modernization
  • Understanding of AI application patterns, Vector Search, RAG, or agentic systems

title: Senior Product Security Engineer, Assessments
descriptionHtml:
Who You Are

You are a seasoned security professional with a deep passion for uncovering vulnerabilities and improving product security through technical assessments and hands-on penetration testing. You pride yourself on being able to execute sophisticated security tests, identify issues, and implement pragmatic solutions, all while keeping the customer experience central. You enjoy working collaboratively across teams and have the ability to communicate complex technical concepts in a clear, approachable manner.

Who We Are

The MongoDB Product Security organization is a diverse collection of individuals working together to scale MongoDB’s security, both security of the products themselves and the security features we offer to customers. The team is responsible for assessing the security of our products including MongoDB Atlas Cloud, Ops Manager, Kubernetes Operator, and the MongoDB Server (Community and Enterprise editions). Our team provides assurance that new MongoDB products and features are built to meet our customers’ high security needs through rigorous threat modeling, code analysis, and penetration testing.

The MongoDB Product Security organization works with software engineers to design, implement, and operate systems in a manner that protects our customers and their data. It is a multidisciplinary team that covers product, software, cloud, infrastructure, and operational security concerns.

The Product Security team:

  • Conducts rigorous penetration testing and security assessments of MongoDB products
  • Develops and deploys advanced AI tooling and modern automation to enhance assessment efficiency and workflows
  • Works closely with Product and Engineering teams to advocate for security best practices and remediate vulnerabilities
  • Builds a developer-driven security program where there is tight integration between engineering artifacts, process, and tooling
  • Uses software architecture and coding patterns to reduce the impact of security issues

Role Responsibilities

As a Product Security Engineer specializing in security assessments, your responsibilities will include:

  • Leading the evolution of our internal security and assessment processes by leveraging AI-based analysis to enhance threat modeling, penetration testing workflows, and assessment efficiency
  • Conducting deep-dive penetration tests and hands-on security assessments of MongoDB products, including architecture reviews, threat modeling, static/dynamic code analysis, and vulnerability exploit verification
  • Researching, prototyping, and executing new attack vectors and techniques to strengthen our defensive measures
  • Collaborating closely with engineering teams to advocate security best practices and to remediate identified vulnerabilities
  • Recommending secure coding patterns, container security measures, and secrets management strategies to strengthen our products
  • Partnering with product development teams to ensure secure delivery across cloud environments, applications, and systems
  • Coordinating closely with the red team and detection functions and processes to address potential security incidents or implement new defensive or monitoring capabilities

Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience in application security, product security or penetration testing roles, including manual and automated approaches
  • Proven expertise in product security assessment techniques such as threat modeling, penetration testing, red teaming, and secure code reviews
  • Some programming and scripting skills, with familiarity in one or more languages such as Python or Golang
  • Hands-on experience with one or more major cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Experience leading threat modeling workshops and discussing security issues with engineers
  • Comfortable explaining and communicating technical concepts and findings to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Demonstrated ownership of security initiatives, with the ability to deliver results autonomously or collaboratively
  • Working knowledge of large-scale distributed systems and container technologies (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker)
  • Knowledge of security tools and frameworks for cloud and application security

Success in This Role Looks Like

  • Driving improvements in MongoDB’s product security through end-to-end ownership of security assessments
