title: Staff Product Manager, Atlas Infinite
descriptionHtml:
The Staff Product Manager is an Individual Contributor (IC) product leader responsible for a broad platform surface for Atlas Infinite at MongoDB. Atlas Infinite is the largest architectural innovation in MongoDB Atlas ever, purpose-built to handle today's speed and scale of development and demand. 

In this position, you will own and solve end-to-end problems around the user experience and database experience of Atlas Infinite, including but limited to feature discovery, activation, monetization, and retention. You will see patterns, opportunities, and risks across areas, own cross-team product and architectural trade-offs, establish reusable standards for PM craft, and align senior stakeholders around multi-year bets. You have deep knowledge of cloud database platforms, distributed data systems, and enterprise product development.

You will partner closely with cross-functional engineering leaders, product peers, and executive stakeholders to drive outcomes across organizational boundaries, guiding a portfolio spanning Atlas Infinite's disaggregated compute and storage architecture, production workload readiness, migration and Atlas interoperability, and the new customer experiences this architecture may make possible. You will not inherit a closed list of future features: part of your mandate is to discover opportunities we have not yet articulated and challenge assumptions about which problems matter most. With AWS public preview now live, you will help turn real workload evidence into a credible path to GA and subsequent releases, in close partnership with the existing team.

This role can be based out of a MongoDB office or remotely in the United States.

Responsibilities

  • Interlinked Vision & Multi-Year Bets: Set and champion a product vision across Atlas Infinite's capabilities, while actively discovering opportunities that are not on today's roadmap or fit any single team's remit. Explore what decoupled compute and storage could make possible for developers, enterprises, and emerging AI workloads; use hypotheses, customer evidence, prototypes, and market signals to uncover needs we have not yet named. Branching, on-demand compute, and instant recovery are examples of possible bets. Make the case for investment and prioritization, including build-vs-buy considerations, and distinguish exploratory vision from release commitments
  • Cross-Team Execution: Along with program management, own execution health across workstreams, negotiating sequencing, scope, and resource trade-offs with engineering leaders and peer PMs where you have no direct authority. Ensure preview-to-GA readiness, roadmaps, and dependencies across database, storage, Atlas platform, migration, backup, security, and cloud infrastructure teams are aligned and connect to company objectives
  • Execution & Research Standards: Establish lightweight operating practices and shared customer/market research frameworks that make workload qualification, customer-representative testing, win/loss analysis, launch readiness, and post-launch learning consistent across the portfolio. Use data to drive decisions without overburdening delivery teams
  • Product Health: Resolve complex post-launch escalations when the root cause spans architecture, performance, migration, observability, supportability, or unclear ownership. Turn customer and operational signals into systemic product fixes rather than one-off workarounds
  • Customer Discovery: Identify needs and competitive dynamics that cut across product areas. Look beyond requests from today's customers to discover emerging jobs-to-be-done, surprising uses of the architecture, and reasons customers do not choose MongoDB at all. Combine interviews, workload and pricing evidence, product analytics, field feedback, and experiments to test known hypotheses and uncover unknowns; reorient the roadmap when the evidence warrants it
  • Outbound & GTM: Partner with product marketing, pricing, sales, solutions architecture, customer success, documentation, and support on high-stakes customer engagements, product positioning, and omni-channel marketing. Establish ideal customer profile; ensure claims and migration guidance match demonstrated capabilities; translate successful adoption and enablement approaches into shared playbooks
  • Executive Alignment: Synthesize customer experience, technical readiness, adoption, and commercial impact into clear, confident product stories for senior leadership. Surface cross-area risks and progress early, including trade-offs between new-workload growth, customer savings, and changes to existing Atlas usage
  • Mentorship: Mentor PMs across the area, sharing frameworks for cross-team alignment, customer evidence, technical trade-offs, multi-year bets, and leadership communication

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of product management or equivalent product leadership experience, with a track record personally shaping strategy and outcomes for complex technical platforms across multiple teams, rather than only coordinating delivery
  • Strong technical fluency in cloud databases, distributed data systems, storage infrastructure, developer experiences, or an adjacent developer platform. Able to reason with engineers about architecture, performance, availability, data movement, and trade-offs without needing to be the system designer
  • A demonstrated ability to discover opportunities beyond the current roadmap: connect technical possibilities to unmet customer needs, formulate and test hypotheses, notice surprising patterns, and change direction when evidence challenges the original thesis
  • Experience taking a complex product from early adoption toward dependable, broader use while protecting space for longer-term innovation; able to make explicit trade-offs among customer trust, technical readiness, speed, and investment
  • Proven ability to influence without authority, negotiating sequencing and resource trade-offs across partner teams with competing priorities
  • Commercial and analytical judgment: able to assess workload-level value, adoption and usage evidence, competitive alternatives, pricing and unit economics, and the impact of a new product on an existing portfolio. Comfortable with build-vs-buy questions where relevant
  • Ability to raise the quality of customer discovery and product decision-making across teams through useful shared methods and mentorship, without mistaking more process for better outcomes
  • Exceptional communication skills: able to explain a technical and commercial thesis, its uncertainties, and the evidence that would change your mind to engineers, customers, executives, and go-to-market partners

Success Measures

  • In 3 months you will have built a shared picture of which workloads Atlas Infinite serves well today, where customers struggle, what must be true for broader adoption, and what remains unknown. You will have clarified ownership with peer PMs and engineering, established baseline measures, and identified the highest-value questions to investigate
  • In 6 months you will have influenced consequential roadmap and GA-readiness decisions with customer-representative evidence; articulated a compelling, revisable view of where Infinite can create distinctive customer value beyond GA; and built a learning agenda with clear tests and decision points for both known bets and newly emerging opportunities
  • In 12 months the portfolio will show measurable progress against its established baselines for qualified adoption, customer experience, and readiness for broader workloads. Important bets will have advanced, changed, or been stopped for explicit reasons; cross-team investments will have produced customer value; and the team will be better equipped to recognize and act on opportunities that were not visible at the start of the year

title: Principal Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
MongoDB's Global Security Organization (GSO) is looking for a Principal Security Engineer. The GSO secures MongoDB's products, infrastructure, and the trust our customers place in us — spanning product security, corporate security, and risk, and working across engineering, go-to-market, and corporate development to keep security moving at the same speed as the business.

The Principal Security Engineer will serve as a senior technical anchor for the team. This is a deep individual-contributor role that will stay hands-on with hard security and architecture problems, form sharp independent opinions, and know how to debate, align, and commit once GSO has made a call.  

Key topic areas will include collaborating with our product teams to ensure identity and permission models meet customer needs for our new autonomous agent platform and working with integration security teams to push the envelope on automated detection, reproduction, and remediation of security vulnerabilities via AI.  What we need here is depth, judgment, and the ability to build up the bench of senior technical talent around you.

This role can be based out of our NYC or Seattle office or remotely in the North America region.

Responsibilities

  • Maintain real technical depth in security and in MongoDB's product architecture — compute, network, and storage — deep enough to evaluate actual risk rather than apply generic best practice
  • Form independent, well-reasoned opinions on security and architecture decisions, and voice them even when they cut against consensus or a leader's default plan
  • Push teams to move faster when process or over-engineering is introducing complexity without reducing risk — and push teams to slow down when GTM pressure is outrunning a clear-eyed view of the risk
  • Debate hard, then align, then commit: help the org land on the right call, then execute on it
  • Seed and grow a working community of senior ICs embedded in security operations, product security, and enterprise security — connecting people, sharing knowledge, and creating the venues (formal or informal) for that to happen
  • Lead time-boxed, high-stakes, cross-functional engagements such as M&A security due diligence and partner risk assessments, often with incomplete information and a short runway
  • Draw on your own expertise where it applies, and quickly figure out how to close knowledge gaps elsewhere — staying accountable for the outcome either way

Requirements

  • 12+ years of experience in security engineering, software engineering, or a related discipline, including senior individual-contributor or technical-lead experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Deep, credible technical expertise in security, plus working depth across compute, network, and storage architecture
  • A track record of forming and defending independent technical positions, along with the judgment to know when to stop debating and commit
  • Experience influencing without formal authority, including with management and cross-functional partners, in both directions — accelerating and slowing down decisions
  • Comfort owning ambiguous, deadline-driven work such as M&A diligence or partner risk reviews, and being accountable for the result even without the full picture upfront
  • A genuine interest in mentoring and connecting other senior engineers, without needing a management title to do it

Don't feel that you meet all of the requirements? We encourage you to apply anyway — studies show strong candidates sometimes rule themselves out prematurely. MongoDB has a diverse, inclusive, equitable, and high-performing environment, and we want to keep improving our ability to deliver for customers.

Nice to Haves

  • Direct experience leading M&A security due diligence or partner/vendor risk assessments
  • Background spanning multiple layers of the stack (e.g., network and storage, or application and infrastructure security)
  • A history of building or growing technical communities of practice

Success in This Role Means

  • Leadership trusts your technical judgment on the hardest, most ambiguous calls
  • Your willingness to disagree — in either direction, faster or slower — makes decisions better, not just louder
  • A real community of senior security talent has formed around you in GSO

title: Senior Staff Technical Program Manager, Global Security Office
descriptionHtml:
Senior Staff Technical Program Manager, Global Security Office

MongoDB’s mission is to empower innovators to create, transform, and disrupt industries by unleashing the power of software and data. MongoDB Atlas and MongoDB’s broader data platform help organizations build, scale, and run modern applications across cloud providers and environments.

The Global Security Office protects MongoDB, our customers, and the trust that enables our business. The GSO works across security domains and business functions to improve our security posture, reduce risk, and help MongoDB deliver secure products and services at scale.

As a Senior Staff Technical Program Manager, you will be a senior individual contributor and program leader for the GSO. The role will have two primary focus areas:

  • Directly lead and manage strategic programs which require senior level oversight due to high business impact and highly complex cross functional dependencies
  • Establish the standard by which technical program managers across the team will execute and report program status, including building a community of progress among program managers who are distributed across reporting lines within GSO. 

This role is designed for a technical program leader who can operate at the intersection of security, technology, risk, and business execution. The successful candidate will bring rigor without unnecessary process, create clarity from ambiguity, and build systems that help security teams and their partners execute predictably as MongoDB scales.

Responsibilities 

  • Serve as the senior program owner and trusted advisor for cross-functional security initiatives, partnering with executive sponsors and functional leads  to establish accountability, sequencing, decision rights, and success measures.
  • Establish a consistent operating system for GSO programs and operational work, including program definitions, roadmaps, milestones, risk and issue management, decision logs, and outcome tracking.
  • Build integrated visibility into GSO priorities and progress, connecting team-level goals and workstreams to SMART goals and other company-level planning and review mechanisms.
  • Bring knowledge of the security domain to complement program management rigor such that risks can be addressed faster. 
  • Drive convergence on project issues when teams disagree, resolve cross-functional deadlocks, and escalate only when decisions carry material, strategic, organizational, or enterprise risk.
  • Identify systemic opportunities to improve execution, including automation, AI-enabled workflows, reusable mechanisms, and common measures that reduce manual effort and improve decision quality.
  • Model MongoDB’s Leadership Commitment by communicating clearly, making trade-offs visible, maintaining high standards, and leading calmly and inclusively through change.

Requirements

  • 10+ years driving large-scale, cross-functional technical programs across engineering, security, and product organizations, with a track record of delivering high-visibility outcomes in ambiguous environments.
  • Deep technical fluency and credibility in modern tech and security domains—such as cloud/infrastructure security, IAM, product security, resilience, or enterprise architecture—with the ability to evaluate system-level dependencies and trade-offs.
  • Proven ability to define multi-year roadmaps, operationalize quarterly goals, and balance pragmatic process with execution agility.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering large-scale, cross-functional initiatives, program strategies and roadmaps with significant technical complexity, ambiguity, and executive visibility.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management skills with a demonstrated ability to build consensus, hold teams accountable, and drive alignment across competing priorities without formal authority.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication, skilled at producing both crisp executive narratives and detailed technical artifacts for engineering teams.
  • Strong analytical data-oriented mindset focused on defining clear metrics, evaluating trade-offs with evidence, and staying composed when resolving high-stakes challenges.
  • Experience with modern program and work-management tools, such as Jira, Confluence, Google Workspace, or comparable platforms. 

Nice to Have

  • Experience building or scaling a security program within a high-growth technology or SaaS company.
  • Experience with secure SDLC, threat modeling, security assessments, vulnerability management, security incident readiness, audit or compliance programs, customer security commitments, or security automation.
  • Experience partnering with Product Management and Engineering to connect security risk reduction, customer trust, delivery outcomes, and business priorities.
  • Experience using automation, data platforms, scripting, or generative AI to improve program operations and decision quality.
  • Experience mentoring TPMs or leading a TPM community of practice.
  • Relevant technical, security, or program-management certification.

Success Measures

  • Delivery of selected strategic GSO programs with clear outcomes, accountable owners, and predictable progress.
  • Improved visibility into GSO portfolio health, including meaningful measures of progress, risk, dependencies, capacity, and outcomes.
  • Faster and higher-quality decisions on complex security trade-offs, with clear escalation paths and durable decision records.
  • Consistent adoption of scalable program-management mechanisms, operating rhythms, and reporting practices across GSO.
  • Measurable reduction in execution friction, avoidable surprises, and manual coordination through process improvement, automation, and AI-enabled workflows.
  • Stronger cross-functional alignment among GSO, Product & Technology, IT, and other partner organizations.
  • Sustained improvements in security posture, operational resilience, customer trust, or other outcomes associated with the programs owned.

descriptionHtml:

title: Senior Software Engineer (SRE), Infrastructure Security
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

At MongoDB, we are building the future of data platforms with MongoDB Atlas; our fully managed, multi-cloud database service. The Infrastructure Security (InfraSec) team sits within Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) in the CTO organization. We are an engineering team dedicated to building the security infrastructure, primitives, and reusable controls that protect MongoDB Atlas across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud (GCP).

InfraSec operates on a preventative, enabling model: rather than acting as a manual approval gatekeeper or compliance auditor, we develop automated guardrails and platform capabilities. We integrate security directly into the platform runtime, CI/CD, and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) workflows so engineering teams can operate securely at scale without friction.

This role can be based out of NYC, San Francisco, Seattle, Austin, Dallas, Denver, Chicago, Washington DC, & Boston.

What You’ll Do

  • Harden hosts and containerized workloads using Linux security mechanisms (AppArmor, SELinux, seccomp, cgroups) and eBPF-based tooling (Cilium, Tetragon)
  • Secure containerized infrastructure across multi-cloud environments via RBAC, network policies, admission controls (Gatekeeper), and runtime threat detection.
  • Build and manage automated services for Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), workload identity, vulnerability management, and access controls across AWS, Azure, and GCP
  • Write production-quality code and leverage Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform) to version, test, and deploy security controls as code
  • Build real-time security monitoring, logging, and alerting systems to detect anomalies and track security posture at Atlas scale
  • Lead initiatives across their full lifecycle; from threat modeling and architectural design to implementation, rollout, and long-term production reliability

What We’re Looking For

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 5+ years in SRE, Infrastructure Engineering, or Cloud Security Engineering
  • Strong coding skills in Go (Golang), Python, C, C++, or Rust.
  • Proven track record of building and operating large-scale distributed systems or cloud platform infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience using Terraform, CloudFormation, or Ansible for automated infrastructure provisioning.
  • Demonstrated experience owning infrastructure in Linux, Kubernetes, and at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Practical experience with eBPF-based security tooling (Cilium, Falco, Tetragon)
  • Direct ownership of Cloud Security and Workload Identity platforms
  • Multi-cloud expertise spanning AWS, Azure, and GCP
  • Production exposure to low-level Linux security mechanisms (seccomp, AppArmor, SELinux, cgroups)

title: IT Support Specialist 2
descriptionHtml:
Serving as the EMEA anchor for MongoDB's Global Enterprise Technology (GET) team, this position acts as a primary technical DRI for enterprise user support, office technology, and regional incident escalation in the GMT/IST time zone. You hold end-to-end operational responsibility for delivering high-touch, reliable IT services—from onboarding hardware provisioning and daily ticket triage to AV room management and high-visibility regional event support.

This role prioritizes proactive support over passive ticketing. By monitoring system health, verifying endpoint configurations, and identifying friction points early, you ensure business continuity for teams across the EMEA region. You combine strong technical diagnostics across macOS, Windows, identity, and SaaS tooling with hands-on AV expertise for Dublin meeting spaces, acting as a trusted partner to local leaders and cross-functional teams.

The operational foundation of GET relies on intelligent automation, structured workflows, and data-informed decision-making. Routine health checks, diagnostics, and repetitive provisioning tasks are streamlined through intelligent tooling, freeing your focus for complex technical problem-solving, live event execution, and relationship building. In this environment, you are encouraged to leverage emerging AI productivity tools and automation scripts to continuously optimize service delivery.

Success in this role requires technical versatility, disciplined execution in shared team queues, discreet handling of sensitive data, and clear communication across a globally distributed IT organization.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin for our hybrid working model.

Key Responsibilities

1. Enterprise Support & Technical Ownership

  • Queue Ownership: Ownership of the regional end-user support queue. Deliver rapid, high-quality resolution for macOS, Windows, identity, mobile, and SaaS software issues across the EMEA region
  • Relationship Management: Partner closely with regional department heads, office administrators, and local stakeholders to maintain strong alignment between IT services and business needs
  • Proactive Resolution: Monitor endpoint health and system alerts to remediate device, network, or security issues before they impact productivity
  • SLA & Workflow Tracking: Keep structured ticket workflows updated with clear diagnostic notes, tracking work against key SLAs (MTTR, FTTR, and CSAT)

2. Lifecycle Management & Onboarding

  • Hardware Provisioning: Manage procurement, device configuration, endpoint deployment, and asset tracking for laptops, mobile devices, and peripherals
  • Onboarding Execution: Ensure new hires receive fully configured hardware and role-based application entitlements prior to their start date
  • Offboarding & Asset Recovery: Execute secure, compliant offboarding workflows, ensuring timely hardware collection, account deprovisioning, and data destruction standards
  • Confidentiality & Data Governance: Handle all employee data, sensitive operational context, and security entitlements in strict compliance with company confidentiality standards and NDA requirements

3. Global Handoffs & Incident Response

  • Follow-the-Sun Operational Coverage: Participate in the global 24/7 handoff standard—APAC → EMEA → AMERICAS—passing overnight incidents, open risks, and active escalation threads at shift boundaries
  • Escalation Coordination: Hand specialized infrastructure or security elements to L3/Engineering teams while retaining ownership of user-impacting regional threads
  • On-Call Rotation: Participate in the regional after-hours or weekend incident rotation, applying quick diagnostic workarounds and escalating according to severity matrices

4. AV Systems, Office Infrastructure & Events

  • Conference Room Maintenance: Maintain operational readiness for Dublin office Zoom Rooms, Teams rooms, microphones, displays, and control systems
  • Event Support: Lead technical preparation and live support for EMEA All Hands, town halls, quarterly business reviews, and regional leadership meetings
  • Network & Workplace Collaboration: Partner with Network/AV Engineering and Facilities teams to resolve physical office connectivity issues, room remediation, and hardware upgrades

5. Process Discipline & AI-Driven Efficiency

  • Structured Ticket Hygiene: Maintain accurate ticket estimates, DRI tags, and clear definitions of done in Jira or similar enterprise service desk tooling
  • Automation & Toil Reduction: Utilize AI agent-assist tools, virtual assistants, and workflow scripting (Python, PowerShell, or API integrations) to eliminate manual tasks
  • Knowledge Management: Author and update internal technical runbooks and end-user self-service documentation in Confluence

Success Measures & Expectations

In this role, success is measured by concrete operational outcomes and your ability to scale regional IT support alongside enterprise growth:

  • Service Excellence & SLA Rigor: Maintain a consistent track record of hitting target SLAs (≥95%) across regional queues with flat-to-up CSAT scores, shifting the operational ratio decisively from reactive ticket firefighting to proactive, automated issue resolution
  • Day-One Readiness: Achieve 100% on-time hardware and identity provisioning for new hires across EMEA prior to day one, with zero role-based entitlement gaps and auditable asset tracking across all regional inventory
  • Global Incident Discipline: Execute seamless follow-the-sun handoffs (APAC → EMEA → AMERICAS) and maintain zero unacknowledged critical incidents during regional on-call shifts, owning incident communication end-to-end
  • Flawless Executive & Event Delivery: Deliver zero preventable AV or operational failures during regional All Hands, town halls, and executive QBRs through structured pre-flight checks and continuous conference room testing
  • Operational Leverage: Deliver at least one measurable toil-reduction or automation initiative per quarter (leveraging scripts, API integrations, or AI tooling) that tangibly reduces repetitive operational overhead

Requirements

Required Qualifications

Req ID: 3273580373

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer, InfraSec
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

At MongoDB, we are building the future of data platforms with MongoDB Atlas; our fully managed, multi-cloud database service. The Infrastructure Security (InfraSec) team sits within Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) in the CTO organization. We are an engineering team dedicated to building the security infrastructure, primitives, and reusable controls that protect MongoDB Atlas across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud (GCP).

InfraSec operates on a preventative, enabling model: rather than acting as a manual approval gatekeeper or compliance auditor, we develop automated guardrails and platform capabilities. We integrate security directly into the platform runtime, CI/CD, and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) workflows so engineering teams can operate securely at scale without friction.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin for our hybrid working model.

What You’ll Do

  • Harden hosts and containerized workloads using Linux security mechanisms (AppArmor, SELinux, seccomp, cgroups) and eBPF-based tooling (Cilium, Tetragon)
  • Secure containerized infrastructure across multi-cloud environments via RBAC, network policies, admission controls (Gatekeeper), and runtime threat detection.
  • Build and manage automated services for Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), workload identity, vulnerability management, and access controls across AWS, Azure, and GCP
  • Write production-quality code and leverage Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform) to version, test, and deploy security controls as code
  • Build real-time security monitoring, logging, and alerting systems to detect anomalies and track security posture at Atlas scale
  • Lead initiatives across their full lifecycle; from threat modeling and architectural design to implementation, rollout, and long-term production reliability

What We’re Looking For

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 5+ years in SRE, Infrastructure Engineering, or Cloud Security Engineering
  • Strong coding skills in Go (Golang), Python, C, C++, or Rust.
  • Proven track record of building and operating large-scale distributed systems or cloud platform infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience using Terraform, CloudFormation, or Ansible for automated infrastructure provisioning.
  • Demonstrated experience owning infrastructure in Linux, Kubernetes, and at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Practical experience with eBPF-based security tooling (Cilium, Falco, Tetragon)
  • Direct ownership of Cloud Security and Workload Identity platforms
  • Multi-cloud expertise spanning AWS, Azure, and GCP
  • Production exposure to low-level Linux security mechanisms (seccomp, AppArmor, SELinux, cgroups)

title: Senior Software Engineer, Atlas API Experience - Integrations
descriptionHtml:
The Atlas API Experience (APIx) teams are part of MongoDB Atlas Data Services, a diverse group of individuals who develop the capabilities to run MongoDB globally (see MongoDB Atlas). Our software and services allow users to deploy fault-tolerant, scalable, globally distributed MongoDB clusters in minutes. APIx’s mission is to craft delightful experiences for developers of all levels onboarding and working with MongoDB. 

We're looking for a Software Engineer to join our growing team, building tooling to automate infrastructure on any cloud and developing MongoDB integrations that seamlessly integrate into partner frameworks or solutions. As part of the team, you will propose, design, build and support product features supporting integrations such as AWS Cloud Formation & AWS CDK, Terraform & Vault. You will build our next generation Atlas SDK for an expanding set of languages. Automation & DevOps is at our core, with the number of Integrations & SDKs continuing to grow. You will be part of building a platform that allows our team to scale with that growth.

We are looking for passionate, intrinsically-motivated software engineers who consistently work to grow their skills and want to take their careers to the next level. No prior experience with MongoDB technologies is required! During interviews, you will meet most of our team and have the opportunity to ask questions about working at MongoDB. We pride ourselves on our team's culture and on being an inclusive and collaborative group that Builds Together.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin for our hybrid working model.

What will you do?

  • Propose, design, implement and support product features for MongoDB Atlas DevOps & SDK tooling, such as MongoDB Atlas Cloud Formation Resources, MongoDB Atlas Terraform Provider & MongoDB Atlas Go SDK
  • Build tooling that enables MongoDB users and developers to succeed, using programming languages such as Golang (primary), Java, Python & Javascript/Typescript (Experience in at least one of the above is desirable)
  • Design and develop software integration components utilizing MongoDB’s technology (i.e. database, mobile, search, etc.) in larger contexts and integrate into partner frameworks or solutions
  • Incrementally ship elements of sophisticated projects
  • Assist with investigating and solving problems experienced by our customers, Our team has a Level 2 support rotation
  • Apply our core values to your planning, designing, and coding work

Who are you?

We understand not everyone will meet all the qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply

  • Inspired by building DevOps & automated tooling that manages deployments at scale
  • Approachable, curious, and intellectually honest
  • Collaborate and communicate effectively across multiple teams, locally & remote across timezones, internally and externally as required, to drive projects to completion
  • Enjoys an environment where you can coordinate your own time, prioritizing, and acting on multiple tasks concurrently without manager oversight
  • Some experience building Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tooling & integrations
  • Familiar with cloud infrastructure platforms, tools and concepts (Amazon AWS, Google Cloud Platform, Microsoft Azure, etc)

How will you measure success?

  • In three months, you'll have become familiar with our developer tools and the existing features most relevant to integrations

  • In nine months, you will be fully embedded in the team. As well as leading your projects, you will be contributing ideas to the team roadmap, improving how we work. You will be mentoring other team members, helping them learn from your experience

What is in it for you?

  • Generous compensation package (top-range salary, equity, comprehensive benefits)
  • Flexible working options with a focus on results rather than time spent in the office
  • A high level of independence in your day-to-day work. Propose innovative solutions to existing problems and own the delivery from start to finish

title: Operations Specialist, Technical Services
descriptionHtml:
Role Overview

We achieve outstanding customer satisfaction through a 24x7x365 ‘follow-the-sun’ support model, with regional teams covering the Americas, EMEA, and APAC.

We have an incredible opportunity for a customer-obsessed, process-driven Technical Services Operations Specialist to join MongoDB’s Technical Services team in Mexico City. As an operational powerhouse, this specialist will drive excellence, efficiency, and scale in delivering technical support services to our worldwide customer base. By embedding AI tools, automation, and modern workforce management workflows into daily operations, you will enable our technical support organization to operate smoothly, predictably, and seamlessly across global teams.

As a key local representative of Technical Services (TS) Operations in Mexico City, you will play a central role in supporting our hybrid working model (3 days in office) while partnering closely with regional and global stakeholders to build a high-performing operations presence and ensure 24x7x365 operational readiness.

Typical responsibilities include

  • Organizing global on-call and mission-critical schedules using Workforce Management (WFM) tools and incident response platforms to guarantee seamless 24x7x365 support availability
  • Collaborating with Technical Services leadership and staff to ensure integrated worldwide processes and a unified, high-quality customer experience
  • Primarily supporting the AMER region while working and interacting regularly with global business partners across 'follow-the-sun' handovers
  • Exemplifying a customer-obsessed mindset by resolving operational roadblocks, servicing critical customer access needs with urgency, and continually refining support ticket workflows
  • Supporting the measurement, analysis, and dashboard reporting of teamwide Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and metrics using tools like Tableau, SQL, and Google Sheets
  • Identifying operational bottlenecks and building automated tools and scripts using Google Apps Script, while leveraging AI platform tools (Claude, Glean) to drive efficiency across the team
  • Ensuring team processes and policies are well-documented, communicated, and followed. Collaborating with legal teams to maintain customer-facing Support Policies and Terms and Conditions
  • Coordinating internal and external messaging regarding operational policies, programs, and MongoDB software product lifecycle releases
  • Infrequent international travel may be required (~1 time per year, only as conditions safely permit)

Candidate Profile

Required

  • 1–3 years of practical experience in operations management, technical support operations, workforce management, or business operations in a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment
  • Strong customer-centric perspective and approach to solving operational challenges, coupled with a passion for delivering service excellence
  • Fluent written and spoken communication skills in both English and Spanish
  • Focuses on data to answer questions—likes to "do the math," validate assumptions with evidence, and solve operational issues with scalable, systems-based solutions
  • Pays close attention to detail, anticipates next steps with minimal direction, and can break strategic initiatives down into tactical, execution-ready next steps
  • Exceptional operational analysis and cross-group collaboration skills, with the ability to articulate insights across all organizational levels, including senior management
  • Ability to think on your feet, remain calm under pressure, and manage competing priorities in a rapidly growing environment against tight deadlines

Desirable

  • Hands-on experience with Workforce Management (WFM) and incident response routing tools
  • Experience with case and task management platforms like Salesforce and Atlassian / Jira
  • Proficiency in reporting, data analytics, and workflow automation using SQL and no-SQL, Tableau, Google Sheets, and Google Apps Script
  • Experience applying AI tools (e.g., Claude, Glean) in technical support or engineering environments to lead adoption of AI-native ways of working across operations

Success Measures

Within 30 days

  • Complete MongoDB’s operational onboarding program and gain a solid understanding of MongoDB’s product suite, Technical Services team structure, key metrics, and global support model
  • Obtain full access to and proficiency in our core operational tool stack (Jira, Salesforce, Playvox, PagerDuty, and Google Workspace, etc.)
  • Shadow daily support operations workflows, including schedule management, queue handling, and shift communications

Within 60 days

  • Develop a deep understanding of our global support models and operational escalation paths
  • Independently manage global workforce management tasks using Playvox and PagerDuty
  • Service routine operational requests (e.g., customer access, system permissions) with urgency, accuracy, and a customer-obsessed approach
  • Build strong working relationships with Technical Services team members and regional stakeholders across AMER

Within 90 days

  • Take ownership of gathering and analyzing teamwide KPI data, maintaining operational dashboards across Tableau, SQL, and Google Sheets
  • Identify at least one operational bottleneck or manual process and implement an automation or workflow enhancement (e.g., leveraging Google Apps Script or AI tools like Claude/Glean)
  • Review and update existing Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and internal runbooks to reflect accurate, scalable processes

At 120 days and onward

  • Partner with Technical Services leadership to pitch and execute continuous process improvements and automation projects

title: Software Engineer 3, Query Optimization
descriptionHtml:
Join the MongoDB Server Query team, and help us build a world-class distributed open source query engine. Our team plays a crucial role in the experience and performance of data processing. We are responsible for the MongoDB Query Language and the lifecycle of each query, from parsing to optimization to plan selection and finally execution. This also includes our geospatial search and update subsystems.

Our global team is growing fast. In North America, we have a presence across the US and Canada including New York, West Coast, Toronto. In Europe, we have a presence in Dublin, Germany, France, Netherlands, UK, Bulgaria, Spain and Italy currently. We support office-based and remote work and align projects with convenient work hours.

We have tons of interesting problems to solve with direct impact on users for transactional, time-series and analytical workloads. We need your help to design and build the heart of a distributed, flexible schema, document database.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin for our hybrid working model.

Join our team and be at the forefront of innovation and creativity as we scale cloud deployments for our customers.

We’re open to speak with candidates based in Sao Paulo.

Life in MongoDB Technical Services

As part of the Support organization, you will be directly interfacing with our largest customers and their most difficult problems. There will almost certainly be sweat. But don’t worry – you’ll have time to prepare before you take on your first escalation. The limits of your understanding will constantly be pushed, and you’ll be challenged to grow. Underlying it all is the fuel that drives our team: customer obsession. We keep mission-critical deployments online, recover from high-pressure incidents with grace and humility, become trusted advisors, and work so closely with our customers that they would swear we were part of their team.

Role scope: This is a technical Team Lead role rather than a traditional people-manager role. The Lead is expected to provide day-to-day technical and operational leadership, while formal personnel decisions remain with the manager.

As the Cloud Support Team Lead, you will:

  • Lead and mentor a small, distributed team as a hands-on technical player-coach
  • Spend approximately 50% of your time directly supporting customer issues, complex cases, escalations, and technical investigations
  • Own frontline service quality by monitoring queue health, case and chat aging, diagnostic quality, staffing coverage, and workload allocation
  • Lead high-visibility customer escalations and incidents, coordinating Engineering, Product, Support Operations, and other stakeholders
  • Turn recurring customer problems and support trends into product feedback, process improvements, training, and reusable technical content
  • Create and maintain SOPs, knowledge articles, training materials, and retrospectives that improve team capability and consistency
  • Represent Technical Services in cross-functional and cross-region programs, driving execution through influence

What you need

The ideal candidate will have experience in most of the following areas:

  • Supporting customers through cases, chats, calls, and high-severity escalations. Preferred experience with running high-severity incidents and follow-the-sun procedures
  • Leading or mentoring a small team of highly technical support engineers
  • Strong troubleshooting experience with MongoDB Atlas or comparable cloud database platforms, including cloud infrastructure, Linux, networking, security, storage, and performance
  • A disciplined diagnostic process covering investigation, customer communication, escalation judgment, and root-cause analysis. Experience leveraging AI tools to broaden, improve and accelerate technical diagnostic processes preferred
  • Coordinating customer-impacting incidents and internal technical responders
  • Improving support operations through queue analysis, workload allocation, staffing coverage, training, and process improvement
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills across Engineering, Product, Security, Legal, Billing, Support Operations, and global Technical Services

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Cloud Manager, Compass, or large-scale relational or NoSQL databases
  • Experience managing FIN(Intercom), chat-support, case-management, or similar customer-support workflows
  • Experience leading incident reviews, RCAs, operational audits, or security/compliance improvements
  • Experience creating technical training, LMS content, knowledge programs, or enablement assessments
  • BONUS: Experience with DevOps, infrastructure-as-code, observability, automation, or scripting

Success Measures

  • First 3 months: Build relationships, understand team operations and customer demand, and begin contributing to complex escalations. Learn the Atlas product and master most common customer use cases
  • By 6 months: Independently lead escalations, establish recurring queue and quality reviews, improve coverage, and deliver at least one durable process or enablement improvement. Acquire Atlas Administrator certification
  • By 12 months: Demonstrate measurable improvement in service quality, escalation execution, team capability, coverage, and cross-functional delivery while remaining hands-on technically

title: Senior Software Engineer, Query
descriptionHtml:
The MongoDB Query Testing Tools Team is hiring Software Engineers who want to join us in building a state-of-the-art distributed query system. Our Team builds tooling that allows us to ship Query Engine features with high confidence in both correctness and performance, making it a great fit if you like seeing your work protect real customers at scale. The team develops advanced testing frameworks (end-to-end testing, fuzzing, property-based testing) as well as performance measurement tools, including high-volume workload generation tools.

The team is part of the Query organization which is responsible for the MongoDB Query Language and the lifecycle of each query, from parsing to optimization to plan selection; our engineers work on maintaining and improving our optimization and execution frameworks and building new query language features to help power our customers' critical workloads. Throughout all our work, our highest priority is always ensuring that customer queries are answered correctly. The successful applicant will be responsible for helping us to maintain the highest standards of quality through rigorous development, testing and automation strategies.

This role can be based out of our Dublin/Cork office, or remotely in Ireland.

Candidate Profile

  • 5+ years of experience in software development and/or performance engineering
  • Fluency in Python, Javascript or Typescript
  • Enjoys chasing down difficult problems in a distributed environment
  • Able to make complex concepts easy to grasp in written and spoken English
  • Able to decompose and solve complex problems and can rapidly iterate by validating new hypotheses and rethinking current assumptions
  • Demonstrating hands-on experience working with relational or NoSQL databases is a plus
  • B.Sc. in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent practical experience. Advanced degrees of experience in database query engines is a plus
  • Experience in developing automation test frameworks is a plus
  • Experience in query processing engine testing is a strong plus
  • Experience in developing performance test plans and monitoring frameworks is a strong plus
  • Background in database query engines or compilers is a strong plus
  • C++ experience is nice to have, but not mandatory.

Position Expectations

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated testing frameworks, Performance automated tests and internal tooling for the MongoDB query engine
  • Collaborate closely with peers to understand new features and functionalities, ensuring testability, test frameworks, tooling and coverage for automating tests of both happy-path and edge-case scenarios
  • Provide feedback in code reviews, focusing on the robustness and reliability of code changes

Success Measures

  • Within three months, you have gained an understanding of MongoDB's MQL syntax and its semantics, as well as the behavior of our unique query engine. You have contributed to several code bases on Mongodb engine internal tooling
  • By six months, you have established yourself as a key owner of automated test frameworks, and demonstrated improvements in test efficiency and coverage
  • After twelve months, you are instrumental in ensuring quality of major new features, setting an example for new team members in best practices for correctness and performance test automation and internal tooling

title: Senior Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
The database market is massive and MongoDB is at the head of its disruption. At MongoDB we are transforming industries and empowering developers to build amazing apps that people use every day. We are the leading modern data platform and the first database provider to IPO in over 20 years. Join our team and be at the forefront of innovation and creativity.

The MongoDB Cloud Services Team is a diverse group of contributors working together to help our users manage MongoDB at global scale. The Cloud Team is responsible for MongoDB Atlas: our database as a service offering, and fastest growing product, which allows users to deploy fault-tolerant, globally distributed MongoDB clusters in just minutes.

The Backup Team delivers essential infrastructure to help our customers in their hour of need - providing the ability to quickly restore a massive, distributed database to any point in time at the click of a button. The Backup Team’s mission is to make MongoDB backup more reliable, faster, and also cheaper.  This team is responsible for the Backup Agent (Go), the extensive server-side infrastructure (Java) which manages 100s of TB of data and processes billions of operations per day, and the user interface (Javascript)  that customers use to manage their backups.  Common project themes are performance, scaling, and ease of use. 

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in New York City for our hybrid working model.

We're looking for someone who is

  • Skilled at writing large-scale, distributed backend systems in a compiled language (Java, C#, Go, etc.)

title: Senior Manager, Accounting
descriptionHtml:
MongoDB is seeking a Senior Manager, Accounting to join the Corporate Accounting team within Controllership in Gurugram. This role will lead core corporate accounting activities, global close execution, balance-sheet integrity, reconciliations, accounting operations, and process improvement across MongoDB’s multi-entity environment.

The Senior Manager will partner closely with General Ledger, SEC Reporting, Technical Accounting, FP&A, Legal, Tax, Internal Audit, and external auditors. The role is designed for an accounting leader who can combine strong operational judgment with disciplined execution, clear communication, and a process-improvement mindset.

What you will do

Corporate accounting and global close

  • Lead and review corporate accounting activities across the monthly, quarterly, and annual close cycles
  • Own the quality and timeliness of balance-sheet reconciliations, journal entries, account analyses, flux explanations, and other close deliverables
  • Coordinate with global accounting teams to resolve variances, strengthen close procedures, and maintain consistent accounting practices across entities
  • Support consolidation activities, intercompany accounting, accruals, prepaids, fixed assets, leases, and other corporate accounting areas as assigned
  • Partner with SEC Reporting and Technical Accounting to provide accurate close data, schedules, and supporting documentation for external reporting and accounting conclusions

Controls, audit, and process improvement

  • Maintain and strengthen accounting controls and support SOX activities, including control execution, evidence quality, process narratives, and remediation
  • Serve as a key point of contact for internal and external auditors during walkthroughs, quarterly reviews, annual audits, and requests related to corporate accounting processes
  • Identify opportunities to improve data quality, reduce manual effort, and increase automation across close and reconciliation processes
  • Help implement scalable accounting policies, procedures, and documentation as MongoDB continues to grow

Leadership and partnership

  • Lead, coach, and develop accounting professionals while setting clear expectations for quality, accountability, and continuous improvement
  • Coordinate work across global accounting teams and help establish consistent processes across entities and reporting cycles
  • Translate accounting issues into clear, practical guidance for Finance leadership and cross-functional stakeholders
  • Build trusted relationships across the organization and represent Controllership with sound judgment and a service-oriented approach

What you bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  • 8+ years of progressive accounting experience, including significant experience in corporate accounting, global close, or a related controllership function
  • Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP and corporate accounting processes in a public-company or similarly complex environment
  • Experience with multi-entity accounting, consolidations, intercompany activity, balance-sheet reconciliations, and close management
  • Experience working in a SOX-controlled environment and partnering with internal and external auditors
  • Experience leading, mentoring, or managing accounting professionals in a global organization
  • Strong analytical, organizational, written, and verbal communication skills

title: Manager, Client Platform Engineering
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Manager, Client Platform Engineering to own MongoDB's endpoint platform worldwide. You'll lead a globally distributed team responsible for macOS, Windows, and Linux endpoints, mobile device and application management, zero-touch provisioning, on-time operating system and patch delivery, and the endpoint telemetry that tells us how the fleet is performing for the people using it. You'll partner with InfoSec to harden the endpoint estate, and build and grow a team of passionate, curious experts in this space. This role combines deep hands-on end user computing expertise with the people leadership and judgment to set technical direction and communicate risk and strategy to stakeholders.

What You'll Do

  •   Own the worldwide endpoint architecture and roadmap for macOS, Windows, Linux, and mobile, including management platform strategy, configuration-as-code, application packaging and self-service, and zero-touch provisioning
  •   Lead the release calendar and deployment ring strategy for every endpoint operating system, delivering major and minor updates on time to a published compliance target, with tested rollback and a clear exception path
  •   Administer and evolve MongoDB's endpoint management stack across MDM and UEM platforms, including declarative device management (DDM) on macOS and Windows Autopilot and Autopatch on Windows 11
  •   Own mobile strategy end to end for corporate-owned and BYOD devices across iOS and Android, balancing data protection against an enrollment experience employees will accept MDM where enrollment is appropriate, MAM and app protection policies where it is not
  •   Build and operate MongoDB's Endpoint Digital Employee Experience program: instrument the fleet, define the DEX metrics and SLOs we hold ourselves to, and drive proactive remediation that resolves issues before employees notice them
  •   Partner with InfoSec to implement and continuously improve endpoint security controls, including hardening baselines, patch and vulnerability remediation SLAs, disk encryption and key escrow coverage, device trust, and Conditional Access
  •   Serve as a senior technical escalation point (L3) for complex endpoint issues across the organization
  •   Build automation to reduce manual endpoint operations work and improve reliability and observability, holding the team to configuration-as-code, peer review, and staged rollout
  •   Act as a technical advisor for MongoDB's relationships with endpoint management, DEX, and hardware vendors, and own the endpoint tooling and licensing budget
  •   Hire, coach, and retain a globally distributed team of EUC engineers, and contribute to a culture of technical excellence and self-service

Responsibilities

  •   Ensure MongoDB's global endpoint fleet remains reliable, secure, compliant, and scalable across every platform and region as the company grows
  •   Deliver operating system rollouts on time, every cycle, across macOS, Windows, and Linux endpoints
  •   Reduce risk and technical debt across endpoint management, patching, and device lifecycle
  •   Build and maintain a high-performing international team, and develop engineers into recognized experts in this space
  •   Communicate endpoint strategy, risk, and incidents clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  •   Uphold strong engineering practices across endpoint documentation, automation, and change management
  •   Balance long-term platform architecture work with day-to-day operational support
  •   Define, publish, and manage the team against the metrics for the service

Minimum Requirements

  •   Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent practical experience
  •   8+ years of experience in end user computing, client platform engineering, or endpoint and modern workplace engineering, including 3+ years hiring and leading engineers
  •   Proven experience owning a fleet of several thousand endpoints across multiple countries and time zones
  •   Hands-on depth across all three desktop platforms, not oversight of them: macOS managed through a modern MDM (Jamf Pro, Iru/formerly Kandji, Microsoft Intune, or Omnissa Workspace ONE) with Apple Business (formerly Apple Business Manager) and Automated Device Enrollment; Windows 11 managed through Intune, Windows Autopilot, and Windows Autopatch; Linux endpoints managed as code with Ansible, Fleet, or equivalent
  •   A current understanding of Apple's declarative device management (DDM) model and what its adoption means for software update enforcement, Platform SSO, and configuration and app delivery
  •   Experience with both mobile management models: MDM for corporate-owned devices and MAM/app protection for BYOD, including Intune App Protection Policies, Android Enterprise work profile, and Apple User Enrollment with Managed Apple Accounts
  •   A demonstrated record of delivering major OS rollouts on schedule, with a defined ring strategy, compatibility gating, communications plan, exception process, and rollback path
  •   Experience instrumenting endpoints with a DEX or telemetry platform such as Nexthink, Lakeside SysTrack, ControlUp, 1E, Aternity, Intune Advanced Analytics, or osquery/Fleet, defining a score or SLO from it, and using it to resolve issues proactively
  •   Scripting skills for endpoint automation using infrastructure as code, with fluency in at least one of Bash, Python, Swift, or PowerShell and comfort with Git-based workflows
  •   Experience partnering with InfoSec, Identity, IT Service Delivery, and Workplace teams on cross-functional endpoint initiatives
  •   Experience leading engineers across multiple regions, with a clear approach to coverage, escalation, documentation, and asynchronous decision-making
  •   Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics to a wide range of audiences
  •   Experience with endpoint documentation and reporting such as fleet compliance dashboards, configuration baselines, and operational runbooks
  •   There will be requirements from time to time to work across multiple time zones as required by the business, including travel

Preferred Qualifications

  •   Jamf Certified Expert, Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate, or equivalent endpoint management certification
  •   Visible standing in the endpoint community — MacAdmins Slack, Jamf Nation, Midwest Management Summit, Penn State MacAdmins — or open-source contributions to projects such as Munki, Installomator, Nudge, swiftDialog, or osquery
  •   Experience supporting a heavily technical employee population, including software engineers with elevated-privilege, virtualization, and local developer and AI tooling needs
  •   Experience with cloud identity and device trust platforms such as Okta and Microsoft Entra ID, and with Conditional Access policy design
  •   Familiarity with ITSM practice, service ownership, and Experience Level Agreements (XLAs) alongside traditional SLAs
  •   Experience owning endpoint tooling budget, vendor relationships, and licensing at scale
  •   Experience mentoring other endpoint or systems engineers

Success Measures

  •   In 3 months, you will: Be fully onboarded with a thorough understanding of MongoDB's endpoint estate and policies, have met your team and key partners in every region, and have delivered a written assessment of the worldwide fleet — platform coverage, compliance posture, tooling, gaps, and top risks — with a prioritized plan and any approved roles actively in flight
  •   In 6 months, you will: Have your team at or above 90% of the approved hiring plan, have published the EUC service metrics and SLOs (OS and patch compliance, zero-touch provisioning rate, mean time to provision, DEX score, self-service resolution rate), have shipped at least one major OS release on schedule under a defined ring strategy, and have closed the highest-priority gaps identified in your assessment
  •   In 12 months, you will: Be recognized as the senior owner of MongoDB's global endpoint platform, operating a fully staffed, high-performing international team; consistently meeting your published OS and patch compliance targets across macOS, Windows, and Linux; running a measurable proactive remediation program with a demonstrated reduction in endpoint tickets per employee; and owning a twelve-month endpoint roadmap that InfoSec, IT, and Engineering leadership have endorsed

Location & Travel:

  •   This role is based in Palo Alto / San Francisco, CA, and candidates should be located within reasonable commuting distance of our Palo Alto and San Francisco offices
  •   The team operates with a flexible work arrangement, with in-person collaboration typically occurring 1–2 times per week
  •   This role involves travel and regular work across time zones to lead a globally distributed team and to support global office and regional IT initiatives

title: Regulatory Compliance Program Manager
descriptionHtml:
MongoDB is seeking a Regulatory Change Management Program manager to help anticipate regulatory developments within Technology, Cyber Security and AI spaces, assess their implications for the business, and ensure material obligations are identified and addressed before they create unexpected risk or exposure. This role reports to the Director of Operations within MongoDB’s Assurance, Risk & Compliance (ARC) team.

You will monitor the regulatory environment, assess applicability and compliance impact, and give the ARC team a clear view of emerging obligations, exposure, and readiness. In addition to working within ARC, you will work across Privacy, Legal, Product, Engineering, People, and other business teams, providing the insight, interpretation, and escalation that help accountable owners respond early and proportionately.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin for our hybrid working model.

What you will do

Regulatory horizon scanning and change management

  • Monitor and triage developments in data protection, privacy, cybersecurity, digital resilience, artificial intelligence, online services, and other regulations relevant to MongoDB
  • Maintain a forward-looking regulatory change inventory, including source, effective date, applicability, affected business areas, accountable stakeholders, and current assessment status
  • Collaborate with legal to assess whether a regulatory development is relevant to MongoDB’s products, services, entities, customers, suppliers, workforce, or operating model
  • Prepare concise impact assessments, obligation summaries, briefing notes, and escalation papers for senior stakeholders within ARC group and Global Security Organization
  • Coordinate regulatory change assessments across subject-matter experts
  • Track decisions, dependencies, risks, and overdue responses; identify where ownership or interpretation is unclear
  • Surface emerging themes and potential blind spots

Data protection and Data classification 

  • Collaborate with the Security team, the Privacy and Legal teams with GDPR and related data-protection analysis across products, business processes, and third-party relationships
  • Escalate potential compliance gaps, or unresolved interpretation questions
  • Help maintain and evolve a practical data-classification framework aligned to regulatory, security and business requirements
  • Advise teams from Compliance perspective on classification decisions for information used in internal systems, customer engagements, and third-party services
  • Review Compliance related classification challenges and exceptions for consistency, proportionality, and traceability

Oversight, reporting, and assurance

  • Develop dashboards and reporting that show exposure, readiness, ownership, overdue decisions, and material trends rather than activity for its own sake
  • Support internal compliance requests, regulatory enquiries, and control assessments by coordinating evidence and explaining the basis for conclusions
  • Contribute to policies, standards, playbooks, and training content where regulatory interpretation or risk context is required

What we are looking for

  • Five or more years of experience in regulatory change management in compliance, privacy, or a closely related discipline
  • Practical knowledge of data-protection principles, especially GDPR and UK GDPR, including lawful processing, accountability, data minimisation, transfers, retention, and individual rights
  • Exposure to DORA, NIS2, the EU AI Act, ePrivacy requirements, digital-services regulation, or comparable technology regulation
  • Experience working with in-house legal teams to interpret laws, regulations, regulatory guidance, or contractual requirements and translating them into obligations, applicability assessments, risks, and decisions
  • Experience supporting regulatory change management, horizon scanning, obligations management, or compliance impact assessments
  • Understanding of data classification, information governance, records management, or data-handling frameworks
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to distinguish material risk from noise and draw clear conclusions from incomplete information
  • Excellent written communication skills, including the ability to produce concise briefings, evidence-based recommendations, and documentation for technical and non-technical audiences

  • High attention to detail and strong organisational skills, including the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, dependencies, and follow-ups
  • A proactive, questioning mindset: you look for what could be missed, what has changed, who is affected, and what evidence would change the conclusion

Nice to have

  • Experience in a technology, SaaS, cloud, platform, or other highly regulated environment
  • Familiarity with information-security and assurance frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST CSF, or the Cloud Security Alliance controls
  • Experience working with regulatory inventories, GRC platforms, privacy-management tools, data catalogues, or workflow systems
  • A relevant qualification such as CIPP/E, CIPM, CIPT, IAPP FIP, CISA, CRISC, or an equivalent professional credential

What success looks like

  • Leaders receive early, decision-useful insight into regulatory developments that could affect MongoDB
  • Regulatory changes have a clear applicability assessment, accountable owner, documented rationale, and visible next step

  • The organisation can distinguish between a confirmed obligation, an interpretation requiring legal advice, an implementation task, and an unresolved risk

title: Director of Customer Marketing & Advocacy
descriptionHtml:
MongoDB is hiring a Director of Customer Marketing & Advocacy to showcase our customers and support one of our strongest growth levers. This is a build-and-influence role: you will scale customer marketing into a strategic growth function impacting market share, mindshare and awareness with a focus on enterprise segments and AI-native startups.

We're not looking for someone to run customer marketing as usual. We want a leader who will innovate, drive change, and take this program to the next level: an AI-enabled engine that finds, matches, and activates customer voice at speed and scale, and a program other companies point to as the bar they aspire to. You will replace manual, ad hoc processes with automation and AI, so customer stories reach every channel faster and with less friction and innovate the customer marketing function and model.

You will build a world where our customers show up everywhere: on stage, in analyst and press conversations, across our brand campaigns and content, and throughout the buying journey. You will also create a channel for customer insight where the insight we gather from customers will sharpen how Product and Product Marketing position, message, and launch. You will make sure every one of those moments is planned, measured, and tied to corporate goals. Customer voice will be the foundation of MongoDB's brand, building awareness and mindshare with the buyers and builders who matter most.

You will lead the customer marketing team across AMER and EMEA and partner closely with Brand, Communications, Strategic Events, Social Media, Product Marketing, Executive Programs, Sales, Customer Success, Partners, Product, and Investor Relations.

This role can be based remotely in the United States.

What You'll Do

Put customer voice at the center of MongoDB's story, across every channel

  • Make the customer voice the heart of our brand. Partner with Brand Marketing & Creative to make customer outcomes a foundational part of MongoDB's brand narrative and campaigns, building awareness and mindshare and shaping how the market sees us
  • Lead customer storytelling and content. Set the editorial bar for case studies, video, and executive point-of-view content, and make sure those stories feed brand, social media, communications, events, and demand programs
  • Bring customers to every stage. Partner with Strategic Events to make customers central to flagship events such as MongoDB.local, plus keynotes, webinars, and brand activations, recruiting and preparing customer speakers who bring our story to life
  • Earn credibility beyond our own channels. Work with Communications to connect customers with the press, analysts, and industry influencers who shape enterprise and developer opinion, so credible third-party voices carry our story further than we can alone

Reimagine the program and build the AI-enabled engine

  • Redefine what customer marketing can be, and set the bar. Set the charter, operating model, and multi-year roadmap for a function that unifies storytelling, advocacy, executive engagement, and influencer relationships into one system, and build a program that peers benchmark themselves against
  • Build an AI-enabled engine that scales. Use automation and AI to find, match, and activate customer voice across channels, from story intake and customer matching to content tagging and performance reporting. Replace ad hoc, one-off requests with clear standards, shared ownership across teams, defined dependencies, and accountability for results

Drive impact

  • 5+ years leading teams, including managing managers and teams across regions
  • A record of innovating and driving change: you've taken a customer marketing or advocacy program well beyond the standard model, built systems that scale efficiently, and created work your peers and the broader community look to as a benchmark
  • Hands-on experience using AI and automation to scale customer marketing or advocacy operations, plus a clear point of view on where AI is taking the function

  • Experience integrating customer voice across brand campaigns, communications, social and influencer marketing, events, and product launches
  • Proven success building customer advocacy and co-marketing programs that recruit and engage a strong, diverse base of customer participants
  • Executive presence, with experience engaging C-level customers and changing senior leaders' minds with data and customer evidence

title: Senior Software Engineer, App Modernization
descriptionHtml:
About the Job

MongoDB is growing its team in Sydney, focusing on building intelligent tools that help customers understand and modernise their application codebases. The Application Modernisation Platform (AMP) guides customers through the entire journey of modernising their applications — from legacy relational platforms to modern, scalable systems built on MongoDB. The App Analysis & Modelling team owns the critical first stage of this journey: building the context that powers everything downstream. The team builds code analysis tools that construct code dependency graphs and generate deep insights for codebases, giving customers a clear understanding of their existing applications before transformation begins. The team also designs schema recommendation engines that analyse signals such as existing relational schemas and query patterns to inform data modelling decisions. Our work sits at the intersection of analysis, data modelling, and AI — helping developers make confident, data-driven decisions as they transition to MongoDB.

We are looking for a Software Engineer who is passionate about building scalable backend systems and applications. As we expand our use of AI to power smarter analysis and recommendations, the ideal candidate will bring strong backend engineering fundamentals with the ability to contribute across the full stack. You will collaborate closely with product management and other engineering teams to design and deliver cutting-edge features that guide customers through complex modernisation journeys.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Sydney for our hybrid working model.

The Ideal Candidate Will Have

  • 3-5+ years (Mid-Level) or 5+ years (Senior) of commercial software development experience with strong proficiency in Python and/or Java
  • Experience(or extensive experience for senior candidates) designing and building scalable, high-performance APIs and backend services
  • Solid understanding of relational data modelling and SQL (Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, or similar), including schema design and query optimisation
  • Good understanding of algorithms, data structures, and their time and space complexity
  • Experience with frontend development using React and TypeScript, or a demonstrated willingness and ability to work across the full stack
  • Degree in Computer Science or a similar field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Curiosity, a positive attitude, and a drive to continue learning
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Nice to Have

  • Experience building AI-powered features, including working with Large Language Models (LLMs) and agentic workflows
  • Experience with code analysis, static analysis tooling, or building tools that traverse and interpret code structures programmatically
  • Familiarity with MongoDB
  • Experience with cloud-native distributed systems (e.g., Kubernetes or similar)
  • Contributions to open-source projects

Position Expectations

  • Contribute high-quality, well-tested code to the App Analysis & Modelling team’s backend and frontend services
  • Design and build scalable APIs and data pipelines that power code analysis and schema recommendation features
  • Drive technical design and architecture for complex features (for senior candidates), or deliver robust implementations following established designs (for mid-level candidates)
  • Collaborate effectively with Product Management, other engineers, and designers to build and deliver on the product roadmap
  • Participate actively in code reviews to enforce best practices and maintain a high bar for code quality
  • Give and solicit feedback on technical design documents and pull requests
  • Help troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues across the stack
  • Perform tasks related to engineering process such as CI/CD, quality, and testing
  • Mentor and guide team members while elevating engineering best practices (for senior candidates)

Success Measures

Within the first three months, you will have:

  • Familiarised yourself with the MongoDB database and aggregation language
  • Familiarised yourself with the backend tech stack including Python, Java, and our API infrastructure
  • Set up your software development environment and begin contributing to the codebase
  • Started collaborating with your peers and contributed to code reviews and design discussions

Within six months, you will have:

  • Familiarised yourself with the full stack including the React/TypeScript frontend
  • Worked on and delivered a large-scale feature in the product
  • Contributed to and helped deliver multiple product releases
  • Reviewed and contributed to scope and technical design documents

Within twelve months, you will have:
