title: Senior Partner Enablement Manager
descriptionHtml:
Every sales play, program change, funding update, and PRM release we build across MongoDB's partner ecosystem only creates value if the people who need to use it actually know how. We're looking for a Senior Partner Enablement Manager to drive this end to end.  This is a dual mandate: enabling our external partners (SIs, ISVs, and cloud partners) to sell, deliver, and support MongoDB effectively, and enabling our own internal partner organization (Sales Plays & Offerings, Partner Programs, Cloud & Hyperscaler Programs, and everyone else in the ecosystem function) to stay current on products, programs, and the frequent changes that come out of a fast-moving partner strategy.

You'll report to the Global Head of Partner Enablement and build the Japanese enablement function supporting the entire Japan partner organization. 

What You'll Do

Enable external partners

  • Develop and own the local Partner Enablement strategy in alignment with the Global Partner Enablement strategy across all key external partners (SIs, OEMs, Resellers, ISVs, cloud/hyperscaler partners)
  • Deliver end to end Partner Enablement for the Japanese Partner ecosystem - partner onboarding, certification pathways (including MongoDB's SI Associate and SI Architect tracks), and ongoing training content that keeps partners current on MongoDB products, sales plays, and programs.
  • Design and run delivery mechanisms — workshops, on-demand training, partner summits, webinars — that fit how different partner types (SI, ISV, cloud) actually consume enablement.
  • In partnership with L&D and Sales Plays & Offerings teams, ensure local training assets are suitable for local market priorities and enablement approaches
  • Identify key local metrics to support ecosystem growth, completing impact analyses with key stakeholders to ensure progress and ROI tracking.   

Enable the internal partner organization

  • Develop and deliver a standing internal enablement cadence that keeps the Japan internal partner org — Sales Plays & Offerings, Partner Programs, Cloud & Hyperscaler Programs, Digital Process & AI Operations, and the PRM product team — current on product updates, program and funding changes, and platform releases. 
  • Treat every significant change coming out of Partner Programs (new tiers, incentives, funding models) or the PRM roadmap as an enablement event, not an email — make sure the internal team knows it's coming, what it means, and how to talk about it before partners ask.
  • Leverage internal enablement formats (briefings, quick-reference guides, office hours) sized to a fast-moving team rather than a heavyweight training program that are localised for the Japan market.

Local Alignment

  • Voice of the Partner & Feedback Loops: Capture insights, localized needs, and enablement gaps directly from Japanese partners, channeling feedback back to global enablement and product teams to refine global offerings.
  • Cross-Functional Regional Alignment: Partner closely with Japan sales leadership, APJ alliance directors, and local field marketing to align enablement initiatives with regional pipeline generation and co-selling motions.

What You'll Bring

  • 7+ years of experience in partner enablement, channel enablement, or sales enablement at a B2B SaaS or infrastructure/data company, including experience leading a team.
  • Fluency in both Japanese and English (business level or above)
  • A track record of delivering enablement for external partners (certification, onboarding, content) across various mechanisms (virtual, in-person, on-demand) and demonstrated experience enabling internal revenue or partner functions.
  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills; comfortable working with Sales Plays & Offerings, Partner Programs, Cloud & Hyperscaler Programs, Digital Process & AI Operations, and the PRM product team as primary stakeholders.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication — able to translate technical or program-level change into clear, actionable enablement content for very different audiences (partners vs. internal teams).

Nice to Have

  • Experience running a partner certification program at scale (e.g., technical or sales certifications with defined tiers).
  • Familiarity with PRM platforms and how enablement content and certification tracking integrate with them.
  • Experience with AI-assisted content creation or delivery tools to scale enablement production.
  • Background in database, cloud infrastructure, or developer-focused technology.

What Success Looks Like in the First Year

  • A clear local enablement plan that is being executed in a structured, engaging manner, driving enablement metrics.
  • A running internal enablement cadence that the Japanese partner org relies on for every significant product, program, or PRM change. 

シニア GTM イネーブルメントマネージャー

MongoDBのパートナーエコシステムで生まれるセールスプレイ、プログラム変更、ファンディングの更新、PRMのリリースは、使う人が使い方を理解してはじめて価値を生みます。このポジションは、その取り組みをエンドツーエンドで推進するシニアGTMイネーブルメントマネージャーです。

役割は大きく2つあります。1つは、外部パートナー(SI、ISV、クラウドパートナー)がMongoDBを効果的に販売・導入・サポートできるよう支援することです。もう1つは、社内のパートナー組織(Sales Plays & Offerings、Partner Programs、Cloud & Hyperscaler Programsなど、エコシステム部門全体)が、製品やプログラム、スピーディーなパートナー戦略に伴う頻繁な変更を常に把握できるよう支援することです。

Global Head of Partner Enablementにレポートし、日本のパートナー組織全体を支えるイネーブルメント機能をゼロから立ち上げます。

業務内容

外部パートナーへのイネーブルメント

  • グローバルのパートナーイネーブルメント戦略と整合させながら、主要な外部パートナー(SI、OEM、リセラー、ISV、クラウド/ハイパースケーラーパートナー)向けの日本のイネーブルメント戦略を策定し、責任を持って推進します
  • 日本のパートナーエコシステム向けに、オンボーディング、認定制度(MongoDBのSI AssociateおよびSI Architectトラックを含む)、MongoDBの製品・セールスプレイ・プログラムの最新情報を伝え続ける継続的なトレーニングコンテンツまで、一貫したイネーブルメントを提供します
  • ワークショップ、オンデマンド研修、パートナーサミット、ウェビナーなど、SI、ISV、クラウドといったパートナーのタイプごとの学び方に合った提供方法を設計・運営します
  • L&D(人材育成)チームやSales Plays & Offeringsチームと連携し、トレーニング資料が日本市場の優先事項やイネーブルメントのやり方に合うようにします
  • エコシステムの成長を支える日本独自の指標を定め、関係者とともにインパクト分析を行い、進捗とROIを追跡します

社内パートナー組織へのイネーブルメント

  • 日本の社内パートナー組織(Sales Plays & Offerings、Partner Programs、Cloud & Hyperscaler Programs、Digital Process & AI Operations、PRMプロダクトチーム)が、製品アップデート、プログラムやファンディングの変更、プラットフォームのリリースを常に把握できるよう、定期的な社内イネーブルメントの仕組みを企画・運営します
  • Partner Programsでの大きな変更(新しいティア、インセンティブ、ファンディングモデルなど)やPRMのロードマップの更新は、メールで知らせて終わりにせず、イネーブルメントの機会として扱います。パートナーから質問を受ける前に、社内チームが「何が変わるのか」「どういう意味を持つのか」「どう説明すればよいか」を理解できるようにします
  • 変化の速いチームに合わせ、大がかりな研修ではなく、ブリーフィング、クイックリファレンスガイド、オフィスアワーといった軽量な形式を採用し、日本市場向けにローカライズします

日本国内での連携

  • パートナーの声とフィードバックループ:日本のパートナーから、現場の声、日本市場固有のニーズ、イネーブルメント上の課題を直接収集し、グローバルのイネーブルメントチームやプロダクトチームにフィードバックして、グローバルの提供内容の改善につなげます
  • 地域内の部門横断的な連携:日本のセールスリーダーシップ、APJのアライアンスディレクター、日本のフィールドマーケティングと密に連携し、地域のパイプライン創出や共同販売(コセル)の取り組みとイネーブルメント施策の方向性を揃えます

応募資格

  • B2B SaaSまたはインフラ/データ関連企業での、パートナーイネーブルメント、チャネルイネーブルメント、またはセールスイネーブルメントの経験が7年以上あり、チームのマネジメント経験があること
  • 日本語・英語ともに流暢なレベル(ビジネスレベル以上)のコミュニケーション力
  • 外部パートナー向けのイネーブルメント(認定制度、オンボーディング、コンテンツ)を、オンライン、対面、オンデマンドなど複数の手法で提供した実績があり、社内の営業部門やパートナー部門を対象としたイネーブルメントの経験があること
  • 部門横断での優れた協業力があり、Sales Plays & Offerings、Partner Programs、Cloud & Hyperscaler Programs、Digital Process & AI Operations、PRMプロダクトチームを主なステークホルダーとして円滑に連携できること
  • 優れた文章力と会話力を持ち、技術的な内容やプログラムの変更点を、パートナーと社内チームという異なる対象に合わせて、わかりやすく実行につながるイネーブルメントコンテンツに落とし込めること

歓迎要件

  • 段階(ティア)が定められた技術認定や営業認定など、パートナー認定プログラムを大規模に運営した経験
  • PRMプラットフォームに関する知識と、イネーブルメントコンテンツや認定管理がPRMとどう連携するかの理解
  • イネーブルメントコンテンツの制作を拡大するための、AIを活用したコンテンツ作成・配信ツールの利用経験
  • データベース、クラウドインフラ、または開発者向け技術に関するバックグラウンド

入社1年後に目指す姿

  • 日本向けのイネーブルメント計画が明確に定まり、体系的で魅力的な形で実行されて、イネーブルメント指標の向上につながっている
  • 製品、プログラム、PRMに関する重要な変更のたびに、日本のパートナー組織が頼りにする社内イネーブルメントの定期的な仕組みが運用されている

title: Senior Manager, Creative Director
descriptionHtml:
The Senior Manager, Creative Director leads the team behind MongoDB's visual brand. Reporting to the Director, Brand Marketing, this leader owns the creative vision, brand systems, and execution standards that turn brand strategy into consistent, high-impact work across campaigns, events, and digital experiences, and leads the designers who deliver it.

This role is for a creative leader who is still close to the craft and ready to build how a brand design team operates: how concepts get made, how the brand is stewarded and enabled across the company, and how AI is applied to build and accelerate design systems and creative work. We’re not looking for someone to run creative as usual. You will raise the bar, push our brand toward more distinctive and recognizable work, and build a creative engine that moves faster and scales further.

Please submit your portfolio in addition to your resume when applying. This role can be based remotely in the US or in one of our office locations.

What You'll Do

  • Lead and develop the Brand Creative design team. Set priorities, define roles and performance standards, coach and grow designers at every level, give clear and direct feedback, build a culture of experimentation and collaboration, and hold a consistent bar for execution across every program.
  • Set creative direction. Own concepting and ideation for high-impact brand campaigns and initiatives, translating brand strategy into scalable visual systems across print, digital, motion, and environmental applications.
  • Translate technology into story. Make complex, technical products feel clear, relevant, and compelling to developers and enterprise leaders, working with Product Marketing to turn positioning into work people remember.
  • Own the brand systems. Steward and evolve typography, iconography, logo, color, and layout frameworks. Keep the brand library, presentation templates, icons, and brand guidelines accurate and up to date.
  • Lead AI and generative design. Identify where AI tools can improve speed, quality, and creative possibility. Spark and embrace AI across the team and make it part of everyday practice, while enforcing the guardrails set by the company. Partner across the org to build expertise, share what works, and learn how to solve real problems with AI.
  • Lead events and environmental design. Direct the creative for large-scale brand moments (e.g. .local, AWS re:Invent, SKO), from early concept through delivery, in close partnership with Strategic Events.
  • Bridge brand and social. Work with Social and Influencer Marketing to extend campaigns and events into platform-native content, with clear creative guidance for creators and partners.
  • Stay hands-on. Roll up your sleeves on concepts and key deliverables when the work calls for it, and model the quality and taste you expect from the team.
  • Build brand enablement. Create the templates, documentation, and guidance that let teams across the company (and external partners) apply the brand confidently and correctly, including programs beyond marketing.
  • Partner across the business. Collaborate with Events, Social, Web, Customer Marketing, Product, Employee Experience, and Corporate Communications to keep every brand touchpoint consistent. Manage agencies, contractors, and specialty disciplines like animation and illustration.
  • Plan work and capacity. Prioritize across competing requests, manage timelines and budgets, and surface resourcing risk early so it never becomes a delivery problem.
  • Present and influence. Share creative concepts and rationale with senior stakeholders, and clearly explain design decisions and constraints to both creative and non-creative audiences.

Qualifications

  • BFA or MA/MS in design, art and design, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • 8+ years of design experience, ideally with 2+ years managing and developing designers.
  • A portfolio that shows event design, campaigns, layout, design systems, and visual storytelling, with clear examples of your creative direction.
  • Experience building and operationalizing brand and design systems, ideally for B2B, technology, or SaaS brands.
  • Experience directing environmental and event design for large-scale brand moments.
  • Advanced knowledge of Adobe and Figma systems, libraries, and scalable brand documentation.
  • Hands-on experience applying AI and generative tools to creative workflows, and leading a team to adopt them.
  • Experience managing agencies, contractors, and cross-functional creative projects within timelines and budgets.
  • Proven ability to influence and align stakeholders across functions and seniority levels.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to present creative rationale to non-creative audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building or evolving a brand identity or design system at scale.
  • Experience creating for both large enterprises and startups, and for technical buyers and developers as well as executive decision makers.
  • Experience with developer or community-driven marketing.
  • A recognized presence in the creative community, such as conference speaking, industry awards, published work, or teaching.

title: Senior Solutions Architect (Pre-Sales)
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for passionate technologists to join our Pre-Sales organization to ensure that our growth is grounded and guided by strong technical alignment with our platform and the needs of our customers.

MongoDB Pre-Sales Solution Architects are responsible for guiding our customers and users to design and build reliable, scalable systems using our data platform. Our team is made up of seasoned technical sales professionals, software architects, entrepreneurs, and developers who take direct responsibility for customer success, including the design of their software, deployment, and operations. You'll work closely with our sales executives, helping customers solve business problems by leveraging our solutions, playing a key role in winning deals and driving the business forward. You'll be a trusted advisor to a wide range of users from startups to the world's largest enterprise IT organizations. 

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in New York City for our hybrid working model.

As an ideal candidate, you will have:

  • Ideally 8 to 11 years of related experience in a customer facing role, with 5 to 7 years of experience in pre-sales with enterprise software
  • Minimum of 3 years experience with modern scripting languages (e.g. Python, Node.js, SQL) and/or popular programming languages (e.g. C/C++, Java, C#) in a professional capacity
  • Experience designing with scalable and highly available distributed systems in the cloud and on-prem
  • Demonstrated ability to work with customers to review complex architecture of existing applications, providing guidance on how to improve by leveraging technology
  • Excellent presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to convey complex technical and business concepts in a clear and compelling manner to technology and business leadership
  • Ability to strategize with sales teams and provide recommendations on how to drive a multi-threaded account strategy, aligning other MongoDB and ecosystem resources to move towards a mutually beneficial account plan
  • The ability to travel up to 25%
  • A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience

You may also have:

  • Experience selling databases and/or deploying applications with any of the major cloud providers 
  • Experience with database programming and data models 
  • Experience in data engineering or AI/ML projects
  • Experience in transforming legacy systems and platforms into modern, scalable, and efficient technology stacks
  • Understanding of popular sales methodologies/ frameworks such as MEDDPICC/ Command of the Message
  • A MongoDB Certification
  • A Cloud Provider Certification

What you do at MongoDB:

In this role, you will work on complex opportunities where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of various factors. You will:

  • Design and Architect: Design scalable and performant applications, systems and infrastructure for large software projects leveraging MongoDB
  • Customer Advising and Value Articulation: Guide customers on architecture patterns and optimisation strategies for MongoDB, while clearly communicating its business value to the relevant stakeholders
  • Sales Partnership: Collaborate with the sales team to drive account success through account planning, opportunity prioritization/qualification and pipeline generation strategy, while taking ownership of the technical aspects (including but not limited to technical discovery, demos, proof of value, presentations, sizing and documentation)
  • Demand Generation: Proactively generate demand within the sales territory through self-driven technical initiatives, participation in events such as industry trade shows and account-based marketing events
  • Customer Success: Foster strong customer relationships, build champions and ensure customer success and satisfaction
  • Innovation and Improvement: Continuously seek opportunities to innovate and improve MongoDB solutions and processes (e.g. by relaying field feedback to the product team), as well as proactively mentor other Solutions Consulting team members 
  • Personal Training and Development: Engage in ongoing training and professional development to stay abreast of MongoDB product suite as well as industry trends

What you will learn:

MongoDB Product Suite Mastery:

  • Core Database Server: Master the fundamentals and advanced features of MongoDB's core database
  • Atlas and Advanced Services: Gain expertise in Atlas (fully managed cloud database service), Atlas Stream Processing, Atlas Data Lake, Atlas Full-Text Search, Atlas Vector Search, and Charts
  • Relational Migrator: Learn to migrate from relational databases seamlessly

Market-Relevant Technologies:

  • Hyperscaler Ecosystem: Gain expertise in designing complex systems utilizing cloud services on hyperscaler platforms
  • Complementary Technologies: Enhance your skills with partner and complementary technologies such as Apache Kafka and Kubernetes

Modern Architecture Design:

  • Design Patterns and Methodologies: Embrace best practices in microservices, DevOps, cloud, and security
  • Cutting Edge RAG and AI Architectures: Help customers on their generative AI journeys and working with industry leading partners in the space

Sales Techniques and Soft Skills:

  • Effective Communication: Master presentations, demonstrations, and whiteboarding
  • Client Interaction: Develop strategies for discovery and objection handling

Industry Insights:

  • Diverse Market Verticals: Gain exposure to a broad spectrum of interesting use cases across various industries

title: Manager, FP&A Systems (Pigment)
descriptionHtml:
MongoDB is seeking a Manager, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) to be the FP&A owner of Pigment, our financial planning platform, in partnership with our Product Manager in IT. We recently migrated to Pigment from Workday’s Adaptive, and the next phase is making it great: scalable, well-governed, deeply integrated, and trusted by every planning stakeholder across the company. You'll sit at the intersection of Finance, IT, and the Business, translating how we plan into how the system works.

You're a builder who speaks finance fluently. You're comfortable building a multidimensional modeling engine in the morning and in a requirements discussion with a budget owner in the afternoon. You take projects from idea to production, communicate clearly, love working with a variety of stakeholders, and enjoy bringing structure to a fast-moving environment.

The working model for this role is flexible. We are open to fully remote or hybrid in-office/remote in our New York City or Austin offices.

Responsibilities

  • Pigment platform co-ownership: Co-own Pigment with a Product Manager in IT, serving as the primary point of contact for the Finance team. Together, you will manage role-based access and user provisioning
  • Prioritization and roadmap development: Clarify, detail, and stack rank requested improvements and enhancements across stakeholders using clear criteria such as business impact, effort, and dependencies, and, with the IT Product Manager, turn the result into a transparent, time-phased Pigment roadmap. Revisit priorities regularly and communicate trade-offs to stakeholders and finance leadership
  • Stakeholder enablement: Drive adoption of Pigment across Finance, Recruiting, HR, and and the broader business through training, documentation, office hours, and guidance on best practices. Build, gain alignment on, and implement the enablement plan from scratch
  • Partnership with vendors and implementation partners: Manage the relationship with Pigment and any consulting partners, and stay current on platform releases and best practices
  • Improve the foundation: Refine and re-architect the models built during our initial migration, reducing technical debt, simplifying logic, and improving performance and usability.Design, build, and maintain Pigment applications (blocks, metrics, lists, dimensions, and dependencies) for corporate forecasting, headcount and workforce planning, consolidation, and allocations. Translate requirements from FP&A and functional finance partners into scalable, well-documented models
  • AI and automation: Evaluate and implement Pigment's AI and workflow capabilities, and identify other opportunities to automate manual FP&A processes, from lightweight connectivity (e.g., Google Sheets plug-ins) to larger workflow improvements

What You'll Need

  • Bachelor's degree; finance, business, economics, information systems, or a related field preferred. MBA a plus
  • 5+ years of experience in FP&A, financial systems, EPM, or finance transformation, with substantial hands-on model-building experience
  • Hands-on experience building and administering models in Pigment
  • Strong command of corporate finance concepts: forecasting, headcount and compensation planning, allocations, multi-currency consolidation
  • Strong documentation habits: requirements, design specs, and process flows that others can pick up
  • Ability to partner with executive finance stakeholders and technical teams alike, and to explain complex model logic simply
  • Curiosity about new technologies and a desire to be an early adopter who can bring others along
  • Extremely organized, with a natural bent toward making sense of mess
  • Strong project management skills, with excellent follow-through across multiple concurrent priorities
  • Expert in Excel and the Google Suite; working knowledge of SQL or scripting is a plus

Nice to Have

  • Experience integrating planning tools with source systems (ERP, HRIS, data warehouse), and comfort working with data pipelines and flat-file or API-based loads
  • Pigment Academy certifications (Modeler, Power User, Admin) or Anaplan certifications
  • Experience leading a migration or implementation of a planning platform
  • Experience with modern data stack tools (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, Fivetran)
  • Experience working with AI tools to automate finance workflows
  • Prior experience managing or mentoring analysts

title: Director, Chief of Staff
descriptionHtml:
Transform your career by becoming the Chief of Staff (CoS) to MongoDB’s Chief Information Officer, working directly with executives and the leadership team across MongoDB, including but not limited to within the IT organization. 

The Role

As a senior leader in technology strategy and operations, the Chief of Staff acts as a key force multiplier for the CIO.

This role requires deep technical knowledge in enterprise systems, technology portfolio management, IT governance, systems analysis, and technology operations to support executive decision-making, enterprise technology investments, and organizational execution across the IT function.

You will run the operating rhythm of the Office of the CIO, lead the IT Program Management Office (ITPMO) that governs the IT portfolio and drive strategic program execution.

You possess the ability to blend strategic direction with hands-on tactical execution: shaping the CIO’s agenda, translating IT strategy into plans and measurable outcomes, and making sure decisions are made on time and followed through. 

The role requires evaluating enterprise technology portfolios, identifying technical dependencies and implementation risks, assessing enterprise systems and technology investments, and translating complex technology requirements into governance, prioritization, and execution plans.

You will operate as a versatile, right-hand to help manage initiatives, demonstrating excellent program management and organizational skills, building the mechanisms that help IT scale.

The role also requires applying technical and analytical expertise to enterprise technology initiatives, evaluating systems-level dependencies and risks, and translating complex IT requirements into portfolio decisions and execution plans.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Palo Alto, CA for our hybrid working model.

What You’ll Do

  • CIO leverage and prioritization: Shape and manage the CIO’s agenda, ensuring time and focus go to the highest-value priorities. Act as a trusted advisor and thought partner, framing decisions with clear options and trade-offs.
  • Operating rhythm: Design and run the IT operating cadence, including IT leadership team meetings, QBRs, planning cycles, offsites, and executive and board readouts. Build workback plans, track commitments, and surface risks early.
  • Strategy and planning: Partner with CIO Leadership team to translate IT strategy into annual and quarterly objectives, OKRs, and plans, and track progress against them. 
  • Strategy and planning:  Partner with IT leaders to evaluate strategic technology initiatives involving enterprise applications, data platforms, AI capabilities, cloud technologies, cybersecurity programs, and enterprise architecture priorities.
  • Influence:  Collaborate, influence and align with CIO Leadership, peers, and other key stakeholders as needed towards the objectives that we are driving in terms of IT strategy.  You are comfortable and possess the ability to push back, question assumptions and influence direction without authority. 
  • ITPMO and portfolio governance: Lead the ITPMO and maintain a single view of the IT portfolio: status, risks, dependencies, value, and alignment to company priorities. You will lead and govern a portfolio consisting of enterprise applications, SaaS platforms, cloud services, infrastructure modernization initiatives, data and analytics platforms, cybersecurity programs, enterprise integrations, AI-enabled capabilities, and digital transformation initiatives. Establish governance processes to evaluate implementation complexity, technical dependencies, resource requirements, architecture impacts, operational readiness, and business value.
  • Portfolio analysis and governance: Assess cross-functional IT initiatives, including dependencies, implementation risks, resource constraints, and alignment to enterprise technology priorities, to support portfolio prioritization and investment decisions. Analyze enterprise technology initiatives involving business applications, cloud platforms, enterprise integrations, identity and access management systems, cybersecurity controls, analytics environments, and AI adoption programs.  Apply knowledge of enterprise systems, systems analysis, IT governance, and technology lifecycle management to assess implementation risks, technical interdependencies, architecture considerations, and operational impacts.
  • Technology strategy and enterprise systems analysis: Evaluate enterprise technology roadmaps, systems integration requirements, enterprise architecture dependencies, data and AI initiatives, and digital transformation programs. Apply expertise in enterprise systems, technology governance frameworks, systems analysis methodologies, and IT operations to support technology investment decisions and long-term planning.
  • Strategic program execution: Oversee CIO-sponsored, cross-pillar programs and special projects. Oversee enterprise technology transformation initiatives, including cloud migrations, enterprise application deployments, process automation efforts, enterprise data initiatives, AI adoption programs, and systems integration projects. Partner with DRIs to define, resource, and deliver them, and to remove blockers and hold owners accountable.
  • Financial and resource partnership: Partner with Finance and IT leaders on budget, forecasting, headcount, and vendor and SaaS spend. Evaluate technology investment proposals, cloud consumption forecasts, infrastructure expenditures, software licensing strategies, SaaS contracts, and vendor capabilities to support prioritization and investment decisions. Assess expected business value, implementation complexity, ongoing operating costs, technical risks, and resource requirements associated with major technology investments.
  • People priorities and HR partnership: Partner with the HR Business Leader on organizational priorities, leadership transitions, and organizational change initiatives.  Demonstrated ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with sound judgement.  
  • Executive communications: Draft and quality-check CIO and leadership communications, including board materials, all-hands content, and IT-wide updates. Develop executive-level communications and board materials that synthesize complex technology topics including enterprise application strategy, technology portfolio performance, cybersecurity initiatives, cloud transformation, AI adoption, and digital modernization efforts into actionable recommendations.
  • Cross-functional alignment: Partner with Chiefs of Staff and leaders across the executive team. Represent the CIO where appropriate and manage through influence.
  • Team leadership: Develop and lead the PMO team, strengthening project management capabilities, operational excellence, and portfolio management. Establish consistent standards, drive accountability, and foster a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and effective execution across IT.
  • Continuous improvement: Define delivery standards and ways of working, and use data and AI-enabled tools to make governance, reporting, and executive support faster and more scalable. Leverage enterprise systems expertise, workflow automation technologies, analytics platforms, AI-enabled solutions, and technology management best practices to continuously improve governance, reporting, portfolio management, and operational effectiveness.

What You’ll Bring

  • 10+ years of experience in enterprise IT strategy, technology portfolio management, IT program management, or technology operations, ideally within a high-growth technology company.
  • Experience managing and governing complex enterprise technology portfolios involving enterprise applications, cloud platforms, infrastructure services, cybersecurity programs, systems integrations, data and analytics environments, AI-enabled technologies, and digital transformation initiatives. Demonstrated ability to evaluate enterprise systems, architecture dependencies, implementation risks, technical tradeoffs, and operational impacts across interconnected technology environments.
  • Experience evaluating program dependencies, implementation risks, and resource constraints to inform prioritization and execution.
  • Proven ability to design and run governance frameworks, operating cadences, and decision processes, and to manage complex, cross-functional programs end to end.
  • Financial acumen: comfort with budgets, forecasting, and investment prioritization.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, including board-ready materials that turn complex information into clear recommendations.
  • Strong analytical and systems-thinking skills; you use data to guide trade-offs and design for scale.
  • High EQ, low ego, and sound judgment. You build trust quickly and  handle confidential information with discretion.
  • AI-fluent: you apply AI and automation in your own work and in how your teams operate.
  • Demonstrated experience governing technology portfolios that include areas such as enterprise applications, infrastructure, security, SaaS, or related IT services and delivery. Familiarity with IT delivery and technology portfolios, agile practices, and change management is beneficial. 
  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Information Systems, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Management Information Systems, or a closely related technical field that provides specialized preparation in enterprise systems, systems analysis, technology architecture, cloud technologies, software and platform lifecycles, enterprise integrations, information management, cybersecurity, data systems, and IT governance.
  • Flexible schedule; occasional domestic or international travel. Bachelor’s degree required; MBA a plus.

What Success Looks Like

  • The CIO’s time and focus are aligned to the highest-value priorities, and decisions happen on schedule.
  • IT’s strategic initiatives are governed through one transparent portfolio, with clear status, risks, and ownership.
  • IT investments align to company objectives and OKRs, with improved cost transparency and delivery predictability.
  • The ITPMO is recognized across the company for execution excellence.

What This Is Not

This is not a traditional Chief of Staff or project management role. It is a senior technology strategy and operations leadership position that requires deep technical expertise, the ability to assess enterprise IT roadmaps, requirements, investments, and complex technology initiatives, and the leadership to drive execution across the organization. The role translates the CIO’s strategic vision into actionable priorities, establishes the technical governance frameworks and operating processes needed to scale MongoDB’s IT organization, and leads and develops the Technical Program Management Office (TPMO), driving program governance, portfolio execution, and cross-functional alignment across strategic IT initiatives.

title: Renewals Manager (Italian Speaker)
descriptionHtml:
MongoDB is looking for a driven, results-oriented, and experienced Renewal Manager (Senior Individual Contributor) to join our Renewals Growth Organization in EMEA. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end commercial renewal lifecycle across two critical segments in the Italian market: high-velocity Enterprise Growth accounts and strategic Public Sector (PubSec) institutions.

Success in this role requires a blend of commercial acumen, operational discipline, and domain expertise in public procurement. You will navigate complex Italian administrative and regulatory frameworks while acting as a trusted commercial advisor to ensure high retention, predictable forecasts, and long-term customer value.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin for our hybrid working model.

What You Will Be Doing

As a Renewal Manager at MongoDB, you will own the renewal execution strategy across your assigned territory, driving high Gross Retention Rates (GRR) and closing Professional Services (PS). You will collaborate closely with Sales, Customer Success, Legal, Deal Desk, and Finance to deliver a frictionless experience for both commercial enterprises and public administrations.

Renewal & Commercial Management

  • End-to-End Ownership: Proactively lead the renewal cycle for an assigned portfolio of Italian Enterprise Growth and Public Sector accounts, managing timelines, risk mitigation, and commercial negotiations to exceed retention targets
  • Public Sector Navigation: Navigate Italian public sector procurement mechanisms, tender processes, compliance mandates, and budgetary/fiscal cycles (e.g., Consip, MePA/electronic marketplaces, framework agreements, and administrative compliance)
  • Proactive Engagement: Initiate customer and partner engagements at least 120 days prior to contract expiration to uncover requirements, align with fiscal timelines, and de-risk renewals early
  • Deal Structuring & Quoting: Prepare accurate renewal proposals, multi-year commitments, order forms, and amendments that comply with MongoDB commercial policies and public contracting guidelines
  • Account Growth & Services Attachment: Partner with Account Executives to uncover expansion opportunities, protect baseline recurring revenue, and strategically position Professional Services and training credits where appropriate

Data Analysis & Forecasting

  • Maintain rigorous pipeline hygiene and accurate, real-time forecasts within Salesforce (and Tableau), tracking key renewal milestones and potential risk indicators
  • Analyze customer consumption, deployment health, and contract terms to build proactive retention strategies for at-risk accounts
  • Deliver regular, structured business updates to EMEA leadership regarding renewal progress, risk mitigation plans, and market trends

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Process Excellence

  • Orchestrate internal resources across Legal, Deal Desk, Finance, Compliance, and Security to address bespoke enterprise terms and public tender/compliance requirements
  • Partner with Enterprise and PubSec Field Sales teams to align on account strategy, customer positioning, and commercial terms
  • Help refine and standardize best practices for managing Italian public administration contracts within MongoDB’s EMEA operational model

We’re Looking for Someone With:

  • Experience: 4–5+ years of quota-carrying or commercial outcome-oriented experience in renewals, account management, or customer-facing sales within a fast-paced SaaS, cloud, or enterprise technology environment
  • Italian Public Sector Expertise: Proven familiarity with Italian Public Sector procurement processes, government buying cycles, public tenders (gare d’appalto), and purchasing vehicles/frameworks (e.g., Consip, MePA)
  • Track Record: Demonstrated history of consistently meeting or exceeding retention, renewal rate, or revenue quotas (recognition or excellence club achievements are a plus)
  • Commercial Negotiation: Sharp commercial instincts with experience negotiating complex contractual, legal, and pricing terms with enterprise procurement and legal departments
  • Language Skills: Native fluency in Italian (written and spoken) is required, along with professional business fluency in English, with the ability to articulate technical and commercial value to senior stakeholders internally and externally

title: Senior Technical Compliance Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Description

MongoDB’s Compliance team leads the strategy, execution, and maintenance of the company’s global security certifications and regulatory requirements. The team translates complex obligations into scalable operational processes and maintains an audit-ready posture across a broad portfolio of frameworks and markets.

The Senior Compliance Analyst is a senior individual-contributor role that leads high-stakes audits and specialized compliance workstreams. 

We act as the primary interface between external auditors and our internal Product, Engineering, and Legal teams. Our goal is to translate complex regulatory requirements into scalable operational processes, maintaining a compliant and audit-ready posture across our diverse portfolio.

Senior Technical Compliance Analyst (Public Sector) is a senior-level individual contributor role responsible for the lifecycle management of our most sensitive US government authorizations. This role acts as a lead for high-stakes workstreams involving FedRAMP High, DoD IL5+, CJIS, and ITAR. Unlike the Analyst level, this role takes full ownership of complex federal assessments and leads the continuous monitoring strategy for our Atlas for Government product. This role is a key resource for interpreting NIST 800-53 controls and translating them into technical requirements for our engineering teams. A requirement for this role is to be a US Citizen. 

This role will be based remotely in United States.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end external audits and certifications, coordinating scoping, audit plans, evidence, auditor engagement, findings, and final outcomes
  • Own internal audit cadences and remediation tracking; establish clear accountability for findings, milestones, dependencies, and resolution timelines, and drive timely follow-through with technical teams
  • Serve as a lead point of contact for auditors and enterprise customers during security reviews and audit deep-dives; explain MongoDB’s control environment with clarity and confidence
  • Map regulatory requirements to the central control framework and conduct gap analyses for new frameworks, jurisdictions, and market expansions
  • Assess compliance-program maturity and report material risks, gaps, trends, and delivery status to team and business leaders
  • Author and review customer-facing security documentation and audit evidence, ensuring it accurately reflects MongoDB’s controls and architectural guardrails
  • Lead cross-functional workstreams that advance the ARC roadmap; identify risks and dependencies early and recommend practical improvements to processes and tooling
  • Build and maintain executive and operational dashboards and Jira workflows for control performance, audit findings, and remediation progress; mentor stakeholders on compliance practices
  • Lead the end-to-end execution of federal assessments, coordinating with Third Party Assessment Organizations (3PAOs), agency sponsors, and the FedRAMP PMO
  • Manage the federal continuous monitoring (ConMon) program, including the timely analysis and reporting of vulnerabilities and the maintenance of the POA&M
  • Lead the annual update and technical review of core FedRAMP artifacts, including the System Security Plan (SSP), Contingency Plan (ISCP), and Incident Response Plan (IRP)
  • Act as a technical advisor to Engineering and Operations teams to ensure cloud configurations (e.g., FIPS 140-2, boundary protection, and access control) meet federal and DoD IL5+ mandates

Expectations

  • Operate independently in ambiguous, complex situations and exercise sound judgment with minimal supervision
  • Take accountability for program outcomes—not only task tracking—and proactively surface risks, trade-offs, and decisions that require escalation
  • Influence technical and business stakeholders across teams and levels to deliver sustainable compliance outcomes
  • Communicate regulatory intent and technical control requirements in concise, actionable language for both technical and non-technical audiences

Scope and Complexity

The role manages overlapping audit cycles and compliance work across international jurisdictions and across highly regulated sectors such as financial services, healthcare, and government. Work ranges from complex evidence and control assessments to interpreting emerging requirements and identifying how controls can satisfy multiple standards.

The scope is deeply technical and specialized for the US Federal, State, and Local Government markets. 

You will navigate the complexity of mapping shared controls across multiple specialized frameworks, ensuring a single remediation effort satisfies FedRAMP, CJIS, and ITAR requirements simultaneously.

Authority and Impact

The Senior Compliance Analyst has the authority to lead federal assessment project streams and represent MongoDB in technical reviews with 3PAOs and federal agencies.Your work directly enables MongoDB to secure and maintain the authorizations required to serve the Department of Defense and civilian agencies, protecting a critical revenue stream.

Expertise and Leadership

The role develops deep subject-matter expertise in assigned frameworks and in how MongoDB’s cloud architecture satisfies their requirements. It serves as a trusted resource for mapping technical evidence to regulatory intent, leads complex projects such as internal audits and framework renewals, and mentors colleagues and partner teams on effective compliance practices.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical field (such as Information Systems, Computer Science, or Cybersecurity), or equivalent practical experience
  • 7+ years of experience in GRC, Information Security, or IT Audit, preferably in a SaaS or cloud environment, with a heavy focus on US Public Sector frameworks (FedRAMP, DoD SRG, CJIS)
  • Demonstrated experience leading technical audits or compliance programs 
  • Strong understanding of cloud security principles, risk management, and how controls operate in a cloud-native environment across AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure
  • Deep understanding of NIST 800-53 and NIST 800-171 controls and how they are implemented within cloud architectures (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
  • Proven track record of managing federal audits from kickoff through to the issuance of an Authorization to Operate (ATO)
  • Exceptional ability to explain complex security configurations to government auditors and internal technical teams
  • Advanced proficiency in Jira and Confluence to track control performance data and manage large-scale federal documentation projects
  • Practical experience performing control mapping, gap analyses, remediation oversight, and program or control-maturity assessments
  • Advanced proficiency with Jira or similar tools for managing audit findings, control data, and high-volume remediation workflows
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to lead auditor/customer discussions and translate technical requirements for non-technical audiences
  • Certifications such as CISA, CRISC, CISSP, or ISO Lead Implementer are preferred

title: Engineering Manager, Customer Tools
descriptionHtml:
MongoDB is seeking an Engineering Manager to lead a team of software engineers responsible for developing and maintaining the applications and platforms that power our Customer organization. From scoping and design, through implementation, deployment and monitoring, the Customer Tools team builds the systems that make our customer-facing teams successful — internal dashboards, workflow automation, data and diagnostics platforms, and a growing suite of AI-powered capabilities. This role has two closely linked mandates: modernizing how the team itself builds software by adopting AI-assisted engineering workflows, and shipping AI-native features — chat interfaces, automated analyses, and proactive insights — directly to end users across the Customer organization. The ideal candidate brings a strong technical background, hands-on familiarity with modern AI/LLM tooling, and experience managing multi-functional teams of engineers. While this role is focused on managing the team itself, a strong technical background will help provide necessary context for the work and motivations of the team.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Mexico City for our hybrid working model.

Candidate Profile

  • 10+ years of professional experience, including:
    • 5+ years of experience managing teams of software engineers. This includes people-management responsibilities such as hiring, performance and growth management, compensation planning, and career development
    • 5+ years providing technical leadership to development teams, including project scoping and design, leading code reviews, driving best practices, providing architectural guidance, and managing technical stakeholders
    • 5+ years of hands-on experience building scalable high-availability systems and integrations
  • Experience working with modern web technologies and infrastructure stacks, such as TypeScript, ReactJS, Python, AWS services, GitHub, Claude Code, Cursor, etc
  • Genuine enthusiasm for AI-assisted software development — you've used tools like Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, or similar in your own workflow and have a point of view on how they change engineering practice
  • Experience building or shipping AI-powered product features (e.g., chat/conversational interfaces, LLM-driven analyses, recommendation or insight engines) is a strong plus
  • Understanding of agile software development methodologies and test-driven development
  • Deep experience in software engineering management with a track record of effectively balancing short-term needs with long-term strategic investment
  • Experience managing multiple stakeholders and external vendors and can clearly articulate risks and dependencies on projects
  • Passion for data-related services and understanding of good systems design
  • Experience building platforms or tools where the main users are internal customers (technical and non-technical) or customer-facing teams
  • You care about facilitating learning and growth on the team – you put our engineers first
  • You lead the team to explore all potential paths to a solution, while accepting that failure is part of the process
  • You're comfortable operating at the intersection of "how we build" and "what we build" — championing AI adoption in engineering process while also shipping AI in the product

Position Expectations

  • Manage a team of 8-10 individual contributors, responsible for ensuring their success, aiding their career growth, and facilitating their technical work
  • Drive adoption of AI-assisted engineering workflows across the team — code generation, review, testing, and documentation — to increase velocity and quality. The goal is to empower software engineers with AI to help the team scale
  • Own the roadmap for AI-powered end-user features, including chat-based interfaces, automated analyses, and insights that help customer-facing teams work more effectively
  • Ensure the team is running smoothly by helping to eliminate technical barriers, coordinating with other teams regarding dependencies, and focusing on the overall happiness of the team
  • Contribute to planning for organizational growth, including allocation of engineering resources, future hiring plans, and assignment of projects
  • Set team culture by example, including modeling a thoughtful, hands-on approach to evaluating and adopting new AI tools and practices
  • Estimate the delivery timeline for projects, and communicate well with upper management and the broader team regarding project execution 

Success Measures

The Manager will be successful in this role when they can execute the following strategic tasks:

  • People: Collaborate with colleagues from various departments and manage stakeholder relationships. Participate in the performance management process and define meaningful growth goals for individual engineers. Establish reasonable metrics for measuring performance improvements across the team
  • Organization: Ability to manage multiple parallel efforts and prioritize resources based upon understanding and interpreting business needs
  • Communication: Effectively capture requirements from non-technical customers and ensure they understand the implementation details. Provide transparency on delivery and process
  • Research: Research best approaches to implementing workflows — including AI-assisted engineering practices — that enable our business. Gather and analyze feedback from internal stakeholders
  • Innovation: Identify and evaluate opportunities to apply AI to both the team's engineering workflows and the products it ships, moving from experimentation to production responsibly
  • Customer Service: Provide pragmatic solutions for our internal stakeholders. Provide great customer service when interfacing with internal customers

title: Senior Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
The Application Modernization Platform (AMP) team is dedicated to solving one of the industry's biggest challenges: transforming rigid, legacy applications that suffer from poor scalability and high operating costs into modern, microservices-based architectures on MongoDB. An important aspect of this is Data Migration. MongoDB is building a world-class team in India to build tooling that helps customers migrate their data from legacy relational databases to MongoDB in real-time. As companies modernise their application and data ecosystems, they are increasingly drawn to the flexibility and scalability of the document model. The tools developed by the Data Migration team are critical in this journey, helping customers with schema modeling, initial data loads, and continuous data synchronization.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer with experience in the Java ecosystem, streaming systems, and data-intensive applications to join our team. We are building a sophisticated data migration suite using a modern technology stack, which includes Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, Debezium, and React. A successful candidate will be a key contributor to our backend services, collaborating closely with product management and other engineers to design and implement cutting-edge products that solve complex customer challenges.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurgaon for our hybrid working model.

The ideal candidate for this role will have

  • 6+ years of commercial software development experience with at least one JVM language such as Java, preferably using the Spring ecosystem
  • Solid experience in software architecture and development
  • Extensive experience with streaming data platforms such as Apache Kafka and Change Data Capture (CDC) tools like Debezium
  • Extensive experience with relational and document data modeling and hands-on experience with at least one SQL database (Postgres, MySQL, etc) and at least one document database (e.g. MongoDB)
  • Exposure to client-side technologies such as JavaScript and React is a plus
  • Good understanding of algorithms, data structures and their time and space complexity
  • Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and contribute to the overall technical direction and roadmap of the team
  • Curiosity, a positive attitude, and a drive to continue learning
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Position Expectations

  • Contribute high-quality, well-tested code to the modernization and framework team and its surrounding services
  • Collaborate effectively with Product Management, other engineers, and designers to build and deliver on the product roadmap
  • Participate actively in code reviews to enforce best practices and patterns
  • Help troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues in our distributed systems
  • Give and solicit feedback on technical design documents and pull requests
  • Perform tasks related to process such as CI/CD, quality, testing, etc 

Success Measures

Within the first three months, you will have

  • Familiarize yourself with the MongoDB Modernization Infrastructure & Frameworks stack
  • Set up software development infrastructure (tech stack, build tools, etc) to enable development using the relevant tech stacks
  • Started collaborating with your peers and contributed to code reviews and design reviews

Within six months, you will have

  • Familiarised yourself with the rest of our the application modernization tool stack
  • Delivered at least one large scale feature that spans the entire tech stack
  • Reviewed and contributed to scope and technical design documents

Within 12 months, you will have

  • Become a key contributor to our stack, capable of taking on complex features independently
  • Helped recruit and interview new members of the team
  • Collaborated effectively with other teams at MongoDB on cross-functional projects

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin for our hybrid working model.

What You'll Do

  • Grow PMs into the best versions of themselves. Lead a high-performing team of IC Product Managers, coaching them on product craft, strategy execution, and career growth. Meet every PM where they are and build a culture of creativity and ownership in line with MongoDB's Core Values
  • Act as a player-coach: guide day-to-day product judgment, while stepping in directly on the highest-priority product questions, toughest trade-offs, and sensitive stakeholder situations without taking ownership away from your team
  • Build the operating engine that makes the team great. Set the product standards the team runs on with clear decision-making mechanisms, building a culture of rapid hypothesis testing and iterative experimentation so the team moves quickly, and everyone knows what matters most and why
  • Set goals, track the right metrics, and drive outcomes. Builder tooling has a profound impact on activation, retention, and churn. Optimize the developer journey and reduce time-to-value for integrations. You'll build a strong partnership with product analytics to identify the right signals, formulate meaningful metrics, and use data to drive decisions
  • Champion agentic development. Builders are using AI to write their code and build agent-native applications, and MongoDB is the data platform at the center of that shift. Make sure our framework integrations are purpose-built for the way agents actually work, with memory, state, and context as core capabilities. Bring real enthusiasm and a clear point of view on where agentic development is going, and set ambitious goals for the builder impact that follows
  • Place smart, ambitious bets on where MongoDB shows up next. Shape a portfolio investment strategy that looks beyond adoption numbers to where the ecosystem is heading, balancing the integrations builders rely on today with rising frameworks and early bets that could define what comes next. Recommend where to build, where to partner, and where to step back and work with leadership and partner teams to land those calls
  • Be a credible technical voice. You’ll engage deeply with engineering on decisions involving client libraries, agentic workflows, and developer tooling. You won’t write the code, but you’ll need to understand it well enough to help the team make the right tradeoffs, communicate confidently with technical customers,  and be a strong advocate for the builders out there who are creating with MongoDB
  • Win the trust of the ecosystem, inside and outside MongoDB. Frameworks is partnership work at its core. Build relationships with framework maintainers and AI platforms that trust MongoDB to ship quality and stay committed after launch. Align with the Partnerships team, product marketing, developer relations, and solutions architects so everyone backing a framework moves together

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of product management experience, including managing and developing IC Product Managers in a technical product organization
  • A track record of growing PMs with different strengths and working styles, and adapting your coaching, performance conversations, and development plans for each of them
  • Proven track record as a player-coach: managing direct reports while maintaining deep hands-on product, technical, and customer fluency
  • You’ve raised the product bar for a team, with clear prioritization, sharp product decisions, and PMs who can explain the why behind their roadmap
  • A data-driven approach to decisions, including partnering with product analytics to define the right metrics in order to connect builder tooling to activation, retention, and churn, even without a direct revenue line
  • Experience with growth loops, experimentation frameworks, or PLG motions for developer tools
  • Genuine passion for AI and developer experience. You are excited by how builders are working with AI and agents today, and you have a point of view on where agentic development is going
  • Real-world experience building products for builders and developers, with a firsthand feel for their pain and what moves the needle
  • Familiarity with builder-focused go-to-market, including messaging, positioning, and what it teams to market to a technical audience
  • Deep technical credibility to engage confidently on DevEx, client libraries, distributed systems, and developer tooling (e.g., reviewing code and docs to evaluate how an integration's architecture handles patterns and how that impacts the builder experience)
  • Experience building partnerships with external organizations, such as open source projects, platform companies, or technology partners, while ensuring that internal teams, like partnerships, product marketing, and developer relations, are appropriately engaged
  • Equally effective in an executive review as in a working session with engineers, with experience getting great products built inside a company of meaningful scale

Success Measures

Within 30 days:

  • Dive deep into the full MongoDB tech stack, from core database to Atlas
  • Build working relationships with your engineering, product marketing, and partner counterparts

  • Evolve the existing portfolio strategy for the AI Builder Experience Frameworks portfolio that balances customer-driven investments with a proactive arm for emerging frameworks and trends
  • Actively participate in hiring, performance conversations, and team development activities

title: Product Manager, S2P
descriptionHtml:
MongoDB is seeking an experienced and outcome-oriented Product Manager to partner with the Product Lead for Source-to-Pay (S2P) and Travel & Expense (T&E) to deliver the roadmap across these domains. This role sits at the intersection of Finance, Procurement, Accounting, employees, and Technology, helping MongoDB scale spend-management operations through intuitive experiences, reliable platforms, strong controls, and intelligent automation.

You will own product discovery, strategy, roadmap, prioritization, requirements, delivery partnership, and adoption for a portfolio that may include procurement, supplier onboarding and management, purchasing, invoicing, business travel, corporate cards, expense submission, audit, reimbursement, and related reporting and integrations.

The ideal candidate combines strong product judgment with enterprise business-systems and AI fluency. You can move comfortably from understanding an employee or Finance pain point to defining a scalable solution, evaluating where AI can improve the experience or operation, aligning stakeholders, guiding an engineering team, and measuring whether the change delivered business value.

What you’ll do

  • Partner with the Product Lead for S2P and T&E to shape, prioritize, and deliver the roadmap, translating Finance Technology and company objectives into clear product outcomes and execution plans
  • Build deep understanding of users and business processes across Procurement, Accounts Payable, Accounting, Travel & Expense, Finance, Legal, Security, Internal Audit, and employees
  • Translate business problems into clear product outcomes, including detailed PRDs, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, process designs, and release plans
  • Lead discovery through interviews, workflow analysis, data analysis, process mapping, and collaboration with subject-matter experts
  • Prioritize investments across new capabilities, enhancements, integrations, operational improvements, technical debt, compliance needs, and user experience
  • Partner closely with Engineering, Architecture, Business Systems, Data & Analytics, Security, Compliance, Internal Audit, and external vendors to deliver reliable and maintainable solutions
  • Drive improvements across procurement and spend workflows, including requisitions, approvals, supplier onboarding, supplier data, purchase orders, invoicing, payment-related handoffs, and spend visibility
  • Drive improvements across T&E workflows, including travel booking, expense submission, corporate cards, policy enforcement, audit, approvals, reimbursement, employee communications, and support experiences
  • Advance intelligent automation, AI-assisted workflows, and self-service capabilities that reduce manual work, improve processing speed, and provide a better employee experience
  • Identify, frame, and prioritize practical AI opportunities across S2P and T&E, such as conversational support, document and receipt understanding, anomaly or fraud detection, policy guidance, risk-based routing, and workflow recommendations
  • Partner with Data & Analytics, Engineering, Security, Privacy, Compliance, and business owners to define responsible AI requirements, including data quality, human oversight, explainability, access controls, monitoring, evaluation, and failure-handling
  • Define and monitor product metrics such as adoption, cycle time, straight-through processing, manual-touch reduction, approval and reimbursement time, exception rates, policy compliance, data quality, support volume, and user satisfaction
  • Ensure product decisions support appropriate access controls, segregation of duties, auditability, data integrity, privacy, and SOX or other applicable control requirements
  • Lead product delivery rituals and operating rhythms, including roadmap reviews, backlog refinement, sprint planning, demos, release readiness, stakeholder readouts, and retrospectives
  • Coordinate integrated testing, business validation, launch readiness, change management, training, communications, and post-launch measurement
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to business leaders and help stakeholders make informed trade-offs among value, risk, cost, time, user experience, and technical health
  • Support incident and problem management for in-scope platforms, partnering with Engineering and Business Systems on root-cause analysis, remediation, and stakeholder communication when issues arise

What we’re looking for

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, or a related field
  • 5+ years of product management experience, or equivalent experience in enterprise technology, business systems, product ownership, or solution delivery
  • Proven experience owning an enterprise product or set of connected tools from discovery through delivery and adoption
  • Experience with Source-to-Pay, procurement, accounts payable, travel, expense, corporate card, or related Finance operations
  • Strong understanding of enterprise business-system concepts, including workflows, approvals, master data, integrations, reporting, controls, and role-based access
  • Experience partnering with Agile or iterative delivery teams and translating complex business needs into actionable requirements
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to use data to frame problems, prioritize work, and measure outcomes
  • Demonstrated AI fluency: understand the strengths, limitations, risks, and economics of modern AI capabilities, and know how to translate them into responsible enterprise product opportunities
  • Experience defining AI-enabled product requirements, evaluation criteria, feedback loops, or human-in-the-loop workflows is preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and make progress in a complex, matrixed environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical and operational topics to executive, business, and engineering audiences
  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution and attention to operational detail
  • Experience with one or more relevant platforms, such as Coupa, Concur, NetSuite, Brex, AppZen, Navan or comparable procurement, ERP, expense, travel, or spend-management solutions
  • Experience with integrations, APIs, middleware, data flows, and third-party SaaS platforms
  • Familiarity with audit, compliance, SOX, privacy, or internal-control considerations in Finance systems is preferred

Success in this role

Within 6 months

  • Build strong relationships with key Finance, Procurement, T&E, Technology, Engineering, and control partners
  • Develop a clear understanding of the current S2P and T&E operating model, product landscape, integrations, pain points, controls, and roadmap commitments
  • Establish a fact base of user needs, operational metrics, platform risks, and improvement opportunities
  • Assess the highest-value AI and automation opportunities, establish a baseline for current manual effort and service quality, and identify the data, control, and adoption requirements for experimentation

Within 12 months

  • Deliver a scalable set of capabilities that reduces manual effort and improves the end-to-end S2P and T&E experience
  • Demonstrate measurable progress against agreed product outcomes and service-level indicators
  • Strengthen platform reliability, integration quality, auditability, and operational readiness
  • Become a trusted product partner to Finance and Technology leaders and a recognized subject-matter expert for the assigned domain

What makes you successful

  • Product mindset: Focus on outcomes, user value, adoption, and continuous improvement—not just feature delivery
  • Strategic execution: Connect day-to-day prioritization to longer-term Finance Technology strategy
  • Stakeholder leadership: Build trust, surface trade-offs early, and create alignment without relying on authority
  • Technical fluency: Understand systems, integrations, data, architecture, security, and technical debt well enough to make sound product decisions
  • AI fluency: Distinguish appropriate AI use cases from rule-based automation, articulate trade-offs among accuracy, latency, cost, privacy, and user trust, and create a disciplined path from experimentation to production
  • Operational ownership: Care about reliability, controls, supportability, change management, and the experience after launch
  • Structured problem-solving: Break down ambiguous problems, use evidence, and make decisions with appropriate speed
  • Clear communication: Create crisp narratives, requirements, decisions, and executive updates

Why join Finance Technology at MongoDB

You will help modernize foundational systems that employees and Finance teams rely on every day. This is an opportunity to shape how MongoDB manages company spend, improve the experience of thousands of users, and build scalable, controlled, and increasingly automated processes at the intersection of Finance, Technology, and operations.

title: Manager, Executive Communications
descriptionHtml:
The AI era is redefining what enterprises need from their data layer, and MongoDB is at the center of that shift. Our intelligent data platform gives organizations everything they need to build and run AI agents in production — real-time operational data, search, and memory, all in one place. Millions of builders and over 70,000 customers, including a large share of the Fortune 100, rely on MongoDB for their most important applications. Join our team and be at the forefront of this next wave of innovation.

The MongoDB Communications team is looking for a strategic and versatile communications professional to serve as our Manager, Executive Communications. This role will support executive communications efforts across the entire company, and be a strategic partner for both internal and external storytelling. 

Reporting to the Director, Executive Communications, you'll work in close partnership with Corporate Communications, Product Communications, Analyst Relations, Employee Communications, Social and Influencer, and various Marketing teams, as well as directly with our executives and their offices. Executive Communications is a newly formed, company-wide, programmatic function, so this is a build role as much as a delivery one: you’ll help shape how the program runs while running it.

This role is based in the U.S., with hybrid or remote options available. Occasional travel will be required.

Position Expectations

  • Serve as the day-to-day communications partner to a portfolio of senior executives and their teams, developing and maintaining their point of view, messaging pillars, and external platform over time
  • Write in multiple executive voices across formats: internal and external events, keynotes and talk tracks, social, bylines, internal memos, customer and partner correspondence, and briefing materials
  • Own comms playbooks for recurring executive moments — org changes, all hands, launches, earnings, exec transitions, and crisis — building and running a repeatable system
  • Partner with executive offices (chiefs of staff and EAs) to turn business context into narrative, and to build the intake, prep, and review rhythms that make executive support predictable and workable for each unique office.
  • Build AI into the work:use and help design the tooling that accelerates research, voice capture, drafting, and briefing prep, so a small team can serve a large executive bench
  • Partner with the AEO/GEO team to make our executives’ ideas discoverable and credible in a world where audiences get answers from LLMs and agents, not just search and press
  • Identify and prepare executives for the right rooms and stages, working with Corporate Comms, Product Comms, Analyst Relations, Social, and the events and keynote teams to secure and support those opportunities
  • Monitor industry news, competitive activity, and the conversations our executives’ peers are shaping, and translate that into proactive opportunities
  • Measure and report on influence: whether ideas travel, whether executives reach the audiences that matter, and whether the narrative shows up in the rooms where decisions get made

We're Looking for Someone With…

  • 6+ years in communications, with meaningful time spent writing for and advising senior executives at a high-growth technology, enterprise software, SaaS, or cloud company
  • Exceptional ghostwriting range — the ability to pick up a voice quickly, hold it consistently, and translate complex technical and business concepts into language people remember
  • Experience building executive thought leadership platforms, including speaking, social, and bylines, with a track record of placements and moments you can point to
  • Sound judgment and discretion with confidential and sensitive material, and the credibility to push back on a senior executive when the message isn’t landing
  • A systems mindset — you build repeatable playbooks, briefs, and intake processes rather than running every request as a one-off
  • Fluency with AI tools and genuine curiosity about using them to scale a small team’s output, with a clear eye for where human judgment is non-negotiable
  • A data-informed approach to measuring communications impact, and comfort being measured on influence rather than reach
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills across comms, marketing, events, and executive offices

descriptionHtml:

You will turn complex infrastructure operations into intuitive, reliable, and increasingly automated experiences that accelerate customer adoption and drive Atlas growth.

You will own the vision, strategy, and 12-month roadmap, including how Atlas evolves to support AI agents. AI agents are changing how teams build and operate cloud infrastructure, and this role will shape how Atlas leads that change.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin for our hybrid working model.

  • Shape Atlas's agentic experience by making Atlas easy for AI agents to discover, understand, and safely operate, while keeping developers in control
  • Drive adoption and revenue growth by identifying high-impact opportunities across programmatic experiences and defining their business models, pricing, and packaging
  • Lead customer discovery and product validation with developers, platform teams, and enterprise customers, translating qualitative and quantitative insights into product decisions

  • Own product positioning, messaging, and go-to-market for your products, translating product value into compelling customer narratives and driving launches and adoption in partnership with Sales and Customer Success
  • Establish clear success metrics for adoption, retention, and Atlas consumption through programmatic usage, using product analytics, customer feedback, and market signals to evaluate progress and adjust priorities
  • Communicate product direction and decisions clearly to senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders, including the rationale behind what we will and will not build

What you’ll bring

  • 7+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products used by developers or technical teams

  • Experience translating ambiguous customer and business problems into focused strategies, product narratives, roadmaps, and prioritized execution plans
