Based in Gurgaon, this role will use employee insight, people data, and strong partnership with business leaders and People teams to strengthen culture, manager capability, employee journeys, workplace experience, and operational excellence to support MongoDB’s continued growth and expansion.

Work Model:This is an in-office role based in Gurgaon, with an expectation to work from the office at least three days per week. This requirement may change based on business needs.

The Employee Experience Team is the trusted strategic HR partner designing and enabling a scalable, consistent, and sustainable employee experience worldwide. In partnership with Recruiting, Total Rewards, Talent Development, HR Shared Services, HR Business Partnering, Workplace, and Legal, the team supports the full employee lifecycle and creates capacity for higher-value work.

Key Responsibilities

  • India EEx Strategy Execution & Portfolio Leadership: In partnership with the India EEx leader, translate the India EEx strategy and operating agenda into a prioritized roadmap, clear ownership, governance, and measurable outcomes. Lead delivery across interdependent workstreams; surface trade-offs, risks, and decisions early; and keep execution aligned with global EEx priorities and local business needs
  • Employee Lifecycle & Service Excellence: Provide senior oversight of the employee and manager experience across onboarding, probation, performance, leave and accommodations, internal mobility, and separation. Lead resolution of complex escalations and drive improvements in service quality, consistency, and employee journeys in partnership with HRSS and relevant People teams
  • Employee Experience Insights & Outcomes: Set clear outcome measures for India EEx priorities and use employee listening, people data, service trends, and recurring case themes to identify systemic opportunities and risks. Convert insights into recommendations, prioritized action, and visible progress reviews with the India EEx leader and business stakeholders
  • Manager, Talent & Leadership Effectiveness: Advise and influence managers and senior leaders on performance, feedback, team effectiveness, and values-based leadership. Partner with HRBPs and business leaders to embed earlier talent interventions—including talent reviews, retention, career growth, and critical-talent risks—into business planning and leadership routines
  • Employee Relations, Investigations & Risk: Provide senior leadership on complex employee relations matters, investigations, mediation, and appropriate recommendations. Strengthen consistent, fair case practice; identify patterns and preventative actions; and support a safe, respectful workplace, including partnership on POSH processes where required
  • India Compliance & Governance: Lead proactive identification and management of people-related compliance risks across India locations, maintaining current knowledge of central and relevant state-level employment requirements. Advise leaders, shape practical policy and process responses, and coordinate with Legal, Payroll, Benefits, HRSS, and Project teams on controls, escalations, and resolution
  • Operating Model, Simplification & Technology: Lead cross-functional redesign of employee journeys and people processes to reduce complexity and create capacity for higher-value work. Drive adoption of standardization, self-service, automation, and AI-enabled tools where appropriate, in partnership with HRSS, global projects, and global EEx teams; balance efficiency with employee needs and local requirements
  • Workplace, Culture & Community: Shape and deliver a connected, productive, safe, and inclusive site experience with Workplace and local leaders. Establish relevant ways to assess progress, strengthen hybrid ways of working and local culture, and operationalize global moments and campaigns with appropriate local nuance
  • Enterprise Change & Operational Excellence: Lead complex, cross-functional change from problem definition through adoption and outcomes. Build scalable operating rhythms, clear escalation pathways, and strong governance; clarify ownership and make evidence-based recommendations on what to stop, simplify, standardize, localize, or scale
  • Senior Leadership & Influence: Operate with sound judgment and enterprise perspective across a global matrix. Build alignment across leaders and teams without relying solely on formal authority; address friction constructively; disagree and commit; and model bold, direct, kind, and accountable leadership that fosters clarity, psychological safety, and effective decision-making
  • Continuous Improvement:Anticipate changes in the business, workforce, employment landscape, workplace, and HR technology. Bring external and internal insights forward and adapt priorities and execution as EEx strategy and business requirements evolve

Requirements

  • Experience: Master’s degree in HR or a related field, with typically 12+ years of progressive HR experience spanning employee relations, business partnership, performance and talent management, and HR operations. Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional programs and advising senior leaders is essential. Experience in a high-growth technology company or global matrix organization is preferred
  • India expertise: Deep working knowledge of employment laws and relevant state-level requirements across India, with a track record of guiding senior stakeholders through complex employment matters, investigations, grievances, and risk decisions with sound judgment and discretion
  • Strategic and operational leadership: Proven ability to translate strategy into a prioritized portfolio, lead multiple complex initiatives through ambiguity, influence cross-functional stakeholders, and deliver sustainable results while remaining close enough to operational detail to address critical issues
  • Data, process, and technology fluency:Strong analytical capability and experience using employee insight and people data to set priorities, evaluate outcomes, identify root causes, and influence decisions. Demonstrated ability to lead process redesign and adoption of technology, automation, or self-service is advantageous
  • Executive communication and influence: Exceptional written and verbal communication, with credibility to advise senior leaders and build alignment across functions, geographies, and levels of the organization
  • Leadership effectiveness:Strong program and portfolio-management skills, commercial and organizational judgment, discretion with confidential matters, and the ability to prioritize, delegate through partnerships, and sustain progress in a fast-changing environment

What Success Looks Like

  • You are a trusted advisor to India leaders and managers, known for sound judgment, clear communication, and practical solutions
  • India EEx priorities are delivered through a clear roadmap, ownership, cross-functional governance, and measurable outcomes aligned to business needs
  • Employees and managers experience simpler, more consistent journeys and clearer support across key moments that matter
  • Employee insight and people data translate into measurable improvements in service, manager capability, workplace experience, and local culture.

title: Financial Analyst, P&T
descriptionHtml:
The worldwide data management software market is massive (According to IDC, the data management software market is forecast to be $94 billion in 2023 growing to approximately $153 billion in 2027, representing a 13% compound annual growth rate). At MongoDB, we are transforming industries and empowering developers to build amazing apps that people use every day. We are the leading developer data platform and the first database provider to IPO in over 20 years. Join our team and be at the forefront of innovation and creativity.

MongoDB is seeking a Financial Analyst, AI & Emerging Products to grow our Product & Technology (P&T) FP&A team. You will be responsible for financial planning, forecasting, reporting, and partnering with the business to drive decision-making and resource planning. This Financial Analyst is expected to make significant contributions to the success of MongoDB by working with executives and team leaders to evaluate, plan, execute, and measure strategic business initiatives.

This position requires an adaptable self-starter who is able to work comfortably and communicate clearly with stakeholders across the organization, progress tasks from start to finish, and enjoy working in a fast-paced, challenging environment. The working model for this role is flexible. This is a hybrid in-office/remote role based in our New York City office.

Responsibilities:

  • Business Partnering: Quickly establish positive relationships and become a trusted partner for your P&T stakeholders, allowing you to build a solid understanding of business drivers and ensuring alignment with overall company objectives
  • Forecast Coordination & Modeling: Build and maintain detailed financial and operating models to support your stakeholders in all aspects of their budget including headcount planning and optimization
  • Analyzing: Conduct ad-hoc analyses and build financial models to guide leaders toward efficient operating strategies, resource allocation, and investments in product initiatives
  • Operational Effectiveness: Improve and scale business, operational, and financial processes understood by all important partners, including standardizing and automating reports and improving how we leverage internal systems
  • Perform financial month-end close activities, including headcount reconciliations, accrual reviews, and budget vs. actuals analysis and reporting
  • Partner with recruiting and HR partners to drive efficiencies in workforce planning and reporting for executives and their leaders
  • Operate independently to prepare schedules and relevant analysis for each planning cycle and develops clear support for management review

What You'll Need:

  • Bachelor’s Degree; finance, business or economics preferred
  • 0-3 years experience in FP&A, and/or analytical, critical thinking, and quantitative skills
  • Proficiency in financial modeling, Google Suite, and Microsoft Excel; financial planning tools (Pigment) are a plus 
  • Ability to analyze data, draw conclusions, and develop actionable recommendations
  • Confidence to forge strong relationships with business partners at all levels of the organization; prior business partnering experience preferred, within a tech company a plus 
  • Drive for results and a sense of urgency with the capacity to multitask and prioritize

title: Senior Industry Consultant, Healthcare
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for passionate technologists to join our growing Industry Solutions Team (IST), a remote/flexible, globally-dispersed team. Our objective is to align MongoDB AI platform with industry specific solutions. We understand our enterprise clients and their needs to modernize software legacies, transition to modernized solutions, and guide them through continuous data-driven modernization.

MongoDB Industry Solutions Consultants communicate the direction of MongoDB’s platform to customers and industry partner communities (i.e. webinars, client presentations, blog content, video content, live/virtual events, demos, account support, etc.), while keeping up with continuous data trends. A key component is direct account engagement with the clients’ senior executives, to help business leaders see the vision of how MongoDB is a solution for their industry’s needs, wants, and pain points. This will require a technical background, foundational DBMS/DBaaS understanding, programming knowledge, an interest in customer-facing interactions, and a keen interest to continue learning and digging into how this applies to Healthcare industries.

You'll work closely with multiple teams, such as marketing, product, pre-sales, sales enablement and sales teams, as well as play a key role in winning deals and driving the business forward, as subject matter experts. Our team is an exciting, diverse group, made up of ambitious, innovative thinkers that range from software thought leaders and entrepreneurs to young professionals. Learn more about #LifeAtMongoDB here!  

This role will primarily focus on the North and Latin American market but you also support other regions such as Europe and Middle East (EMEA). As such, the location for this role is based in Toronto, Canada, and includes about 30% of traveling across the North American region and to some extent globally. 

 What you do at MongoDB

  • You translate technical concepts and patterns into business benefits for senior management and executives as well as enterprise architects and product owners. This includes the creation of demos, training materials, slide decks, whitepapers, blogs and YouTube videos that communicate the business value of MongoDB as a leading industry solution
  • You partner with our sales team to help ensure success in accounts ranging from small startups to large enterprises (i.e customizing solutions, client presentations, etc.). We are NOT a sales team, but we work closely with sales
  • You support sales through enablement, with activities such as technical discovery, demos, training, proof of values, presentations, and documentation of technical decision criteria; working across a number of sales opportunities in parallel. You will take initiative in creating more opportunities for sales support
  • You present MongoDB’s position at various events - either in person or digitally
  • You represent MongoDB in international organizations, in workgroups, committees, and standardization bodies
  • You are tightly aligned with our product management organization and communicate field requirements, changes you see in industry requirements to the product management leadership
  • You proactively seek opportunities to enable other functions such as Sales, Pre-Sales or Marketing
  • You help our team continue building processes in how we work with each other and other teams throughout MongoDB, to make ourselves as scalable and efficient as possible
  • Enjoy the ride because we’re growing fast

As a candidate, you should have

  • More than 5 years in the Healthcare Sector (Lifesciences, clinical data, insurance) directly or in a consultative form in multiple areas; candidates with less years of experience but with exceptional expertise can be considered accordingly
  • Strong programming/software engineering skills for demo development
  • Deep expertise in clinical data structures (openEHR, Snomed, FHIR), and the US healthcare system
  • Expertise in technical architecture, solution design, and delivering complex technical solutions at scale
  • Excellent presentation and communication skills with the ability to visualize and communicate complex information to all levels of an organization - both internally and externally
  • Ability to discuss a broad range of data technologies (non-exhaustive list:  RDBMS, document, key-value, unstructured, noSQL, JSON,...)
  • A pro-active, self-starter with the drive to learn new skills and become an expert in that field
  • The ability to travel up to 30% globally in normal circumstances for conferences, clients, team shadowing, team events, MongoDB events, etc.
  • Strong English language skills, Spanish is an advantage

Ideally you would also have

  • A Master’s degree or higher in a relevant discipline
  • Experience in addressing data related challenges in unifying standards, advanced data analytics, AI-applications or similar specialized areas in the Healthcare sector
  • Knowledge of latest innovations and emerging trends within the Healthcare sector
  • Strong understanding of data modeling and data architecture principles for various use cases in the industry
  • In-depth understanding of database schema design principles, and database programming
  • Experience with definition of standards, participation in forums, councils, steering committees is a strong advantage

What you will learn

  • MongoDB product suite (i.e. core database server, Atlas, Atlas Search & Vector Search, Charts, tools, etc.)
  • MongoDB complementary technologies (i.e. Apache Kafka, Kubernetes, etc.)
  • Modern architecture design patterns and methodologies (i.e. microservices, event-driven architectures, DevOps, cloud, etc.)
  • MongoDB’s partners’ technologies and how we collaborate
  • Sales techniques and related soft skills (i.e. presentations, demonstrations, whiteboarding, discovery, objection handling, etc.)
  • Exposure to a wide variety of markets and a broad spectrum of interesting use cases

title: Senior Data Analyst
descriptionHtml:
MongoDB’s Analytics team partners across go-to-market and Product to help the business make better decisions. We work with Sales, GTM Operations, FP&A, CRM Technology, and Product teams to connect data at a granular level, understand performance, and identify opportunities to improve how we operate.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you’ll work with business and technical partners to frame questions, deliver reliable analysis, and translate findings into practical recommendations. You’ll contribute to analytics and reporting that make complex information easier to understand and act on.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurgaon for our hybrid working model.

What you’ll do

  • Partner with Sales, GTM Operations, FP&A, CRM Technology, and Product to understand business questions and shape them into clear analytical work
  • Analyze business performance, including pipeline health, funnel movement, productivity, attainment, and other team priorities
  • Write SQL analyses and build reusable datasets; use Python or R for data exploration, analysis, and automation
  • Build and improve dashboards and reporting that help teams monitor performance and investigate changes
  • Identify meaningful trends, risks, and opportunities; explain what the analysis does and does not show; and recommend next steps
  • Work with data and systems partners to investigate quality issues, clarify definitions, and improve data reliability
  • Communicate results clearly to technical and non-technical audiences and follow through on whether recommendations are adopted

What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or a related field. We welcome candidates with different backgrounds and strong evidence of relevant skills and impact
  • Strong SQL skills are required, including the ability to join and aggregate data, reason about metric definitions, and validate results
  • Experience using Python or R for analysis and data manipulation is a plus
  • Experience turning business questions into structured analysis and communicating findings to different audiences
  • Familiarity with dashboards or data visualization tools; Tableau experience is helpful
  • Good data judgment: you check assumptions and data quality, are transparent about limitations, and can distinguish a useful signal from noise
  • A collaborative, dependable approach to working with business and technical partners, including when requirements are still taking shape
  • Experience in SaaS, go-to-market, sales, finance, or product analytics is helpful, but not required

title: Senior Solutions Architect
descriptionHtml:
MongoDB Pre-Sales Solutions Architects are technical business advisors who help customers design, justify, and adopt reliable, scalable systems using MongoDB’s data platform. They own the technical strategy across complex opportunities—from discovery and qualification through architecture, proof of value, executive alignment, and successful adoption—and connect technical decisions to measurable business outcomes.

You’ll partner closely with Account Executives, Sales Leadership, Customer Success, Professional Services, and ecosystem partners to shape multi-threaded account strategies, build champions, de-risk complex architectures, and drive expansion. You’ll serve as a trusted advisor to developers, architects, operations leaders, and business executives, helping organizations modernize legacy systems, build AI-powered applications, and realize measurable value from MongoDB.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Singapore for our hybrid working model.

As an ideal candidate, you will have:

  • Ideally 8 to 11 years of related experience in a customer facing role, with 5 to 7 years of experience in pre-sales with enterprise software
  • Minimum of 3 years experience with modern scripting languages (e.g. Python, Node.js, SQL) and/or popular programming languages (e.g. C/C++, Java, C#) in a professional capacity
  • Experience designing with scalable and highly available distributed systems in the cloud and on-prem
  • Demonstrated ability to lead architecture reviews for complex, multi-component applications and platforms, identifying risks, evaluating trade-offs, and providing clear guidance to modernize, optimize, and de-risk the solution
  • Excellent presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to convey complex technical and business concepts in a clear and compelling manner to technology and business leadership
  • Ability to partner with Sales Leadership and Account Executives on multi-threaded account and territory strategies, prioritize opportunities, constructively challenge assumptions, and align MongoDB and ecosystem resources around measurable customer and business outcomes
  • Demonstrated ability to connect technical recommendations to customer business drivers, measurable outcomes, ROI/TCO, and clear success criteria
  • Experience leading conversations with senior technical and business stakeholders, including executives, and influencing long-term modernization, data, and AI strategies
  • Demonstrated ability to create reusable reference architectures, demos, playbooks, or enablement content that improves the effectiveness of other Solutions Architects
  • The ability to travel up to 25%
  • A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience

You may also have:

  • Experience selling databases and/or deploying applications with any of the major cloud providers 
  • Experience with database programming and data models 
  • Experience in data engineering or AI/ML projects
  • Experience in transforming legacy systems and platforms into modern, scalable, and efficient technology stacks
  • Understanding of popular sales methodologies/ frameworks such as MEDDPICC/ Command of the Message
  • A MongoDB Certification
  • A Cloud Provider Certification

What you do at MongoDB:

In this role, you will work on complex opportunities where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of various factors. You will:

  • Design and Architect: Own the end-to-end technical strategy for complex opportunities, designing scalable and performant applications, systems, and infrastructure leveraging MongoDB. Lead architecture reviews, evaluate trade-offs, and reduce technical risk across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments
  • Customer Advising and Value Articulation: Lead discovery with technical and business stakeholders to understand customer priorities, business drivers, and success measures. Guide customers on architecture, modernization, optimization, and AI patterns while clearly connecting MongoDB’s capabilities to measurable business value
  • Sales Partnership: Partner with Account Executives and Sales Leadership on account planning, opportunity prioritization, qualification, and pipeline-generation strategy. Own the technical aspects of the sales cycle—including discovery, demonstrations, proof of value, proposals, sizing, ROI/TCO analysis, presentations, and documentation—and constructively challenge assumptions when needed
  • Executive and Stakeholder Engagement: Build trusted relationships with architects, developers, operations leaders, and executives across multiple teams and workloads. Develop champions, navigate stakeholder dynamics, and maintain strategic relationships beyond individual sales opportunities
  • Demand Generation: Proactively generate demand within the sales territory through technical workshops, executive briefings, user groups, webinars, industry events, account-based marketing activities, and other self-driven initiatives
  • Customer Success: Define clear technical success criteria and help customers achieve adoption, reduce risk, and accelerate time-to-value. Foster strong customer relationships and support successful modernization, migration, and AI initiatives
  • Innovation, Enablement, and Improvement: Create reusable reference architectures, demos, playbooks, and technical content that scale the impact of the Solutions Architecture organization. Relay structured field feedback to Product and Engineering, mentor other Solutions Architects, and continuously improve MongoDB solutions and engagement practices
  • Personal Training and Development: Engage in ongoing training and professional development to stay at the forefront of MongoDB’s product suite, cloud-native architectures, AI and RAG patterns, data security, observability, and relevant industry trends

What you will learn:

  • MongoDB Data Platform: Apply deep knowledge of MongoDB, Atlas, Atlas Search, Atlas Vector Search, Atlas Stream Processing, Atlas Data Lake, Charts, and Relational Migrator to customer use cases
  • Modern Application Architectures: Design cloud-native, distributed, highly available, secure, and observable systems across hyperscaler, on-premises, hybrid, and multi-cloud environments

title: SVP, Revenue Marketing
descriptionHtml:
MongoDB is growing faster than it has in years, with strong momentum in Atlas and EA. We are consolidating global Revenue Marketing under one leader to strengthen our partnership with Sales and build a modern, AI-powered revenue growth engine.

The SVP of Revenue Marketing owns marketing-sourced revenue for our sales-led business across AMER, EMEA, and APJ, including new investments in India, Japan, and Public Sector. You will rethink how we generate growth, connecting account intelligence, enterprise demand creation, developer engagement, and sales execution into a scalable system that influences architecture decisions and converts demand into revenue. You will also own partner marketing, digital services, and MDF.

This role reports to the CMO, sits on the Marketing Leadership Team, and partners directly with the CRO. This is a revenue role that lives in marketing. You know why pipeline is short before anyone asks, and you act.

This role can be based out of any of our US offices or remotely in the United States. 

What you will own

  • Marketing-sourced revenue: Own the sales-led marketing revenue target, regional forecasts, and performance; Anticipate pipeline gaps, diagnose performance, and adjust investment and execution to deliver the number
  • Global revenue growth system: Build a unified growth engine across AMER, EMEA, and APJ; Move beyond traditional campaign- and event-centric execution toward always-on, signal-driven engagement; Establish repeatable growth plays, shared capabilities, and measurement while enabling regional teams to adapt to local markets

How we'll measure success

title: Solutions Architect
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for passionate technologists to join our Pre-Sales organization to ensure that our growth is grounded and guided by strong technical alignment with our platform and the needs of our customers.

MongoDB Pre-Sales Solution Architects are responsible for guiding our customers and users to design and build reliable, scalable systems using our data platform. Our team is made up of seasoned technical sales professionals, software architects, entrepreneurs, and developers who take direct responsibility for customer success, including the design of their software, deployment, and operations. You'll work closely with our sales executives, helping customers solve business problems by leveraging our solutions, playing a key role in winning deals and driving the business forward. You'll be a trusted advisor to a wide range of users from startups to the world's largest enterprise IT organizations.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Singapore for our hybrid working model.

As an ideal candidate, you will have:

  • 8 to 11 years of related industry experience, ideally 5-7 years of experience in a customer facing role
  • Minimum of 3 years experience with modern scripting languages (e.g. Python, Node.js, SQL) and/or popular programming languages (e.g. C/C++, Java, C#) in a professional capacity
  • Experience implementing scalable and highly available distributed systems in the cloud and on-prem
  • Demonstrated ability to work with customers to review complex architecture of existing applications, providing guidance on how to improve by leveraging technology
  • Excellent presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to convey complex technical and business concepts in a clear and compelling manner to technology and business leadership 
  • Ability to work with a cross functional sales team to formulate and execute an end to end deal cycle
  • A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience 
  • Must have fluency in Mandarin language both verbal and written

You may also have:

  • Experience developing, deploying, or supporting applications with any of the major cloud providers 
  • Experience working in a technical pre-sales capacity 
  • Experience with database programming and data models 
  • Experience in data engineering or AI/ML projects
  • Understanding of popular sales methodologies/ frameworks such as MEDDPICC/ Command of the Message
  • A MongoDB Certification
  • A Cloud Provider Certification

What you do at MongoDB:

In this role, you will work on complex opportunities where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of various factors. You will:

  • Design and Architect: Design scalable and performant applications, systems and infrastructure for large software projects leveraging MongoDB
  • Customer Advising and Value Articulation: Guide customers on architecture patterns and optimisation strategies for MongoDB, while clearly communicating its business value to the relevant stakeholders

MongoDB Product Suite Mastery:

  • Core Database Server: Master the fundamentals and advanced features of MongoDB's core database

title: Senior Manager, Engineering
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a Senior Engineering Manager to join the Observability team within MongoDB. This is an opportunity to join a team that is responsible for all Observability systems that support operational metrics, visualization, logs, traces, and alerts to monitor the performance and health of our customers' MongoDB deployments. We are looking for a senior leader that is results focused, with high standards, and experience in managing large teams of engineers (or engineering managers) in designing, building and operating complex distributed systems at scale, with strict SLO on security, durability, availability and performance.  

Tens of thousands of customers depend on our Observability stack to monitor their database clusters and to generate actionable alerts to safeguard critical workloads. As MongoDB Atlas and its supporting infrastructure continue to experience rapid growth, the demand for high-cardinality observability data for internal and external use cases means we need to continually innovate and scale our systems to the next level. For example, MongoDB Observability systems need to handle 10’s of billions of metrics time series, all whilst processing petabytes of logs, traces, and events.

Our team champions a strong culture of inclusivity, diversity, and collaboration. If you want to be a deeply technical leader on a collaborative team that applies low-level systems expertise to build the foundational infrastructure of a popular database, join us! 

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin for our hybrid working model.

What you’ll do

  • Manage and coach a large team of motivated individual contributors (up to 10) who are eager to learn and grow
  • Contribute to the design, infrastructure and architecture of the high-volume ingestion systems your team develops
  • Work closely with product managers, program managers, and other engineering teams to specify, prioritize and deliver new features that delight our users, internally and externally
  • Estimate task complexity, report progress, and voice risks for projects executed by the team
  • Work with customers and support engineers to fix issues and become part of our on-call rotation 
  • Collaborate with team members and Engineering Managers to improve the health, design principles and best practices of our codebase and on-call rotation
  • Drive best practices for monitoring, reliability, and performance of observability services in production
  • Actively participate in growing the team by hiring
  • Foster an inclusive and respectful work environment according to MongoDB's Core Values

We’re looking for someone who

  • Has at least 8 years of professional software development experience
  • Has at least 4 years of people management experience and performance management
  • Has experience with managing larger teams or engineering managers 
  • Has led engineering teams that have built, designed and maintained large scale systems
  • Can showcase delivering operationally solid systems and strives and can demonstrate examples of a high bar of engineering excellence
  • Has experience with at least one major cloud provider technology (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Is eager to solve tough problems and help engineers navigate tricky production outages
  • Has excellent communication skills
  • Is curious, collaborative, and motivated

Success Measures

  • In 1 month, you'll be familiar with the foundational parts of the system, the existing features, and projects within the Atlas Observability team
  • In 3 months, you will be contributing to design and development of your team’s projects and working on your team’s growth
  • In 6 months, you and your team will have ramped enough to take on medium sized projects and you will be leading your team towards its product and engineering goals. You will be supporting our customers during escalations and have joined our on-call rotation

descriptionHtml:

descriptionHtml:

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree with a quantitative focus (Economics, Finance, Computer Science, Mathematics, etc.)
  • 5+ years of work experience in either CS, Sales, GTM Strategy and/or Operations
  • 1+ years of leadership experience
  • Comfortable being in a player-coach manager type role
  • Familiarity with consumption-based software business models
  • Experience as a business partner to a field organization
  • Experience with at least one major business intelligence tool (Tableau, Google Data Studio, Looker)

The Ideal Candidate

  • Thrives in working in a fast-paced working environment
  • Effective communicator who can break down convoluted technical, financial, or operational concepts into simple business vernacular
  • Believes that the best way to drive success is by motivating and leveraging their team to deliver results without being hands-off or disconnected from the day to day work

title: Software Engineer 3
descriptionHtml:
The Kubernetes teams make running MongoDB in and from Kubernetes so frictionless that it is the default database choice for cloud-native applications. Our operators let developers and platform teams provision, scale and operate MongoDB through Kubernetes-native APIs, in their own clusters or in MongoDB Atlas.

You will join the Kubernetes Capabilities squad. Our sister squad builds the shared platform layer of the MongoDB Controllers for Kubernetes; we build the capabilities on top of it that users actually adopt. That means bringing MongoDB features such as Search and Vector Search to Kubernetes, extending what our users can deploy and manage declaratively, and owning the Atlas Kubernetes Operator. Our work starts with a user problem and ends with a Kubernetes API that solves it.

In practice, we build a platform for other engineers. Our users are developers and platform teams who expect self-service, sensible defaults and APIs that behave predictably. If you have built an internal developer platform, a Kubernetes controller, or any system whose customers are other engineers, you will recognise the problems we work on.

No prior experience with MongoDB is required. You will meet most of the team during interviews, and we pride ourselves on being an inclusive, collaborative group that Builds Together. Our core engineering values are Context, Predictability, Transparency, Focus and Craftsmanship.

This role can be based in our Dublin office, Cork office or remotely within Ireland.

The role

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join the Kubernetes Capabilities squad and help decide which MongoDB capabilities our users get on Kubernetes and how they work. You will own significant capabilities from design to production, make sound technical decisions under ambiguity, and raise the engineering bar of the team through design, review and mentorship.

Experience we value

What matters most is that you have built platforms, not only operated them. We value experience from any of these backgrounds: 

  • Building Kubernetes controllers, operators, CRDs, admission webhooks or other extensions against the Kubernetes API
  • Building internal developer platforms: self-service provisioning, golden paths, platform APIs, CLIs or developer portals used by other engineering teams
  • Building developer-facing infrastructure products such as SDKs, managed services, CI/CD systems or cloud provisioning tooling

Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and delivery of new capabilities in our Kubernetes operators, from technical design through production support
  • Work with Product and the teams behind MongoDB features to turn them into Kubernetes-native APIs our users can adopt
  • Write technical designs that weigh trade-offs clearly and bring the team and stakeholders to a decision
  • Shape our platform APIs with our users in mind: predictable, self-service and safe to operate
  • Mentor engineers through pairing, code review and design feedback
  • Partner with our platform squad, Support, Docs and other engineering teams, and help resolve complex customer issues
  • Improve how the team works, including testing strategy, release quality and developer experience

Requirements

  • Strong core software engineering skills and several years building production software in a modern language; we mostly use Go
  • Proven experience building a platform for other engineers, such as Kubernetes controllers and operators, an internal developer platform, or developer-facing infrastructure products
  • Deep working knowledge of Kubernetes, including its API model, reconciliation and the operational realities of running workloads on it
  • Experience designing, testing and operating distributed systems in production
  • A track record of leading projects through ambiguity and delivering them end to end
  • Strong written communication, including technical design documents

Nice to have

  • Experience with controller-runtime, kubebuilder or contributing to Kubernetes ecosystem projects
  • Experience with multi-cluster Kubernetes, networking or service mesh
  • Experience running stateful workloads or databases on Kubernetes
  • Experience with a major public cloud provider

What is in it for you

  • Generous compensation package (top-range salary, equity, comprehensive benefits)
  • A diverse, highly collaborative team that values shipping fast and clean
  • Time to learn on the job and grow into new technologies
  • A high level of independence, focused on results rather than the appearance of work

title: Program Manager, GRC Audit
descriptionHtml:
The Compliance team at MongoDB manages the strategy, execution, and maintenance of our global security certifications and regulatory requirements. We ensure that our cloud database products meet the rigorous security standards required by our customers in the most highly regulated industries worldwide.

We act as the primary interface between external auditors and our internal Product, Engineering, and Legal teams. Our goal is to translate complex regulatory requirements into scalable operational processes, maintaining a compliant and audit-ready posture across our diverse portfolio.

The Program Manager is a mid-to-senior level individual contributor role responsible for leading high-stakes audits and specialized compliance workstreams. This role takes full ownership of complex international frameworks—such as IRAP and ENS High—and manages the relationship with our Financial Services customers during audit deep-dives. You will lead internal audit cadences and perform gap analyses for new market expansions.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin for our hybrid working model.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end execution of specialized external audits (e.g., PCI, SOC2, ENS High, IRAP, ISO 22301) and coordinate all phases from initial scoping to final certification
  • Serve as the lead point of contact for Financial Services customer audits, facilitating meetings, responding to security questionnaires, and defending our control environment to external stakeholders
  • Lead internal audit cadences and drive the POA&M tracking process, ensuring technical teams remediate findings within required SLAs
  • Map new regulatory requirements to our central control framework, performing gap analyses to identify where existing controls can be leveraged for new certifications
  • Conduct NIST CSF or similar maturity assessments to monitor the effectiveness of the Compliance Program and report findings to team leads
  • Author and review customer-facing security documentation, ensuring it accurately reflects our technical controls and architectural guardrails
  • Partner with Engineering and Product leads to implement compliance-by-design, ensuring future product roadmaps align with global regulatory shifts
  • You are expected to be a subject matter expert who can operate with minimal supervision
  • You don't just track tasks; you own the success of the program
  • You are expected to navigate complex audit negotiations with external parties and drive internal technical teams toward compliance milestones without disrupting innovation
  • The scope is international and technically diverse. You will manage overlapping audit cycles across different global jurisdictions (e.g., Spain, Australia, US) and complex industry sectors
  • You are responsible for identifying how a single technical control can satisfy multiple global regulatory requirements simultaneously
  • You have the authority to lead audit engagements and represent MongoDB’s security posture to sophisticated Financial Services customers
  • Your impact is direct: by securing and maintaining these certifications, you enable our sales organization to close enterprise-level deals in highly regulated markets
  • You will be recognized as an expert in implementing our Common Controls Framework
  • You move beyond general compliance to become a specialist in how MongoDB’s architecture satisfies specific, high-bar standards like IRAP and PCI. You are the go-to for mapping technical evidence to regulatory intent

Requirements

  • 7+ years in GRC, Information Security, or IT Audit, specifically within a high-growth SaaS/Cloud environment
  • Deep understanding of cloud security principles (AWS/GCP/Azure) and a proven track record leading technical audits for ISO 27001, SOC 2, or PCI
  • Solid grasp of audit processes, terminology, and risk assessment standards. Certifications such as CISA, CRISC, CISSP, or ISO Lead Implementer are highly preferred
  • Exceptional ability to lead meetings with external customers and auditors, translating technical complexities into business risk and compliance assurance
  • Advanced proficiency in Jira for tracking control performance data and managing high-volume remediation workflows
  • Practical experience performing gap analyses and maturity assessments at an enterprise level

title: Senior Solutions Architect (Pre-Sales)
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for passionate technologists to join our Pre-Sales organization to ensure that our growth is grounded and guided by strong technical alignment with our platform and the needs of our customers.

MongoDB Pre-Sales Solution Architects are responsible for guiding our customers and users to design and build reliable, scalable systems using our data platform. Our team is made up of seasoned technical sales professionals, software architects, entrepreneurs, and developers who take direct responsibility for customer success, including the design of their software, deployment, and operations. You'll work closely with our sales executives, helping customers solve business problems by leveraging our solutions, playing a key role in winning deals and driving the business forward. You'll be a trusted advisor to a wide range of users from startups to the world's largest enterprise IT organizations. 

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Chicago for our hybrid working model. 

As an ideal candidate, you will have

  • Ideally 8 to 11 years of related experience in a customer facing role, with 5 to 7 years of experience in pre-sales with enterprise software
  • Minimum of 3 years experience with modern scripting languages (e.g. Python, Node.js, SQL) and/or popular programming languages (e.g. C/C++, Java, C#) in a professional capacity
  • Experience designing with scalable and highly available distributed systems in the cloud and on-prem
  • Demonstrated ability to work with customers to review complex architecture of existing applications, providing guidance on how to improve by leveraging technology
  • Excellent presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to convey complex technical and business concepts in a clear and compelling manner to technology and business leadership
  • Ability to strategize with sales teams and provide recommendations on how to drive a multi-threaded account strategy, aligning other MongoDB and ecosystem resources to move towards a mutually beneficial account plan
  • The ability to travel up to 25%
  • A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience

You may also have

  • Experience selling databases and/or deploying applications with any of the major cloud providers 
  • Experience with database programming and data models

  • Personal Training and Development: Engage in ongoing training and professional development to stay abreast of MongoDB product suite as well as industry trends

What you will learn

  • Core Database Server: Master the fundamentals and advanced features of MongoDB's core database
  • Atlas and Advanced Services: Gain expertise in Atlas (fully managed cloud database service), Atlas Stream Processing, Atlas Data Lake, Atlas Full-Text Search, Atlas Vector Search, and Charts

  • Hyperscaler Ecosystem: Gain expertise in designing complex systems utilizing cloud services on hyperscaler platforms
  • Complementary Technologies: Enhance your skills with partner and complementary technologies such as Apache Kafka and Kubernetes

Modern Architecture Design

  • Design Patterns and Methodologies: Embrace best practices in microservices, DevOps, cloud, and security
  • Cutting Edge RAG and AI Architectures: Help customers on their generative AI journeys and working with industry leading partners in the space

title: Staff Technical Program Manager, IT Audit & Governance
descriptionHtml:
We're looking for a senior, hands-on leader to own IT audit and governance across all of our applications, infrastructure, and systems. You'll be accountable for keeping IT audit-ready every day: SOX ITGCs and ITACs, plus the broader audit and governance obligations that touch the technology stack (SOC reports, ISO, security and regulatory audits).

This role is about accountability and execution. You'll work with cross-functional IT leaders across Infrastructure, Engineering, Security, Cloud, Enterprise Applications, and Business Systems to make sure controls are owned, operated, evidenced, and remediated on time. You'll also be the primary IT liaison to Internal Audit, Finance/SOX PMO, and external auditors. You operate independently, influence without authority, and can speak credibly with an engineer about a CI/CD pipeline and with the CAO about a deficiency.

We're looking to speak with candidates based in Palo Alto or New York City for our hybrid working model.

What You'll Do

Own audit and governance across all IT

  • Own the audit and governance program across all IT applications, infrastructure, cloud platforms, and supporting systems
  • Maintain a complete inventory of systems, owners, and applicable audit and compliance obligations (SOX, SOC 1/SOC 2, ISO 27001, and other regulatory or customer requirements)
  • Build and run an IT audit calendar that coordinates SOX, internal audit, external audit, and compliance activities to reduce duplicate asks and audit fatigue
  • Establish governance standards, policies, and control frameworks that apply consistently across IT

Drive accountability and execution with IT leaders

  • Partner with cross-functional IT leaders to assign clear control and remediation ownership, with defined deadlines and escalation paths
  • Run regular governance forums and control health reviews with IT leadership, reporting status, risks, and overdue items
  • Hold teams accountable for timely control execution, evidence quality, and issue closure, escalating early when commitments slip
  • Translate audit and compliance requirements into practical work that engineering and infrastructure teams can adopt without slowing delivery

Own ITGC and ITAC compliance

  • Own the end-to-end SOX IT program: scoping inputs, control design, ownership, evidence, readiness testing, and issue management
  • Maintain the ITGC framework (access management, change management, IT operations, SDLC) across all in-scope applications, databases, operating systems, and cloud infrastructure
  • Own ITAC strategy and coverage with Finance and business-system owners: automated controls, configurations, interfaces, calculations, and approval workflows
  • Own IPE/report validation, ITAC baselines, and segregation of duties (SoD) across ERP and key financial applications

Design, operate, and strengthen controls

  • Design controls that are engineered into IT workflows (ticketing, CI/CD, IAM, CMDB) rather than layered on manually
  • Run readiness and self-assessment testing ahead of Internal Audit and external auditor testing
  • Rationalize overlapping controls across frameworks so one control and one piece of evidence can satisfy multiple requirements
  • Drive automation and continuous control monitoring to reduce manual effort and audit burden
  • Manage SOC 1/SOC 2 report reviews, CUECs, and third-party/vendor control dependencies

Drive remediation and issue management

  • Own the issue lifecycle across IT, from identification and root cause through remediation plan, validation, and closure
  • Prepare management's response to audit findings and provide the IT perspective on deficiency severity with Finance, Legal, and Internal Audit
  • Report control health and remediation status to IT leadership, the CAO, and the Audit Committee as needed

Be the IT face to auditors and the business

  • Serve as primary IT contact for Internal Audit and external auditors on scope, walkthroughs, evidence requests, and reliance strategy
  • Coordinate PBC requests, evidence standards, and timelines across IT teams
  • Train and enable control owners and IT leaders on audit requirements, evidence quality, and their responsibilities

Lead and elevate the program

  • Set standards for control documentation, evidence, and issue management across IT
  • Mentor analysts and guide co-source or outsourced resources
  • Contribute to emerging governance areas such as AI/emerging technology

What You'll Bring

Required

  • 8-12+ years of experience in IT audit, SOX compliance, IT governance, or technology risk (Big 4, internal audit, or in-house IT GRC)
  • Deep, hands-on experience with SOX 404 ITGCs and ITACs in a public company
  • Working knowledge of COSO, COBIT, and PCAOB AS 2201, and how external auditors approach IT reliance and ITAC testing
  • Experience across modern technology environments: cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), SaaS, ERP (e.g., Oracle, NetSuite, SAP), infrastructure, and identity/access platforms
  • Familiarity with other frameworks and audits (SOC 1/SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST) and how to harmonize them
  • Proven track record of owning programs end-to-end and driving accountability and execution across multiple teams and senior leaders without direct authority
  • Excellent communication and executive presence, including negotiating with auditors and briefing senior leadership
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Accounting, Computer Science, or a related field

Preferred

  • CISA, CISSP, CIA, CPA, or equivalent certification
  • Experience with GRC and audit tools (e.g., AuditBoard, ServiceNow GRC, Workiva, Archer)
  • Data analytics skills (SQL, Python, Power BI/Tableau) for full-population testing and control monitoring
  • Experience in high-growth, SaaS, or technology company environments
  • Familiarity with DevOps/CI-CD, infrastructure-as-code, and change management in agile environments

What Success Looks Like

title: Regional Director, Commercial Growth
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity:

MongoDB is a true data platform with a comprehensive suite of tools to make working with data remarkably easy for everyone, from developers to analysts to data scientists. We are growing our Commercial Growth Sales Team to help our customers be more productive while still providing all the capabilities needed to meet the most complex requirements at any scale. We are looking for a leader to build and develop an all-star team of Commercial Growth sales  professionals.

We like to say, “Come to MongoDB and get your Masters in Sales” and your “Ph.D. in Leadership,” where we spend significant time on AE and leader enablement. We invest in ways to attract, hire, and develop top talent while ensuring our team is are set up for long-term success on their individual career paths.

This role will be located in Austin, TX.

About the Role

As the Regional Director, you will drive revenue and ensure the continued successful trajectory of the territory while also focusing on recruitment, enablement, and execution for the Commercial Growth Sales Team. With a people-first culture, which is echoed throughout the whole company, managing and leading our team is top of mind. Our sales leadership is committed to building the best salesforce in technology, with a legendary reputation of excellence and integrity. This means, inspiring and enabling success for everyone on the team. We provide the opportunity for all Regional Directors to sit with their peers and collectively learn from each other about how to better develop our people, recruit, retain, and use data to get the best results for and from our people. All of us are committed to working hard to build something unparalleled in the industry.

What is Commercial Growth Sales:

The Commercial Growth Team’s mission is to drive broader revenue expansion by prioritizing accounts with high potential for multi-workload adoption, proactively retaining top accounts with strong growth trajectories, and accelerating new workload contributions through strategic use case expansion.

Our sales motion combines strategic account planning, consultative selling, and product-led insights to drive growth. By understanding customer business priorities, leveraging product usage signals, and engaging key stakeholders, we identify opportunities to modernize applications, expand workloads, and deliver measurable business outcomes. Through a value-driven, multi-threaded approach, we build stronger customer relationships, accelerate adoption, and position MongoDB as a strategic partner for long-term growth.

  • Develop deep product and market expertise to mentor AEs, navigate complex customer organizations, and position MongoDB as a strategic technology partner
  • Drive operational excellence through weekly forecast meetings, pipeline inspection, territory planning, and data-driven decision-making to improve predictability and sales productivity
  • Build strong cross-functional partnerships with Solutions Architecture, Professional Services, Customer Success, Marketing, and other stakeholders to accelerate customer outcomes and unlock growth opportunities
  • Shape and scale our Commercial Growth business by optimizing territory coverage, evolving go-to-market strategies, developing future leaders, and establishing repeatable best practices

What you will bring to the table:

descriptionHtml:
MongoDB Professional Services (PS) works with customers of all shapes and sizes, in all verticals, from tier-1 banks to small web startups, on a variety of exciting use cases.   • 2+ years of software development/consulting/support experience, preferably in a number of distinct industries/verticals
  • Familiarity with enterprise-scale software architectures, application development methodologies, and software deployment and operations

title: Senior Software Engineer, Cluster to Cluster Synchronization, Migration Tooling
descriptionHtml:
The Cluster to Cluster Synchronization team is working to make migrations, backups, and disaster recovery of MongoDB clusters easy and reliable. Our main focus is mongosync, a tool to synchronize two MongoDB clusters. This tool is a top priority for the company, and is used to migrate customers from on-prem MongoDB to MongoDB's cloud service, MongoDB Atlas.

Our team champions a strong culture of inclusivity and collaboration. If you want to work on a collaborative team that’s creating a high-performance distributed service for syncing databases, this is the team for you! 

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin for our hybrid working model.

Responsibilities

  • Build mongosync, a database migration and syncing tool. This tool is heavily used by MongoDB Atlas (our Database-as-a-Service), as well as by on-prem customers
  • Develop the MongoDB Database Tools, a set of CLI utilities for working with a MongoDB deployment. It includes tools for importing, exporting, and diagnostics
  • Work closely with product, support, and engineers across the organization to collectively build features that our customers love
  • Mentor and contribute to the growth of team members

Candidate Profile

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience designing, building, testing, and maintaining industrial-strength software
  • Experience with building databases or core components for data processing systems
  • Experience with distributed systems such as data replication, distributed transactions, scalability, and fault tolerance
  • Experience in at least one compiled language, and interest in working with Go
  • Excellent verbal and written technical communication skills and a desire to collaborate with colleagues and mentor junior engineers
  • Curiosity, willingness, and ability to quickly learn new things in the domains of computer science and software engineering

Success Measures

  • In three months you’ll have learned about how MongoDB and mongosync works. You’ll have contributed to an ongoing project and fixed a few bugs in existing code
  • In six months, you’ll be reviewing code and new feature designs. You're involved in the design and implementation of a major project, and leading development of smaller features
  • In twelve months, you’re leading the design and development of major new features and are helping to mentor new engineers on the team. You have strong familiarity with the products the team owns and are able to work across the codebase

title: Executive Assistant
descriptionHtml:
MongoDB is seeking an Executive Assistant, based in the United States, to support two SVPs and one VP in our Marketing org based across the United States. This role is ideal for a dynamic, intelligent, highly-organized individual who thrives in dynamic environments, takes ownership over the details and loves to get things done.

In this role, your day will consist of managing and prioritizing a steady stream of requests, meetings, and trips, and anticipating how your executives want these priorities to be handled. To succeed in this role, you’ll need to balance the needs and requirements of multiple stakeholders and be ready to pitch in wherever needed. You should be comfortable engaging with senior executives, navigating ambiguity, and operating with a high level of discretion and autonomy. This is a hybrid position, requiring in-office presence several times per month. Occasional travel may be required to support your executive in planning and executing offsites.

Responsibilities

  • Provide seamless day-to-day support to the executive, including proactive calendar management, time prioritization, and coordination across time zones
  • Think ahead and manage time effectively, anticipating scheduling conflicts, proactively booking a month in advance, and making adjustments to avoid last-minute disruptions
  • Coordinate complex domestic and international travel in line with policy, and manage monthly expense reconciliation with accuracy and timeliness
  • Partner with the executive on long-term planning and operating rhythms, including goal tracking, meeting preparation, and slide and agenda development
  • Track key deliverables and action items to closure with integrity and accountability, escalating blockers when needed and following through without reminders
  • Lead the planning and execution of events and offsites, from gathering requirements and securing venues to managing budgets, contracts, and payments
  • Build trusted relationships across functions and levels, communicating with professionalism and discretion in support of the executive
  • Take ownership of special projects as needed, showing initiative and sound judgment in ambiguous or fast-changing scenarios

Requirements

  • 4+ years experience supporting executives, or other relevant experience working directly with executives

title: Lead, Engineering Backup
descriptionHtml:
Engineering Manager, Atlas Infinite Backup

New York City

MongoDB powers mission-critical workloads for customers who expect their data to be durable, recoverable, and fast to access. Atlas Infinite is our next-generation cloud-native architecture that decouples compute from storage, and its storage layer continuously backs every cluster up to cloud object storage. The Atlas Infinite Backup team builds the systems that turn that stream of data into something customers can trust: point-in-time recovery, retained snapshots, fast restores, disaster recovery, and backup storage that stays affordable as clusters grow to hundreds of terabytes.

We are hiring an Engineering Manager to lead this team. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who takes the responsibility of durably storing and recovering customer data seriously, is comfortable with the economics of large-scale storage, and has strong empathy for both their team and our users.

About the Atlas Infinite Backup team

The team is part of MongoDB's Backup and Object Storage Services organization and works hand in hand with Storage Layer Services, the disaggregated storage layer behind Atlas Infinite. We own the object storage tier: everything that happens to a cluster's data after it leaves the hot path and lands in cloud object storage. Because backup is a property of the storage layer rather than a separate agent copying files, the team works on the storage engine's write path, data layout, and lifecycle as much as on backup features.

The team's responsibilities include:

  • Continuous backup of log and page data to object storage, and the indexing that lets a cluster's full history be located and read efficiently
  • Point-in-time recovery, snapshot retention, and restore for clusters at the scale of 100+ TB per shard, including cluster-level and collection-level restore
  • Compaction and garbage collection of the object store so that retained history costs what it should and no more
  • Cold data: serving and tiering infrequently accessed collections and indexes directly from object storage
  • Metering and billing for backup storage, including the model that decides what customers pay for retained snapshots and point-in-time recovery
  • Disaster recovery and compliance capabilities for Atlas Infinite, such as cross-region protection, retention policies, and data lifecycle guarantees
  • Operating these services in production across many cells and regions: observability, on-call, capacity, and cost

What you'll do

  • Lead, grow, and manage a team of 6 engineers working in Rust and Java on distributed storage systems; set clear expectations, high standards, and healthy, sustainable execution
  • Own the team's roadmap across durability, recoverability, cost efficiency, and compliance, in partnership with Backup and Object Storage Services leadership and Product Management
  • Drive the Atlas Infinite backup roadmap to GA and beyond: define what done means for disaster recovery, compliance, and backup economics, and sequence the work to get there
  • Manage customer escalations involving backup, restore, or backup cost; work with Support, Atlas, and server teams to reproduce, root-cause, and resolve issues
  • Partner closely with the WiredTiger storage engine team, the Storage Layer Services teams that own the Log Service and Page Materializer, Atlas Backup, Atlas Billing, and Pricing & Packaging on cross-team features such as incremental billing, collection-level restore, and cold collections
  • Raise the bar on engineering practice: design reviews, operational readiness, incident follow-through, and the tooling that lets a small team run a large production footprint
  • Represent the team in planning, staffing, and calibration; make thoughtful tradeoffs between near-term GA deliverables, long-term architecture, and operational investments

Candidate profile

  • 8+ years building, debugging, and operating distributed storage, database, or large-scale data infrastructure systems (storage engines, object storage, backup and recovery systems, log-structured systems, or similar)
  • 2+ years managing engineers directly, including hiring, performance management, and coaching across a range of levels
  • Strong proficiency in at least one compiled, statically-typed language such as Rust, Java, C++, or Go; experience with both Rust and Java is a plus
  • Deep understanding of durability, consistency, and recovery tradeoffs; experience with snapshots, point-in-time recovery, log-structured storage, compaction, or cloud object storage (S3, GCS, Azure Blob) is highly desirable
  • An instinct for storage economics: you have reasoned about cost per GB, data lifecycle, and how physical layout translates into a customer's bill
  • Demonstrated customer obsession: direct experience working with demanding customers or support teams on complex incidents and turning them into clear, outcome-oriented recommendations
  • Proven ability to develop people: mentoring and promoting engineers, managing underperformance directly, and building high-engagement teams with low regretted attrition
  • Comfortable leading multi-quarter initiatives with multiple stakeholders and using written documents to align teams on design, scope, and tradeoffs
  • Curious, collaborative, and intellectually honest

Success measures

In three months, you have:

  • Built strong relationships with your team and key partner teams across Storage Layer Services, Atlas Backup, and Product
  • Taken over team ceremonies, short-term planning, and on-call ownership
  • Co-led at least one active project and shipped one concrete process or operational improvement

In six to twelve months, you have:

  • Led at least one cross-team initiative in recoverability, disaster recovery, or backup cost efficiency through to production
  • Delivered a multi-quarter project with clear impact on Atlas Infinite's GA readiness or on what backup costs customers
  • Built a bench of engineers ready for increased scope and, over time, leadership roles

Preferred

  • Prior exposure to database, cloud, and infrastructure technology is a plus

title: Senior Software Engineer, Atlas Agent Engine
descriptionHtml:
MongoDB’s mission is to empower innovators to create, transform, and disrupt industries by unleashing the power of software and data. We enable organizations of all sizes to easily build, scale, and run modern applications by helping them modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our industry-leading developer data platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud database and is available in more than 115 regions across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. Atlas allows customers to build and run applications anywhere—on premises, or across cloud providers. With offices worldwide and over 175,000 new developers signing up to use MongoDB every month, it’s no wonder that leading organizations, like Samsung and Toyota, trust MongoDB to build next-generation, AI-powered applications.

Atlas Agent Engine is an agent development platform built on Atlas. It lets enterprises build, deploy, and govern AI agents in production on top of their real-time operational data. Many agents stall between demo and production because of gaps in memory, governance, and security. Agent Engine addresses these natively, as one foundation for execution, memory, and governance, instead of a stack of separate tools.

We are seeking a Software Engineer to join the Atlas Agent Engine team to build and scale the core of this platform. You will work on the developer CLI, SDKs, and distributed systems that run agents reliably at scale: the runtime, memory, retrieval, identity, and governance layers. You’ll take on challenging, high-visibility projects that improve the performance, scalability, and reliability of a new product. MongoDB engineering teams pride themselves on building high-quality software and living our cultural values every day. We value intellectual curiosity and honesty, and building together in an environment that prioritizes collaboration over competition.

We are looking to speak to candidates in the United States based on our remote working model.

Position Expectations

  • Work closely with research, product management, product engineering, product design, peers as well as other teams within the company to implement the first version and future evolution of the service 
  • Design, build and deliver well-tested core pieces of the platform in collaboration with other vested parties
  • Contribute to shaping architecture, code reviews and development practices, developer experience as the teams and product grow 
  • Mentor fellow engineers and assume ownership and accountability of projects

Qualifications

  • Strong background in building core components for high scale compute and data distributed systems
  • 5+ years experience of building distributed systems, and/or foundational cloud services at scale and an interest in working with Go, Python, and Typescript.
  • Proven success in designing, writing, testing, debugging, performance tuning, possessing a strong grip on the foundational materials of computer science and maintaining distributed and/or highly concurrent software systems in large, long-lived code bases
  • Track record of identifying problems, implementing solutions and delivering complex projects in distributed systems or databases
  • Good verbal and written technical communication skills, desire to collaborate with colleagues
  • Bonus: Experience with AI frameworks and tools, open standards such as MCP, A2A, multi-tenant security, enterprise authentication and identity management.
  • Eager to learn, with a strong technical background
